843262853a47af8b25d8.title: Travel Coordinator (Temp)
843262853a47af8b25d8.description:
For 30 years, SQA Services has been a premier leader in providing managed supplier quality services for audits, assessments, remote surveillance assessments, corrective actions, remediation, inspections, and engineering to manufacturers within all industries. We deliver services by deploying associates who are located throughout the United States and in 90+ countries around the world to your supplier sites. Our associates are expert quality assurance professionals with broad experience and local knowledge who can represent our clients on-demand and on-site faster than our competitors.

The Travel Coordinator is responsible for coordinating domestic and international business travel while ensuring compliance with company travel policies and budget requirements. This position serves as the primary point of contact for employee travel, manages travel-related expenses and documentation, and provides support to travelers before, during, and after their trips. This is a 4-5 month contract in which you will work 8:00am-5:00pm PST hours.

### **Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and book domestic and international business travel, including flights, hotels, rental cars, and ground transportation through the company's travel management platform or other approved booking methods when business needs require.

* Research and provide travel itineraries, pricing options, and cost comparisons to support business travel planning.

* Review travel requests and bookings to ensure compliance with company travel policies, preferred vendors, approval requirements, and budget guidelines.

* Coordinate travel approvals and communicate with managers regarding travel requests and policy requirements.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee travel inquiries and provide timely assistance before, during, and after travel.

* Provide guidance and training to employees on travel policies, booking procedures, and use of the company's travel management platform.

* Assist travelers with itinerary changes, cancellations, delays, and other time-sensitive travel disruptions

* Communicate with the company's travel management platform, airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors to resolve booking issues, refunds, credits, billing discrepancies, and other travel-related concerns.

* Administer and maintain the company's travel management platform, including user accounts, traveler profiles, system settings, and policy configurations.

* Track and manage unused airline ticket credits, ensuring available credits are applied toward future business travel whenever possible.

* Review, reconcile, and process corporate travel expenses, ensuring charges are accurate, properly documented, and compliant with company policies.

* Monitor corporate travel spending and prepare travel-related reports as needed.

* Submit and manage timesheets within SQA's internal system, ensuring accurate billing, proper documentation, and timely processing of adjustment timesheets when required.

* Update travel forms, procedures, policies, and internal documentation as needed.

* Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of company travel policies and procedures.

* Assist with travel-related projects and other administrative duties as assigned.

* Occasionally respond to urgent, time-sensitive travel issues outside of regular business hours on an as-needed basis.

### **Qualification and Experience**

* Previous experience coordinating corporate travel, travel administration, or administrative support preferred.

* Experience using an online travel management platform (Navan, Concur, Egencia, or similar) preferred.

* Knowledge of corporate travel policies, expense management, and travel compliance.

* Experience working with airlines, hotels, car rental agencies, and other travel vendors.

* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Strong customer service, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Ability to analyze travel costs and identify cost-effective travel solutions.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.

### **Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer.

* Ability to communicate effectively by phone, email, and virtual meetings.

### **Additional Responsibilities**

Depending on business needs, this position may also:

* Create and update SQA associate resumes for recruiting purposes.

* Review and approve associate timesheets.

* Assist with administrative support functions as assigned.

SQA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is based on merit and qualifications and is not influenced by race, color, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

f1f9dbe729f02f0bd5d2.title: EverCommerce Payments - Customer Care Specialist (Remote, US)
f1f9dbe729f02f0bd5d2.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

We are looking for a **Customer Support Specialist** to focus on our EverCommerce Payments solutions. Customer Care Specialists (Tier 2) contribute to the overall success of the Customer Care team by managing and organizing cases escalated from Customer Care Professionals (Tier 1), e-mail and Help Center tickets. Customer Care Specialists serve a critical role as the knowledge and energy leaders for Payments Customer Care

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Be a payments industry expert. Maintain a complete understanding of all EverCommerce Payments policies and procedures.
* Understand how merchant accounts and the credit card industry operates and use that knowledge to unravel mysteries and solve complex problems.
* Meet or exceed individual and team monthly case goals.
* Manage Tier 2 Cases ensuring all cases are addressed within a maximum of 72-hour SLA and a target of 48 hours.
* Assist partners with API-related questions, ensuring proper configuration and functionality for seamless integrations.
* Submit JIRAs for bugs or system issues raised by partners, working closely with the tech team to drive resolution.
* Manage and execute fraud authorization testing cases from initiation to resolution.
* Handle escalated partner cases, managing and resolving complex technical issues that require advanced knowledge and coordination across departments.
* Manage cases transferred from our team, CX department, or partners to full resolution.
* Provide overflow support to Tier 1 teams by managing escalated cases, backup phone/chat support, and email inquiries.
* Occasionally participate in special projects aimed at improving processes, supporting new initiatives, and enhancing the overall customer and partner experience.
  

  
  

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**

* Strong knowledge of payments, merchant accounts, and the credit card industry.
* Ability to investigate complex payment issues and resolve escalated partner cases.
* Ability to manage cases to resolution while meeting service-level expectations, including a 48-hour target and 72-hour maximum for Tier 3 cases.
* Familiarity with APIs and the ability to help partners troubleshoot configuration and integration issues.
* Ability to document bugs or system issues in Jira and coordinate with technical teams through resolution.
* Ability to manage fraud authorization testing cases from initiation through resolution.
* Strong case-management skills, including prioritizing a high volume of cases and meeting individual and team goals.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills for working with partners and internal teams across Customer Care, CX, and Technology.
* Flexibility to provide overflow support through escalated case management, phone or chat backup, and email inquiries.
* Interest in contributing to process improvements, new initiatives, and projects that improve the customer and partner experience.
  

  

**Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

**Benefits and Perks**:

* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid

**Compensation:** The target compensation for this position is $18 to $23 per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

  
  

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. 0163a39781cc426868fd.title: Vice Chair for Clinical Operations for the Department of Radiation Oncology, Thomas Jefferson University
0163a39781cc426868fd.description:
**Number of Positions In Requisition**

1



**Job Details**

The Department of Radiation Oncology at Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Thomas Jefferson University, seeks an experienced radiation oncologist to serve as Vice Chair for Clinical Operations. This is a senior leadership position that reports directly to the Department Chair and works closely with the Associate VP of Radiation Oncology to lead clinical, operational, and strategic performance across the enterprise.
  
The Vice Chair serves as the Chair's principal deputy for the clinical enterprise, with accountability for the safety, quality, consistency, and efficiency of radiation oncology care delivered across all Jefferson Health facilities, and for the strategic growth of that enterprise across the regions. The successful candidate will pair credible clinical practice with operational discipline and judgment — standardizing care across a geographically distributed network while identifying and executing the partnerships, programs, and technology investments that expand access to high-quality radiation oncology.
  
This is a position of unusual scope. Following Jefferson Health's combination with Lehigh Valley Health Network, the radiation oncology enterprise extends from Philadelphia and South Jersey north through the Lehigh Valley and northeastern Pennsylvania. Bringing academic, community, and regional sites across that geography onto common standards of quality, safety, and practice — while respecting the local relationships and referral patterns that sustain each site — is the central work of this role and its principal opportunity for impact.
  
The role is designed as a working leadership position: the Vice Chair maintains an active clinical practice and remains an engaged member of the academic faculty.

**Job Description**

**Clinical Leadership**
-----------------------

Oversee clinical workflows, patient safety, quality metrics, and multidisciplinary program development across the department's radiation oncology facilities.

Provide enterprise physician leadership across the radiation oncology network, partnering with Regional Medical Directors and Site Medical Directors to establish expectations for clinical performance, access, quality, productivity, professionalism, clinical citizenship, and adherence to enterprise standards.

Establish and lead a consistent physician governance structure across the enterprise, including regular engagement with Regional and Site Medical Directors and clear mechanisms for decision-making, escalation, accountability, and dissemination of clinical standards.

* Provide operational oversight of clinical workflows across all Jefferson Health radiation oncology sites — consultation, simulation, planning, treatment delivery, on-treatment management, and survivorship handoff — with an emphasis on timely access and reducing unwarranted variation between sites.

* Serve as the department's physician leader for patient safety: oversee event and near-miss reporting, root cause and common cause analysis, corrective action plans, and closure of the safety loop with frontline staff.

* Define, monitor, and act on the departmental quality dashboard, including time from referral to consultation and from consultation to treatment start, physics and chart-check completion, peer review participation and yield, treatment interruptions and unplanned breaks, on-treatment visit compliance, adverse event and toxicity rates, patient-reported outcomes, and patient experience scores.

* Lead and standardize the departmental peer-review and chart-round structure across sites, including prospective contour and plan reviews.

* Maintain continuous accreditation and regulatory readiness — ASTRO APEx, Commission on Cancer, The Joint Commission, state radiation control programs, and NRC/Agreement State licensure — and lead survey preparation, response, and remediation.

* Develop and maintain evidence-based treatment guidelines, care pathways, and technical standards for contouring, planning, immobilization, image guidance, and dose constraints, and oversee their consistent adoption network-wide.

* Lead multidisciplinary program development in partnership with disease-site leaders in medical oncology, surgical oncology, urology, radiology, pathology, and palliative care — including tumor boards, multidisciplinary clinics, and aligned pathways with the Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center.

* Guide the clinical deployment of advanced technology and techniques across the network — SBRT/SABR, brachytherapy (including HDR and image-guided approaches), adaptive and MR-guided radiotherapy, radiopharmaceutical therapy, and proton referral pathways — including credentialing, competency, and equitable geographic access.

* Partner with medical physics, dosimetry, radiation therapy, nursing, and advanced practice leadership on staffing models, scope of practice, competency assessment, and workflow design.

* Manage clinical capacity: machine utilization, scheduling templates, downtime, and disaster contingency planning, cross-site coverage, and patient transfer protocols.

* Lead post-combination clinical integration of radiation oncology across legacy Jefferson and Lehigh Valley Health Network sites — harmonizing quality and safety standards, peer review, treatment pathways, credentialing, technology standards, and operational metrics into a single accountable system while preserving effective local practice and referral relationships.

* Champion equitable access and consistent quality across the full network — extending academic-standard care, multidisciplinary review, and clinical trial availability to community and regional sites, including those outside the cancer center's formally defined catchment area.

* Develop an enterprise framework for Centers of Excellence and regional specialization, defining which clinical capabilities should be broadly distributed across the network and which highly specialized programs should be concentrated at designated centers based on volume, expertise, technology, quality, access, and academic opportunity.

**Administrative Duties**
-------------------------

* Assist the Department Chair with clinical operations and strategic planning, serving as the senior physician leader for enterprise clinical operations. Serve as the Chair's principal deputy for clinical operations, representing the Chair in designated operational forums and acting on the Chair's behalf as delegated. Work in dyad partnership with the Associate Vice President of Radiation Oncology to align physician leadership with enterprise operations, finance, workforce, capital planning, and strategic execution.

* Co-led annual departmental strategic planning, operating, and capital budget development, and performance-to-budget review for the clinical enterprise.

* Contribute to clinical workforce planning: physician and advanced practice staffing models, site assignments and coverage, call schedules, recruitment needs, and onboarding of new clinical faculty.

* Help design and administer clinical effort, productivity, and incentive frameworks, and participate with the Chair in faculty performance review, professionalism, and clinical citizenship expectations.

* Oversee clinical informatics supporting operations — the oncology information system, electronic health record integration, scheduling, registries, operational dashboards, and automation or AI-enabled workflow improvement — in coordination with information services and institutional digital health leadership.

* Coordinate with fellow Vice Chairs so that clinical operations enable, rather than compete with, research accrual and trainee education.

* Ensure that enterprise clinical operations create infrastructure that advances the Department's academic mission, including clinical trial accrual, resident and trainee education, prospective data collection, implementation research, and dissemination of clinical innovation across the network.

* Represent the department to the hospital, cancer center, medical school, and enterprise administrative leadership, and serve on relevant institutional operating committees.
  

  

**Clinical Practice**
---------------------

Provide direct patient care at the Academic Hub in Center City for an expected 2 days per week.

* Maintain an active, high-quality clinical practice across one or more disease sites that align with departmental needs and the candidate's expertise.

* Meet departmental expectations for clinical productivity, documentation timeliness, peer review participation, coverage and call, and patient experience.

* Model the safety, quality, and pathway-adherence standards that the role is responsible for overseeing.

* Maintain active medical licensure, board certification, and hospital privileges at assigned sites.

* Travel regularly to sites across the network, including the Lehigh Valley and northeastern Pennsylvania, as required by operational responsibilities.
  

  

**5. Academic Contribution**
----------------------------

Participate in clinical, translational, or other research, resident education, and departmental, hospital, and medical school committees.

* Participate in clinical, translational, health services, or implementation and operations research, with scholarly output commensurate with academic rank.

* Support clinical trial accrual across the network and work to extend trial access to community and regional sites.

* Teach and mentor residents, fellows, and medical students, including didactic instruction in quality, safety, and health care operations.

* Mentor junior faculty and advanced practice providers in clinical and operational leadership development.

* Serve on departmental, hospital, cancer center, and Sidney Kimmel Medical College committees.

* Maintain engagement with national professional and cooperative group organizations (e.g., ASTRO, ASCO, AACR, ACR, ACRO, ABS, NRG Oncology).
  

  

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* MD, DO, or MD/PhD degree.

* Board certification in Radiation Oncology by the American Board of Radiology (or board eligible with certification expected within [12] months of appointment).

* Eligibility for unrestricted medical licensure in Pennsylvania and New Jersey.

* Eligibility for faculty appointment at the rank of Associate Professor or Professor at Sidney Kimmel Medical College; rank commensurate with academic record.

* Minimum of [five to seven] years of practice beyond training, including demonstrated formal leadership in clinical operations, quality, or safety (for example, medical director, site director, quality officer, or service line lead).

* Demonstrated experience with quality and safety systems, accreditation processes, and performance metrics in radiation oncology.

* Evidence of effective multidisciplinary collaboration and successful clinical program development.

* Strong communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, and change management skills, with the credibility to lead peers across multiple sites.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience leading clinical operations across multiple sites or within an integrated health system network.

* Experience with post-merger or post-affiliation clinical integration — harmonizing standards, metrics, and governance across previously separate organizations.

* Demonstrated effectiveness working with community and regional physicians and hospital leadership, not solely in an academic medical center setting.

* Formal management training (MBA, MHA, MMM, or an executive leadership program) — valued but not required.

* Working knowledge of radiation oncology reimbursement, coding, and alternative payment models.

* Experience with clinical informatics, operational analytics, or AI-enabled workflow improvement.

* Record of peer-reviewed scholarship and participation in cooperative group or investigator-initiated clinical trials.
  

  

**About the Department and Institution**
========================================

The Department of Radiation Oncology is a department of Sidney Kimmel Medical College at Thomas Jefferson University and delivers care across the Jefferson Health enterprise. The department maintains an ACGME-accredited residency program, an active clinical trials portfolio, including cooperative group participation, and research programs spanning radiation biology, medical physics, precision oncology, and clinical and digital health investigations.

  
  

**The Clinical Enterprise**
---------------------------

Jefferson Health completed its combination with Lehigh Valley Health Network in August 2024, forming a system of 32 hospitals and more than 700 sites of care across eastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey. The radiation oncology clinical enterprise within the scope of this position spans that full geography — from the academic campuses in Philadelphia and the South Jersey sites, north through the Lehigh Valley and northeastern Pennsylvania — and includes academic, community, and regional facilities.

  
  

**Cancer Center Partnership**
-----------------------------

Clinical care is delivered in partnership with the Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center, which the National Cancer Institute designated a Comprehensive Cancer Center in April 2024. The Cancer Center's NCI-defined catchment area comprises seven contiguous counties — Philadelphia, Montgomery, Delaware, and Chester in Pennsylvania, and Burlington, Camden, and Gloucester in New Jersey — a population of approximately 6.1 million.

The operational scope of this position extends beyond that formally defined catchment area to the full Jefferson Health radiation oncology network. Reconciling the two — extending comprehensive cancer center standards, multidisciplinary care models, and clinical trial access across a footprint larger than the catchment area itself — is among the defining opportunities of the role.

  
  

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================

Salary and academic rank are commensurate with experience, qualifications, and accomplishments. The position carries an administrative stipend and administrative time. Jefferson offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement contributions, malpractice coverage, continuing medical education support, and tuition benefits.

**Work Shift**

Workday Day (United States of America)

**Worker Sub Type**

Regular

**Employee Entity**

Jefferson University Physicians

**Primary Location Address**

111 S 11th Street, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Nationally ranked, Jefferson, which is principally located in the greater Philadelphia region, Lehigh Valley and Northeastern Pennsylvania and southern New Jersey, is reimagining health care and higher education to create unparalleled value. Jefferson is more than 65,000 people strong, dedicated to providing the highest-quality, compassionate clinical care for patients; making our communities healthier and stronger; preparing tomorrow's professional leaders for 21st-century careers; and creating new knowledge through basic/programmatic, clinical and applied research. Thomas Jefferson University , home of Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson College of Nursing, and the Kanbar College of Design, Engineering and Commerce, dates back to 1824 and today comprises 10 colleges and three schools offering 200+ undergraduate and graduate programs to more than 8,300 students. Jefferson Health , nationally ranked as one of the top 15 not-for-profit health care systems in the country and the largest provider in the Philadelphia and Lehigh Valley areas, serves patients through millions of encounters each year at 32 hospitals campuses and more than 700 outpatient and urgent care locations throughout the region. Jefferson Health Plans is a not-for-profit managed health care organization providing a broad range of health coverage options in Pennsylvania and New Jersey for more than 35 years.

Jefferson is committed to providing equal educational and employment opportunities for all persons without regard to age, race, color, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military status, veteran status, handicap or disability or any other protected group or status.

**Benefits**

Jefferson offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time colleagues, including medical (including prescription), supplemental insurance, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, retirement plans, tuition assistance, as well as voluntary benefits, which provide colleagues with access to group rates on insurance and discounts. Colleagues have access to tuition discounts at Thomas Jefferson University after one year of full time service or two years of part time service. All colleagues, including those who work less than part-time (including per diem colleagues, adjunct faculty, and Jeff Temps ), have access to medical (including prescription) insurance.

Washington, DC (hybrid, 3 days in office, preferred) or East or Central Remote

Full-time, exempt

Reports to: VP of Operations

**About Us:**

Zest Health is redefining care for the 40M+ Americans with chronic dermatologic conditions like eczema and psoriasis. Through our virtual dermatology clinic, Zest is making care more accessible, effective, and affordable. Join our well-resourced, passionate team as we set the new gold standard for value-based specialty care.

**Job Summary**

Zest Health is building the category leader in value-based dermatology, and we're hiring the person who builds the pipeline to do it.

Every new partner launch and market expansion depends on having the right people ready before go-live. As our Talent and People Operations Manager, you'll build the talent pipeline that enables continual business growth and ensures we launch on time, then run and scale the people operations that make every new hire successful: onboarding, systems, and the policies and processes a growing company needs. You'll work directly with the leadership team and shape the roadmap with us. As Zest scales, so does your scope, and we expect the person in this role to grow into a People leader.

This is for a talent acquisition professional who wants more than a recruiting seat: someone who builds before the need exists, wants to learn the operating side of a company, and is looking to grow into a People leader at a fast-paced business.

### **Scope of Work**

#### **Talent pipeline (roughly half your time)**

* Build and maintain proactive pipelines of patient-facing personnel (licensed clinicians, care coordinators, and enrollment specialists)
* Recruit for a diverse set of business roles across marketing, product, and more, including sourcing, screening, scheduling, reference checks, and offers
* Work with leadership to craft a long-term talent strategy based on brand investments and creative pipeline strategies
* Work with Operations, Growth, and Clinical leadership to turn new partner launches into hiring plans, lead times, and pipeline targets
* Manage our ATS, and report on pipeline health, time to fill, and pipeline coverage by state

#### **People operations (roughly half your time)**

* Run onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors, including pre-employment checks, new hire paperwork, system access coordination, and exit steps
* Serve as day-to-day contact for our PEO on new hires, changes, and terminations
* Prepare employment verification letters and other HR correspondence
* Partner with counsel on HR compliance questions, as needed
* Improve and build the processes that help us scale people operations as the company grows

#### **Required Qualifications**

* About 5 years of recruiting experience in healthcare, including direct experience sourcing and closing licensed clinicians (telehealth, provider group, or staffing/locum experience a plus)
* Experience building a pipeline ahead of need, not only filling open requisitions
* Exposure to HR operations (onboarding, offboarding, HRIS), formal or informal
* Ability to plan against a forecast and communicate lead times to leadership
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, service-oriented approach
* Comfort in an early-stage environment with a lot of ownership and evolving structure
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Zest Health is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

We care more about what you've built than a perfect resume match. If you've recruited hard-to-fill, credentialed, or contingent talent, learn fast, and build before the need exists, we want to hear from you even if you don't check every box.

d1793afb57125195b0e7.description:
**Travel Consultant (Remote)**

  

Position summary

The Travel Coordinator administers travel and mobility planning for a traveling workforce supporting data center launches and installations. Working from a home office under general direction, the Travel Coordinator evaluates deployment requirements, develops travel plans, manages travel budgets and supplier performance, and advises deployment leaders on options that balance cost, employee needs, travel policy, and operational readiness.

The proposed role includes independent evaluation of travel alternatives, recommendations on supplier arrangements and operating practices, and decisions within approved budgets and delegated authority. The Travel Coordinator is accountable for the effectiveness of travel support across assigned deployments and coordinates booking execution directly or through approved travel management partners. Deployments may be requested with as little as 48 hours’ notice.

Essential duties and responsibilities

* Develop travel and mobility plans for assigned deployments, assessing workforce volume, destinations, reporting dates, shift schedules, assignment duration, lodging capacity, transportation needs, and total projected cost.

* Evaluate alternative deployment travel arrangements and recommend options to Operations based on cost, service reliability, traveler needs, and the effect on launch readiness. Identify constraints early and advise leaders on feasible alternatives.

* Develop and maintain deployment travel forecasts and budgets by site and cost center. Analyze spending and variances, recommend corrective actions, and obtain approval for commitments or exceptions outside delegated authority.

* Evaluate travel providers and lodging and transportation options. Negotiate proposed rates, room blocks, cancellation terms, billing arrangements, and service commitments with Procurement; make supplier recommendations and secure required approvals before commitments.

* Determine responses to travel disruptions within approved policy and spending authority, comparing rerouting, hotel extensions, alternate ground transportation, early returns, and redeployment options. Escalate safety concerns, policy exceptions, and expenditures beyond authority.

* Develop and recommend improvements to travel readiness procedures, booking controls, supplier escalation practices, and contingency plans. Implement approved changes and assess their effectiveness across deployments.

* Confirm approved traveler rosters, travel authorizations, cost centers, and reporting requirements. Arrange or oversee air travel, hotels, airport transfers, and recurring hotel-to-site transportation through approved channels.

* Maintain readiness for requests received within 48 hours through current traveler profiles, supplier contacts, available capacity information, escalation contacts, and documented backup coverage
* + Ensure travelers receive complete itineraries, confirmations, reporting instructions, emergency contacts, and assistance procedures. Communicate changes clearly and professionally to employees, leaders, and suppliers.

  + Monitor booking status, arrivals, roster changes, missed connections, and transportation gaps. Coordinate with site leaders and travel partners to resolve issues affecting deployment readiness.

  + Analyze supplier performance, travel spending, cancellations, unused tickets, and service failures.

  + Present findings and recommendations to deployment leadership, Procurement, and Finance.

  + Reconcile travel charges, hotel folios, transportation invoices, refunds, and unused credits with Finance. Resolve discrepancies, recover available credits, and maintain accurate supporting records.

  + Protect confidential traveler and payment information in approved systems. Maintain accurate deployment trackers, supplier records, contingency procedures, and backup handoffs.

  Decision making and accountability

  The Travel Coordinator manages assigned priorities and evaluates competing travel solutions without step-by-step direction. Decisions must remain within approved travel policies, budgets, procurement rules, and documented financial authority. The Travel Coordinator recommends exceptions and changes to operating practices; the appropriate leader retains approval authority for unbudgeted spending, policy exceptions, and contractual commitments outside the Travel Coordinator’s delegation.

  Performance expectations

  Deliver travel readiness within approved deployment deadlines; maintain reliable arrivals and transportation coverage; provide accurate forecasts and timely cost reporting; reduce avoidable fees, billing errors, and lost credits; and recommend improvements supported by service and spending data.

  Travel Coordinator |

  Required qualifications

  + High school diploma or equivalent and at least three years of corporate travel, group travel, workforce mobility, or comparable travel logistics experience; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered.

  + Experience coordinating flights, hotels, and ground transportation for multiple travelers under short deadlines, using corporate travel tools or a travel management company.

  + Ability to evaluate alternatives, analyze travel costs, develop recommendations, and resolve complex travel issues within delegated authority.

  + Proficiency with spreadsheets, traveler rosters, tracking systems, email, and accurate financial records, including changes, cancellations, and ticket credits.

  + Strong organization, professional verbal and written communication, supplier coordination, and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently from a home office and manage competing priorities.

  + Experience supporting workforce deployments involving hundreds of employees.

  + Supporting data center, construction, logistics, or rotating-shift operations.

The employee’s primary work location is a company-approved home office with a suitable workspace, reliable internet connectivity, and the ability to handle confidential conversations and traveler information securely. The employee must use approved equipment, systems, and access controls and comply with company remote work, information security, equipment, and expense policies.

  The employee must be available during an agreed work schedule aligned with supported deployment locations and time zones. Business needs may require evening, weekend, holiday, or after-hours coverage for urgent travel disruptions and short-notice deployments. Management will establish coverage rotations, response expectations, backup arrangements, and applicable pay practices before assignment. Continuous traveler support will be provided through an approved coverage plan; uninterrupted personal availability is not expected.

  Occasional travel to deployment sites, company locations, or supplier meetings may be required. Site visits may involve walking through operational areas and following applicable safety and personal protective equipment requirements.

  Physical demands and reasonable accommodation

  Work primarily involves computer and telephone use, reviewing detailed travel and financial information, and communicating with employees and suppliers for extended periods. Essential functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation. DP World provides equal employment opportunity without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. Contact Human Resources to request accommodation during the application process or employment.

  Travel

**About the Role**
------------------

**Position Summary**
====================

Coordinate travel for employees deploying to, returning from, and transferring between data center projects across the United States. Arrange flights, lodging, ground transportation, and itinerary changes in alignment with staffing plans, company travel policy, and project schedules. Provide timely, professional communication and scheduled on-call assistance for delays, cancellations, emergencies, and last-minute deployment changes. This role supports a highly mobile workforce; personal travel requirements and primary work location will be confirmed for the assignment.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
=========================================

* Coordinate all assigned deployment and return travel, including flights, lodging, rental vehicles, other ground transportation, and approved itinerary changes.
* Partner with Operations and HR to maintain accurate traveler lists, destinations, project dates, and deployment priorities; reconcile changes before booking.
* Arrange group bookings and extended-stay accommodations, considering availability, cost, cancellation terms, safety, and approved traveler needs.
* Respond to last-minute travel requests and changes, communicate options, and obtain approvals within company policy and delegated authority.

* Coordinate rebooking and alternate arrangements; escalate emergencies, employee welfare concerns, and costs beyond assigned authority through designated channels.
* Work with travel agencies, airlines, hotels, and transportation providers to resolve reservation problems and manage approved vendor relationships.
* Track travel spending, credits, refunds, cancellations, and outstanding reservations; reconcile invoices and booking records with Finance or the travel team.
* Support expense documentation and explain approved reimbursement procedures; refer payroll, taxable allowance, and policy exceptions to authorized specialists.
* Coordinate approved accessibility and accommodation arrangements with employees and HR while limiting collection and sharing of sensitive information.
* Maintain accurate travel records and protect employee and payment information using approved systems and access controls.
* Provide deployment readiness and travel issue updates to leadership, maintain coverage handoffs, and recommend improvements to booking and support processes.
* Record all hours worked, including after-hours calls, messages, booking activity, required training, and compensable travel; follow applicable timekeeping and break requirements.

Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.As part of our comprehensive benefits package, DP World offers a broad range of Health, Life, Voluntary Lifestyle and other benefits and perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing.

  

**About DP World**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities, spanning 77 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

The incumbent is responsible for the daily execution and management of all daily activities as well as providing assigned work specialists. The Team Lead will work with internal and external team members to meet daily program Key Program Initiatives (KPI’s) in a timely and efficient manner.

**Job Scope and Major Responsibilities:**

  

* Effectively perform in a high-volume call center hub requiring a blend of soft skills (patience, empathy/compassion, active listening, problem solving) and technical/process skills (mastery of tools, knowledge base, adherence to SOPs, efficient multitasking, problem-solving) to handle numerous calls quickly and accurately, use available resources like knowledge bases, and maintain quality through focused communication and efficient workflow, ensuring quick resolutions while balancing speed with customer satisfaction.

* Managing Exception Reporting.
* Effectively manage the team to accomplish daily tasks. Direct workflow and assignments as needed
* Answers team member questions, help with team member problems, and oversees team member work for quality and guideline compliance
* Develop contacts within each member pharmacy in order to maintain most current status on referrals for all programs.
* Maintain tracking document and crosscheck to ensure platform/tracking document accuracy.
* Provide weekly/monthly updates to manufacturer regarding referral status as required.
* Monitor quality and performance of the team and demonstrate the ability to provide feedback in an effective manner that drives change in behavior and results
* Receive and effectively route program “referrals” (prescriptions)
* Interface with programmers as needed to address any system difficulties
* Communicate with internal contacts, manufacturers, insurance companies, pharmacies and patients to achieve program goals.

* Hold engaging one on ones with team members.
* Effectively train or re-train team members. Identify training needs and provide coaching.

* Manage attendance and tardiness.
* Monitor phone systems and queues to ensure all phone lines are covered throughout the day.

* Alert site leadership to any potential staff matters, including performance or behavioral issues.
* Establish effective rapport with other employees, clients, physicians, pharmacies and clients.
* Adheres at all times to physical, administrative and technical safeguards related to core business when executing job functions.
* Attendance and schedule adherence is critical.
* Adhering to company policies and procedures.
* Possess a professional demeanor, focused on respectful communication, a positive and reliable attitude, and responsible behavior. This includes dressing appropriately, being punctual, maintaining composure, and demonstrating accountability for your actions.
* Working outside of core business hours may be required.
* Some travel may be required.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Compliance with the provisions of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 and its implementing regulations, as amended (“HIPAA”).

**Performance Criteria:**

Success is defined by accurate and timely routing of referrals and reporting as well high levels of customer service. A high level of employee engagement is critical. Empathetic servant leadership is expected of the Program Manager Team Lead.

**Required Minimum Qualifications:**

**New Jersey Office ONLY:**

* Must be registered with the State of New Jersey Board of Pharmacy as a Pharmacy Technician.
* Must successfully complete the ASPN Pharmacies New Jersey Policies and Procedures: Assessment.

**Nevada Office ONLY:**

* Must have Nevada Pharmacy Technician License. Technician Trainee License, issued by the Nevada State Board of Pharmacy is permitted only for internal candidates striving to obtain their Nevada Pharmacy Technician license.

* Pharmacy Technician License (requires national certification by PTCB or ExCPT), or Technician Trainee License, issued by the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy.

**Pennsylvania Office ONLY:**

* Must have Pennsylvania Pharmacy Technician License.

**Remote Workers:**

* Must be registered as a Pharmacy Technician with both their home state Board of Pharmacy and the Board of Pharmacy in the state where their assigned office is located.

**ALL LOCATIONS:**

* High school diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, nursing, or a related scientific field preferred.
* Three to eight or more years of pharmacy, patient support center, call center HUB, or customer service experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of pharmacy operations, standard operating procedures, data integrity requirements, quality control/quality assurance practices, and related knowledge tools.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and other business systems required for daily operations.
* Previous supervisory, lead, or management experience preferred.
* Ability to motivate, train, mentor, and coach team members; foster teamwork; set goals; and support conflict resolution.
* Knowledge of ASPN network capabilities preferred.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to communicate effectively with patients, prescribers, pharmacies, payers, internal teams, and pharmaceutical manufacturer partners.
* General knowledge of pharmacy laws, practices, procedures, insurance processes, and third-party billing systems.
* Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities, manage multiple tasks, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and safeguard protected health information (PHI).
* Ability to support daily operations, allocate tasks, monitor performance, and resolve complex patient access barriers in a timely manner.
* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, HIPAA, medical terminology, and adverse event reporting procedures required.
* Ability to travel as required.
* Must maintain a professional demeanor and courteous attitude when interacting with individuals at all levels.
* Reliable and consistent attendance and schedule adherence are required.

b2effd5c8e6e3000cfba.title: Talent Operations Specialist (Talent Acquisition)
b2effd5c8e6e3000cfba.description:
#### **Description**

At Rankings.io, the candidate experience doesn't end when someone signs an offer. We're looking for a **Talent Operations Specialist** who can turn that "yes" into an exceptional new-hire experience, one that is organized, intentional, and consistent from offer acceptance through an employee's first several months with the company.

As a fast-growing, fully remote digital marketing agency serving law firms, we need someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about creating a white-glove experience for every new hire. You'll play a critical role in ensuring a seamless transition from candidate to employee, coordinating across teams, anticipating needs, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**While this role offers a clear growth path into full-cycle Talent Acquisition,** the initial focus will be owning our white-glove onboarding experience, employee engagement initiatives, and Talent Operations processes. As you demonstrate success, you'll progressively develop your recruiting skills, expanding into candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and eventually full-cycle recruitment.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition, takes pride in delivering an exceptional people experience, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where excellence and accountability matter.

##### **Your Mission: Create an Exceptional New-Hire Experience**

You’ll own the onboarding experience from signed offers through Day 90 and help support employees beyond onboarding through structured check-ins, surveys, and stay interviews. You’ll partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR, IT, and hiring managers to ensure every new hire has the tools, training plan, communication, and support they need to hit the ground running.

**This is more than checking boxes.** You’ll own and continuously improve a process that includes dozens of moving pieces for every hire while helping us create an onboarding experience that supports engagement, retention, and long-term success.

#### **Responsibilities**

**Onboarding & New-Hire Experience**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle from signed offer through Day 90, coordinating approximately 30–50+ tasks per new hire to ensure a seamless, white-glove experience.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop, implement, and track structured 30/60/90-day training plans in ClickUp.
* Lead new-hire check-ins at 1 week, 30 days, 60 days, and 90 days, proactively identifying concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
* Coordinate 6-month employee surveys and conduct quarterly stay interviews, sharing actionable feedback and trends with HR and department leaders.
* Collaborate with IT, HR, Talent Acquisition, and hiring managers to ensure systems access, onboarding documentation, and employee information are completed accurately and on time.
* Partner with the Experience Coordinator to coordinate new-hire swag and personalized onboarding touchpoints.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires, providing responsive communication, guidance, and support throughout their onboarding journey.

**Talent Operations & Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate onboarding records, workflows, and documentation across Rippling, ClickUp, Notion, and other internal systems.
* Proactively identify onboarding gaps, streamline workflows, and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, consistency, and the employee experience.
* Track onboarding milestones, completion rates, and employee feedback to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

**Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Support**

* Support recruiting operations and hiring initiatives, including candidate communication, interview coordination, and applicant tracking.
* Assist with proactive candidate sourcing, outreach, and pipeline development during high-volume hiring periods.
* Progressively develop recruiting skills through resume screening, candidate sourcing, interviewing, and other hiring activities, with the goal of growing into a full-cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist.

#### **Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in onboarding, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, recruiting coordination, or People Operations.
* Experience managing multiple employees or candidates through different stages of a structured process simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage 15–20 new hires at different stages of onboarding without losing sight of the details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create a welcoming, white-glove employee experience.
* Comfortable taking ownership of a process from beginning to end rather than simply executing an existing checklist.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where priorities and hiring volume can shift quickly.
* Genuine interest in employee engagement, retention, and building an onboarding experience that sets people up for long-term success.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with an ATS, HRIS, or similar people systems; experience with Teamtailor or Rippling is a plus.
* Familiarity with project management and documentation tools such as ClickUp.
* Mountain Time (MST) candidates are strongly preferred to provide coverage later in the business day, as many hiring decisions and onboarding needs arise toward the end of the Central Time workday.

#### **Benefits**

* Starting salary: $60,000
* Recruiting commission opportunities in addition to base salary
* Fully Remote
* Unlimited PTO
* $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program
* Quarterly professional development stipend
* 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)
* 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

#### **What to Expect in the Interview Process**

* **Resume Review**: The Talent Acquisition Manager will review applications and resumes to identity candidates whose experience aligns with the role.
* **One-Way Interview:** Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.
* **Live Zoom Interview:** Candidates who advance will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and HR Generalist to discuss their experience, organizational skills, approach to employee experience, and role expectations.
* **Final Live Zoom Interview:** Finalists will meet with the Talent Acquisition Manager and VP of Human Resources to discuss career goals, team alignment, and long-term growth opportunities.

8dd20a4a9f1b7b7b4ea7.title: Customer Success Manager
8dd20a4a9f1b7b7b4ea7.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

As the **Customer Success Manager**, you’ll play a key role in creating an exceptional customer experience. You’ll guide both new and returning clients through every step of their journey—offering proactive, personalized support that anticipates needs, solves challenges, and drives long-term engagement. Your commitment will shine through not only in your customer partnerships, but also in your contributions to team initiatives and cross-functional projects.

As part of a growing Customer Success team, you will contribute to the continued development and improvement of customer service messaging, processes, and systems across our products and services. You will also execute post-sales activities for an assigned portfolio of customers through strong and effective relationship-building, product knowledge, planning, and execution. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact on customers and are ready to contribute to the continued growth of our Customer Success function and the future of our products and services, we’d love to meet you.

Responsibilities include:

**Create Strong Customer Partnerships**

* Lead onboarding experiences for assigned customers.
* Implement and maintain a customized engagement plan for each customer — covering deployment, regular TEACH usage, and integration into instructional routines — to support high retention, position partners for long-term success, and inform future renewal conversations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with an assigned portfolio of customers, ensuring “moderate” to “strong” health scores through proactive, personalized engagement.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and speak with customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific needs.
* Function as the customer advocate and provide internal feedback on how we can better serve our teachers and leaders.

**Deliver Customer Support**

* Use the Intercom customer service system to manage and respond to Tier 1 support requests for professional development services and subscription inquiries.
* Route and escalate Tier 2 and 3 requests, content questions, and other requests to the appropriate contact, tracking all inquiries to ensure timely resolution.
* In collaboration with the Marketing, Product, and Program teams, craft and send outreach communications to customers to support their successful use of products.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of FAQ and Help documents based on customer needs across all services and products offered by the organization.

**Community Management**

* Manage and monitor the TEACH community, responding to questions directly or routing them to the appropriate person.
* Implement engagement plans and contribute to the development of strategies to foster community participation.

**Track and Analyze Data**

* Work closely with the Product, Program, Operations, and Research teams to understand and collect data about our customers.
* Track, analyze, and act on customer signals to support successful implementation and identify opportunities to intervene early when customers are not progressing as expected.
* Collect and share relevant customer data and insights with service leaders to support their portfolios of partners.

**Contribution to PBLWorks’ Mission, Vision, and Racial Equity Imperative**

* Work with other PBLWorks team members to further our mission, vision, racial equity imperative, and strategic plan.
* As a collaborative team player, support PBLWorks colleagues and contribute to the full breadth of the organization’s work and culture.
* Engage in ongoing individual and collective learning about how to advance racial equity through Project Based Learning for all students, especially Black and Brown students.

Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements, Skills and Abilities**
======================================

This role must believe in PBLWorks’ core values, be driven by our mission and vision, and share our commitment to advancing racial equity.

Specific requirements include:

* Two or more years in a customer-facing role such as customer success, account management, or EdTech implementation in an education-focused tech/SaaS company.
* Prior experience as a K-12 classroom teacher, instructional coach, and/or instructional leader is preferred. You understand what educators care about, how schools function, and how to change hearts, minds, and habits.
* Demonstrated passion for providing top-notch customer service and a knack for creative and resourceful problem-solving.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail and account management. Operationally and efficiency-minded, using tools, data, and systems to work smarter and scale your impact.
* Quick learner who picks up new technology easily and can train others on the use of tools/platforms.
* Ability to move quickly, make sound decisions under time constraints, incorporating feedback and consistent learning to drive progress.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of people and communities, including communities of color.
* Ability to adapt to the needs of the organization and employees.
* Comfortable working effectively in virtual environments.

***The successful candidate will also bring the following skills and abilities:***

* Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, sound business judgment, and the business acumen to make good decisions under uncertainty.
* Results-oriented, with a proven track record of exceeding goals, strong project management skills, and resourcefulness in setting priorities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; a great listener with excellent interpersonal skills, the ability build trust quickly, and a commitment to transparency and open communication.
* Extraordinary organizational skills, with strong attention to accuracy, accountability, and the ability to manage time and meet deadlines.
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, diverse environment as a team player who works effectively with peers and colleagues.
* Impeccable integrity, a positive attitude, and strong self-direction.
* Passionate about addressing equity in education.
* Action-oriented and proactive, energized by challenges and willing to take smart risks.

**Reporting Relationships**
===========================

The Customer Success Manager works closely with sales, operations, product development, and curriculum colleagues and reports directly to the Senior Customer Success Manager.

**Location**
============

This position is remote and may be based anywhere within the U.S., with a preference for someone who can work 9 am - 5 pm PST. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings and events (~1-2 times per year).

**Compensation & Benefits**
===========================

* This full-time, exempt role offers full health benefits (including medical, dental, and vision), a 403b, and life and disability insurance. PBLWorks offers competitive pay (commensurate with experience) and a generous benefits package.
* The target salary range for this position is listed below and is commensurate with experience.
* The base pay range for this position varies by geographic location of the successful candidate. PBLWorks is committed to internal pay equity and therefore does not negotiate outside of these stated ranges:
  + Zone A (SF Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles): $102,000 - $108,000
  + Zone B (Boston, Seattle, Denver, Chicago): $91,800 - $97,200
  + Zone C (Dallas, Atlanta, Austin, Hawaii): $86,700 - $91,800
  + Zone D (Rest of U.S.): $81,600 - $86,400
  + Your zone is based on where you live, including for remote roles. Within each range, your offer will reflect your skills, experience, and internal pay equity.
  + Don’t see your city/ area listed? Our HR team will confirm your “zone” if you successfully complete a phone screen interview.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
================================

As a mission-driven education organization, we celebrate and embrace diversity. We actively seek a diverse pool of candidates in every hiring process. PBLWorks is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, veteran status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability (in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act).

Buck Institute for Education (dba PBLWorks) participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. We will only use E-Verify once a newly hired employee has accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

**Application**
===============

Apply on our website with your resume and a one-page cover letter outlining your unique qualifications for this role.

cfbf9b273dc3b127a2ff.title: Loan Analyst
cfbf9b273dc3b127a2ff.description:
**Kiavi is one of the nation's largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.**

Formerly known as LendingHome, we're committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

* **Loans Funded:** $30 billion in loans funded
* **Homes financed:** 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country
* **Geography:** 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods
* **Employees:** Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks

**This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.**

**Identity Verification Notice:**To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

**The Role**

With innovation, simple & scalable efforts, and customer service at our core, the Loan Analyst team at Kiavi works cross-functionally with other departments to change the landscape of the mortgage industry. The team is responsible for using their critical thinking skills to work through customer challenges, and their collective effort is integral in shaping a positive loan experience for all stakeholders. The team works together to find a way to win and adapts to new changes quickly. We're a fast-growing company and are looking for people who have a desire to grow, learn, and accelerate their careers. As an integral part of the Operations team, you will process the loan and get it ready for an underwriting decision, working with third parties, borrowers, and mortgage brokers to create a smooth and simple process for getting a loan. Your primary focus will be on delivering exceptional customer service, addressing client concerns, and guiding them through the mortgage process with professionalism and expertise.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze loan applications, collect essential documents, and obtain third-party reports.
* Reach out to customers and third parties via phone, email, & text to obtain documents or essential information, provide proactive status updates, and answer customers' questions relating to required documents within the expected timeframe.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the processing and underwriting stages, providing personalized assistance and support.
* Reviewing and analyzing documents against our credit policy, with the goal of getting the loan ready for an underwriting decision.
* Meet and exceed your daily and monthly quotas for new application reviews while upholding our high standards for quality.
* Identify potential roadblocks or credit policy alignment issues and work with sales and other operations teams to determine the best approach.
* Work closely with your cross-functional team to meet and exceed weekly and monthly processing and funding goals.
* Contribute to cross-functional projects or assigned initiatives as needed. Examples may include testing new systems, procedures, or credit policies, functioning as a power user, training or mentoring new hires, data and reporting, etc.
* Attend and regularly give feedback in team meetings.

**Qualifications**

* Preferred Associate's or Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business or a departmentally related field.
* 1-2 years of successful professional experience as a Loan Analyst/Processor and/or 2-3 years of successful professional experience within the mortgage lending industry.
* You have a track record as a self-starter with a strong desire to learn and grow your capacity.
* You have strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Word & Excel/Google Suite.
* You have the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* You look for ways to apply technology to help solve business problems.
* You have outstanding verbal and written skills that will enable you to provide an excellent customer experience with borrowers and business partners.
* You are open to giving and receiving feedback, comfortable speaking up and asking questions, and able to follow a proven process.
* You are flexible and can work in a dynamic environment of rapid change

Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $52,500 to $65,000 base + $6,500 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries. Within the range, the successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits.

**Benefits and Perks**

* **Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.
* **Health Savings Account (HSA):** For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.
* **Disability and Life Insurance:** Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.
* **Remote Work Policy:** Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.
* **Flexible Time Off:** Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.
* **Paid Leaves:** Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.
* **401(k) & Company Match:** A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

**Protect yourself from recruitment scams:**

* If you are offered an interview or a role with Kiavi, this will be communicated with you through email, via an official email address ending in @kiavi.com or @lendinghome.com.
* You will never be asked for payments of any kind during the process.
* We also never communicate with candidates via Whatsapp at any point during the recruitment process.
* We won't ask for personal information or data via text message. If you have any concerns regarding how genuine a text message is, please contact your recruiter.
* You can find our official Kiavi careers page here. We advise you to check that the page details and website addresses match if you have any concerns.

**What will you be doing?**

The Senior Training Specialist is responsible for delivering high-impact training experiences that support the strategic goals of the Transformation & Enablement Network (TEN) for Sales Operations. This role focuses on facilitating live and virtual training sessions, managing Learning Management Systems (LMS) workflows, and supporting learners through onboarding and continuous development. This position works with subject matter experts to understand needs and identify appropriate training method options. The Senior Training Specialist will independently support the creation of classroom and blended curriculums in a high-volume training department. The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator with strong communication skills and a passion for helping others grow through structured learning programs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Creates instructor-led training based on learner needs and business owner objectives
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to ensure training content is accurate and aligned with business needs.
* Facilitate live and virtual training sessions for onboarding, role-based enablement, and technical fluency.

* Maintains current knowledge of LMS (Amplify) through each release.

The VITAS Healthcare Admissions Coordinator is a customer service professional who facilitates the conversion of referrals to admissions through the completion of the intake process and the use of effective communication, technology and customer service skills. An Admissions Coordinator interacts with patients and families, referral sources and program staff to enable the start of care for VITAS patients.

* Process new referrals that arrive by telephone, email, fax and website inquiries, in the manner best fitting the needs of the referral source.
