af01176ad1a6511d7168.description:
**About us**

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with American Recovery Services.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

**Short Description**  
The Patient Service Representative will be a resource to the department, patients, families, and health care team members within the scope of their role.

They will support the administrative and scheduling needs of the Innovative Delivery Programs including Population Health at Home, Remote Patient Monitoring, Complex and Transitional Care, and other population health programs/initiatives as needed.

1. Answers and fields phone calls and voice mail messages, monitors assigned front desk pools, documents events in patients digital health record, and escalates as appropriate.  
2. Faxes, scans PHI into their digital health record, and sorts mail.  
3. Schedules and confirms patient appointments and performs check-in, check-out.  
4. Prepares patient charts and information prior to scheduled appointment.  
5. Facilitates activation of patient’s MyChart account if not active  
6. Supports patient screening for digital remote patient monitoring (RPM) program eligibility (i.e. social, digital capabilities) and facilitates digital RPM program enrollment  
7. Orders/ships digital remote monitoring devices and confirms patient receipt.  
8. Anticipates problems or issues and solves within the scope of responsibility.  
9. Reviews digital RPM patient agreement and ensures signed.  
10. Collaborates with patients, care givers, providers, and other health care team members.  
11. Maintains privacy and confidentiality for all patients.  
12. Regularly attends in-services to further develop position and department.  
13. Performs all related duties or special projects as assigned/required.

The above are guidelines for the position but are not necessarily a delineation of all the actions/duties necessary to the job.

**Experience Required**

* Minimum one year of recent registration or billing experience working in a medical facility preferred.
* Proficiency in patient registration, scheduling, medical insurance pre-certifications, authorizations and referrals preferred.
* Epic experience preferred.
* Excellent organizational, written/verbal communication and teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated performance of excellent customer service skills.

**Education Requirements**  
High School Diploma or equivalent required.

**Special Requirements**

* Customer service oriented attitude/behavior as well as a pleasant and poised demeanor and excellent phone etiquette.
* Must possess excellent communication skills both verbal and written. Must be skilled in the use of computers.
* NAHAM Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) certification preferred.

5af6c3bcd712a4c27be7.title: Fleet Parts Sales Manager
5af6c3bcd712a4c27be7.description:
At Hunter Truck, our people are the driving force behind our success. As one of the largest Peterbilt dealer groups in the country, we combine the resources and opportunities of a growing organization with a culture where people are empowered to make an impact. With twenty-eight locations across Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, and West Virginia, we offer the scale, support, and career opportunities to help you take your career to the next level.

Come build your career with a team that invests in you from day one.

**POSITION AT A GLANCE**

**Status:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm  
**Location:** Southern Region

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Pay**: $95,000 to $125,000 per year

**Reports to:** Senior Vice President of Parts

**SUMMARY**

The Fleet Parts Sales Manager will be responsible for driving growth in parts and service sales among National Fleet Accounts and targeted large fleet customers. This role will collaborate closely with Regional Parts Directors, Regional Service Directors, Parts Outside Sales Representatives, and PACCAR Parts Fleet Sales Managers to strengthen customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, and maximize fleet account growth. Additionally, the Fleet Parts Sales Manager will serve as a key resource for Regional Vice Presidents, Parts Managers, Service Managers, Product Support Representatives, and fleet customers by providing guidance and support on fleet programs, benefits, and program requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Develop and grow parts and service sales with existing fleets assigned to Parts Outside Sales Representatives through regular communication and joint customer visits.
* Work closely with the PACCAR Parts Fleet Services team to develop and execute fleet pricing strategies utilizing market basket pricing, volume rebates, and other fleet programs.
* Conduct new and prospective fleet account sales calls on a regular basis.
* Develop annual fleet account growth strategies and business plans.
* Maintain strong relationships with key contacts at existing and targeted fleet customers while supporting assigned Product Support Representatives responsible for day-to-day account servicing.
* Analyze and monitor dealership parts and service sales to fleet accounts and provide periodic reporting to dealer management.
* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new sales opportunities with existing and prospective fleet customers.
* Develop and strengthen relationships with out-of-network and in-transit fleets to drive additional service and parts business into branches.
* Collaborate with Service Support personnel to develop, negotiate, and implement service agreements and customized pricing structures for fleet customers.
* Assist in resolving escalated customer concerns, service issues, and operational challenges impacting fleet relationships.
* Track account performance, sales activity, fleet program participation, and growth opportunities using available reporting tools and systems.
* Coordinate with dealership leadership to ensure consistent execution of fleet programs, customer commitments, and service expectations.
* Provide training and support to fleet customers and dealership personnel regarding fleet programs, products, services, and account management best practices.
* Deliver superior customer service to all assigned and prospective accounts.
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry trends, competitive activity, and customer needs within the transportation and fleet marketplace.
* Adhere to and promote all company health, safety, and environmental policies and procedures.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Strategic account management and business development skills.
* Excellent customer relationship and sales skills.
* Strong negotiation and influencing abilities.
* Ability to effectively communicate with fleet ownership, senior leadership, and operational stakeholders.
* Superior customer service and problem-solving skills.
* Strong presentation, training, and facilitation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.
* Ability to analyze account performance, profitability, and growth opportunities.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Proven ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and customer relationship management (CRM) tools.
* Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, and sound business judgment.
* Ability to travel extensively and maintain schedule flexibility as required.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Travel is required up to 50% of the time and may include a combination of local and overnight travel. The position requires regular travel to fleet customer locations, Hunter

Truck dealerships, industry events, and business meetings. Overnight travel will be necessary based on customer needs, geographic territory, and business requirements.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE**  
High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required

Post-secondary degree in a related field preferred

Three years of industry experience, including two years of heavy-duty truck or parts sales experience, with a thorough understanding of heavy-duty trucks, truck dealers, suppliers and fleets preferred.

Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

Ability to calculate discounts, pricing structures, rebates, margins, commissions, percentages, and sales performance metrics.

Ability to analyze account profitability, market opportunities, and business trends using basic mathematical and financial concepts.

Ability to interpret sales reports, pricing models, and operational performance data.

**REASONING ABILITY**

Ability to analyze customer needs and identify appropriate business solutions.

Ability to evaluate sales opportunities, assess business risks, and make sound decisions with limited information.

Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on customer service and business objectives.

Ability to interpret and apply written, oral, operational, and technical instructions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**

Valid driver's license required and must meet company insurability standards.

Ability to travel by vehicle and air as business needs dictate.

Valid passport preferred based upon business travel requirements.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

* Prolonged periods of sitting while driving, working at a desk, and performing computer and telephone-related tasks.
* Frequent use of computers, mobile devices, and other office equipment.
* Occasional walking through dealership facilities, customer locations, warehouses, and service environments.
* Regular travel by vehicle and occasional air travel.
* Periodic work at dealership locations, customer facilities, and remote work environments.
* Occasional work in parts warehouses, shipping and receiving areas, service departments, and at parts counters.
* Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee regularly works in office settings, dealership facilities, and customer locations. The employee may occasionally be exposed to moving mechanical parts, vehicle traffic, fumes, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and moderate noise levels while visiting service departments, warehouses, and customer facilities.

Hunter Truck is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all employees.

Serves as the initial point of contact for patients and healthcare providers within the practice. Delivers the high standard of customer service necessary to maintain the overall patient experience.  
  
**Job Duties**

* Gathers information necessary for accurate registration and check-in to fulfill service promise.
* Obtains and verifies insurance authorizations/precertification and completes medical record release requests and schedules/confirms patient appointments.

* 1 year Customer service experience
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to maintain accuracy and compliance with detailed-oriented responsibilities.
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
* Proficient computer skills.
* Proven proficiency of technology and EMR workflows at the conclusion of orientation.
* Able to handle cash and other methods of patients accurately.
* Able to explain, educate, and support the usage of the LVHN patient portal including various features.

**About us**

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with American Recovery Services.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.

**Short Description**  
The Patient Service Representative will be a resource to the department, patients, families, and health care team members within the scope of their role.

They will support the administrative and scheduling needs of the Innovative Delivery Programs including Population Health at Home, Remote Patient Monitoring, Complex and Transitional Care, and other population health programs/initiatives as needed.

1. Answers and fields phone calls and voice mail messages, monitors assigned front desk pools, documents events in patients digital health record, and escalates as appropriate.  
2. Faxes, scans PHI into their digital health record, and sorts mail.  
3. Schedules and confirms patient appointments and performs check-in, check-out.  
4. Prepares patient charts and information prior to scheduled appointment.  
5. Facilitates activation of patient’s MyChart account if not active  
6. Supports patient screening for digital remote patient monitoring (RPM) program eligibility (i.e. social, digital capabilities) and facilitates digital RPM program enrollment  
7. Orders/ships digital remote monitoring devices and confirms patient receipt.  
8. Anticipates problems or issues and solves within the scope of responsibility.  
9. Reviews digital RPM patient agreement and ensures signed.  
10. Collaborates with patients, care givers, providers, and other health care team members.  
11. Maintains privacy and confidentiality for all patients.  
12. Regularly attends in-services to further develop position and department.  
13. Performs all related duties or special projects as assigned/required.

The above are guidelines for the position but are not necessarily a delineation of all the actions/duties necessary to the job.

**Experience Required**

* Minimum one year of recent registration or billing experience working in a medical facility preferred.
* Proficiency in patient registration, scheduling, medical insurance pre-certifications, authorizations and referrals preferred.
* Epic experience preferred.
* Excellent organizational, written/verbal communication and teamwork skills.
* Demonstrated performance of excellent customer service skills.

**Education Requirements**  
High School Diploma or equivalent required.

**Special Requirements**

* Customer service oriented attitude/behavior as well as a pleasant and poised demeanor and excellent phone etiquette.
* Must possess excellent communication skills both verbal and written. Must be skilled in the use of computers.
* NAHAM Certified Healthcare Access Associate (CHAA) certification preferred.

**Lemus Remodeling Group | Warminster, PA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Compensation:** $20.00 - $23.00 per hour  
**Location:** Warminster, PA

### **Build Your Career. Make a Difference. Grow With Us.**

**Are you a people person who enjoys helping others, solving problems, and creating exceptional customer experiences?**

Lemus Remodeling Group is growing, and we're looking for a friendly, organized, and motivated **Customer Service Specialist** to join our team!

We specialize in residential exterior remodeling, including roofing, siding, windows, and other home improvement solutions. Our mission is to provide homeowners with outstanding workmanship, reliable communication, and a remodeling experience they can trust.

We believe exceptional customer service is the foundation of lasting relationships. From the first phone call to the completion of a project, every interaction is an opportunity to make a positive impression.

At Lemus Remodeling Group, we're not just offering a job. We're offering an opportunity to develop your skills, contribute to a growing company, and build a rewarding career.

### **What You'll Do**

As a Customer Service Specialist, you'll play an essential role in creating a positive experience for our customers. You'll be one of the first points of contact for homeowners, helping answer questions, coordinate appointments, and ensure clear communication throughout their remodeling journey.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Deliver Exceptional Customer Service:** Answer incoming calls, emails, and customer inquiries promptly, professionally, and with a positive attitude.
* **Assist Homeowners:** Provide information about our remodeling services, address general questions, and guide customers through the next steps.
* **Coordinate Appointments:** Assist with scheduling consultations, confirming appointments, and communicating updates to customers and internal teams.
* **Manage Customer Communication:** Follow up on inquiries, appointment requests, and outstanding customer needs to ensure timely responses.
* **Maintain Accurate Records:** Document customer interactions, update contact information, and track follow-up activities using our customer relationship management (CRM) system.
* **Support Internal Teams:** Work closely with sales, marketing, and production teams to ensure customer requests are handled efficiently.
* **Resolve Customer Concerns:** Listen carefully, identify solutions, and escalate issues when necessary to ensure customer satisfaction.
* **Create a Positive Experience:** Help maintain strong customer relationships by providing clear information, consistent follow-through, and professional support.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who takes pride in helping others, pays attention to details, and understands the importance of delivering outstanding service.

**Our ideal candidate is:**

* Friendly, professional, and genuinely passionate about helping customers.
* An excellent communicator with strong verbal and written skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks.
* Patient, empathetic, and confident when handling customer questions or concerns.
* Reliable, accountable, and committed to following through on responsibilities.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced office environment.
* Proficient with computers, email, and common office applications.
* Able to learn new software, including CRM and scheduling platforms.
* A team player who collaborates effectively with different departments.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative to improve the customer experience.

**Previous experience in customer service, call centers, appointment scheduling, administrative support, or home improvement is preferred but not required.**

Experience with CRM platforms, particularly ServiceTitan, is a plus.

### **Compensation & Career Opportunities**

We believe great customer service deserves recognition and opportunities for professional growth.

**Hourly Pay: $20.00 - $23.00**

What we offer:

* **Competitive Hourly Compensation:** Reliable hourly pay in a professional office environment.
* **Training & Support:** Hands-on training to help you understand our services, systems, and customer service standards.
* **Career Growth:** Opportunities to develop professionally and take on additional responsibilities as our company expands.
* **Technology & Tools:** Access to customer management and communication systems that help you work efficiently.
* **Collaborative Work Environment:** Work alongside a supportive team committed to providing excellent service.
* **Professional Development:** Strengthen your communication, organization, problem-solving, and customer relationship management skills.

### **Why Join Lemus Remodeling Group?**

**Great Service. Strong Relationships. Real Opportunities.**

At Lemus Remodeling Group, we believe our customers deserve more than quality home improvements. They deserve a company that communicates clearly, follows through on its commitments, and genuinely cares about their experience.

Our Customer Service Specialists are an important part of making that happen.

As our company continues to grow, we're looking for individuals who want to grow with us, take ownership of their responsibilities, and contribute to a culture built on professionalism, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

Whether you're looking to develop your customer service career or bring your experience to a growing home remodeling company, we want to hear from you!

### **Ready to Join Our Team?**

If you're organized, dependable, enjoy working with people, and take pride in delivering excellent customer service, **we'd love to meet you!**

**Apply today and become part of the Lemus Remodeling Group team!**

689f8cb5b5d278114651.title: Customer Experience Representative
689f8cb5b5d278114651.description:
Client Experience Representative

The Client Experience Representative is an important part of the NorthStar VETS team and is often the first and last person a client interacts with during their visit.

This role is responsible for providing a warm, professional, and compassionate experience for clients and their families while supporting the day-to-day operations of a busy 24/7 emergency and specialty veterinary hospital.

Client Experience Representatives work closely with doctors, technicians, Client Liaisons, Client Experience Supervisors, and other hospital teams to help ensure clients receive clear communication, timely service, and a consistent experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, compassionate, and able to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, the ability to prioritize multiple tasks, and a willingness to help wherever needed to support the team and our clients.

All team members are expected to follow NorthStar VETS' CPETS values of Compassion, Professionalism, Excellence, Teamwork, and Service.

Key Responsibilities

**Client Experience & Communication**

* Welcome clients and their families in a warm, professional, and compassionate manner.
* Serve as a positive first point of contact for clients visiting or calling the hospital.
* Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally.
* Listen to client questions and concerns and provide appropriate assistance or connect them with the appropriate team member.
* Provide general information about hospital services, processes, appointments, and next steps.
* Properly route calls, messages, and client inquiries to the appropriate department or team member.
* Communicate with clients who are waiting and provide updates when appropriate.
* Maintain professionalism and empathy during difficult, emotional, or stressful situations.
* Recognize when a concern needs to be escalated and involve a Client Experience Supervisor or Manager when appropriate.
* Support clients with general questions regarding their visit, account, appointments, and hospital processes.

**Patient Check-In & Admissions**

* Check patients in and out of the hospital accurately and efficiently.
* Assist with emergency and specialty admissions.
* Assist clients with completing required paperwork and forms.
* Ensure client and patient information is accurate and up to date in the practice management system.
* Create and prepare charts for emergency and specialty appointments.
* Ensure required documents are properly uploaded to the patient's medical record.
* Communicate with the clinical team regarding patient arrivals, admissions, and other client needs.
* Support euthanasia visits with compassion, professionalism, and attention to detail.

**Scheduling & Appointments**

* Schedule appointments accurately based on hospital and department guidelines.
* Schedule appropriate follow-up appointments before the client leaves when requested.
* Confirm appointment information and ensure clients understand where and when to arrive.
* Assist with appointment changes, cancellations, and general scheduling questions.
* Work with clinical teams when scheduling questions or changes arise.
* Assist with managing appointment flow and identifying potential scheduling concerns.

**Basic Billing & Financial Support**

* Collect deposits, payments, and other client payments accurately.
* Accurately post payments and charges to the appropriate client account.
* Review invoices for basic accuracy before the client leaves.
* Answer basic billing and account questions and direct more complex financial questions to the appropriate team member.
* Assist clients with understanding basic information related to their invoice, payment, or account.
* Follow hospital processes for deposits, payments, refunds, and other financial transactions.
* Notify the appropriate leader when there is a billing concern, discrepancy, or issue that requires additional review.
* Maintain accuracy and confidentiality when handling client financial information.

**Discharges**

* Support the discharge process by ensuring clients have the appropriate paperwork and information.
* Review invoices for basic accuracy and ensure appropriate charges and payments are posted.
* Confirm required discharge documentation is complete.
* Communicate with the clinical team when additional information or clarification is needed.
* Help ensure medications, paperwork, and other discharge items are ready when appropriate.
* Work as part of the team to identify and address discharge issues before the client arrives.
* Provide clients with a professional and welcoming discharge experience.

**Client & Hospital Communication**

* Monitor hospital email and approved client communication platforms.
* Properly route calls, messages, and client requests to the appropriate team member or department.
* Communicate important client information accurately and promptly.
* Monitor hospital census boards and other communication tools.
* Monitor clients who are waiting and communicate with them as appropriate.
* Communicate changes or concerns to Client Experience Supervisors and other appropriate leaders.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling client, patient, and hospital information.

**Front Office Operations**

* Support the smooth daily operation of the front office.
* Assist with front office coverage during periods of high volume or changing hospital needs.
* Maintain an organized, clean, and welcoming reception and waiting area.
* Monitor client waiting areas and check in with clients who may be waiting for extended periods.
* Maintain a clean and organized workstation.
* Restock front office, coffee, and client-facing supplies as needed.
* Monitor client restrooms and ensure they remain clean and presentable.
* Clean up spills or accidents in client-facing areas when appropriate and notify the appropriate team when additional assistance is needed.
* Support daily tasks assigned by Client Experience leadership to maintain an efficient workflow.
* Complete other duties and responsibilities as assigned based on the needs of the **hospital.**

**Teamwork & Collaboration**

* Work collaboratively with Client Experience Representatives, Client Experience Supervisors, Client Liaisons, technicians, doctors, and other hospital teams.
* Support teammates during periods of high volume.
* Ask for help when needed and offer help when others are overwhelmed.
* Communicate concerns or barriers early so the team can address them.
* Contribute to a positive and respectful work environment.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on tasks.
* Be open to learning new processes and supporting improvements to the client experience.
* Support other departments and hospital teams when appropriate and as directed by leadership.

**Service & Continuous Improvement**

* Look for opportunities to improve the client experience and daily workflow.
* Provide feedback to Client Experience leadership when a process is unclear or creates challenges for clients or the team.
* Participate in training and ongoing development.
* Learn and follow hospital policies, procedures, and workflows.
* Stay informed about hospital services, departments, and client-facing processes.
* Take responsibility for personal performance and development.
* Help create a consistent experience for clients across all shifts and departments.
* Support new processes and changes designed to improve the client and patient experience.

**Core Competencies**

**Compassion**  
Demonstrates patience, empathy, and understanding when working with clients, patients, and team members.

**Professionalism**  
Maintains a professional and respectful approach in all interactions, including difficult or stressful situations.

**Communication**  
Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with clients and hospital team members.

**Teamwork**  
Works collaboratively and willingly supports teammates to meet the needs of clients and patients.

**Organization**  
Effectively manages multiple responsibilities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

**Accountability**  
Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and communicates when assistance is needed.

**Problem-Solving**  
Uses good judgment to identify issues, find solutions, and know when to involve a supervisor or manager.

**Adaptability**  
Comfortably adjusts to changing priorities and the unpredictable nature of a 24/7 emergency and specialty hospital.

**Emotional Intelligence**  
Recognizes the emotions and needs of clients and coworkers and responds with patience, empathy, and professionalism.

QualificationsEducation

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Veterinary or medical education or experience is a plus.

Experience

* Previous experience in client service, customer service, hospitality, healthcare, veterinary medicine, or a related field preferred.
* Veterinary or medical experience is preferred but not required.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment is preferred.

Skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and client service skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful situations.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize competing responsibilities.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Comfortable using computers and learning practice management systems.
* Ability to handle basic billing and payment transactions accurately.
* Ability to handle sensitive client and patient information appropriately.
* Ability to recognize when a situation needs to be escalated to leadership.

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during a shift.
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods.
* Frequent use of hands for typing, paperwork, and operating office equipment.
* Ability to bend, reach, and perform repetitive motions.
* Ability to occasionally lift or carry items up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work around animals and within a veterinary medical environment.

Schedule & Work Environment

* Full-time or part-time position based on hospital needs.
* Must be available to work in a 24/7 emergency and specialty hospital environment.
* Schedule may include days, evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays.
* Work is primarily performed in a busy, client-facing hospital environment.
* The position involves frequent interaction with clients, patients, doctors, technicians, and other hospital team members.
* The environment can be fast-paced and emotionally challenging, particularly during emergency situations.

About NorthStar VETS

NorthStar VETS is a group of veterinary emergency and specialty hospitals serving the NJ and PA region. For more than 25 years, we have been committed to improving the communities we serve by helping as many patients as possible.

We are committed to providing high-quality medicine, supporting the growth and development of our teams, and creating an environment where people can build long-term careers.

We support employee wellness through quarterly wellness events, provide continuing education opportunities, give back to our local communities, and encourage a workplace built on respect, teamwork, and inclusion.

NorthStar VETS exists for one fundamental purpose: **to improve the quality of life for our patients, clients, family veterinarians, and our staff.**

We do this through our CPETS values:

6676dcca21ba95057196.title: Customer Support Specialist (Integrations & Accounting)
6676dcca21ba95057196.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $78M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Help own our integrations and accounting support queue across phone and email: sync errors, connector outages, GL and journal entry questions, and ERP setup, all the way to resolution.
* Troubleshoot how data moves between Miter and our partners' systems. Read sync logs and API errors, reproduce the issue, figure out whether it's configuration, customer data, a partner-side problem, or a real product bug, and explain the fix in plain language.
* Untangle construction accounting scenarios like GL account and department mapping, job and cost code costing, labor burden and fringe allocation, multi-entity setups, and employees, jobs, or activities that won't sync.
* Be the checkpoint before integration cases reach Engineering. When something is a true defect, hand it over with a clean reproduction, logs, and the customer's settings so it can be fixed fast.
* Help define what a proactive support motion could look like for Integration/Accounting issues. What ways can we automate fixes or suggestions for customers based on what we are seeing customers get stuck on.
* Build the playbooks: troubleshooting guides for each integration, saved replies for the most common fixes, and knowledge base articles all updated with an eye for extreme accuracy so customers (and our internal and customer-facing AI tools) can get it right without escalating
* Level up the team. Review integration escalations with Tier 1, run trainings on each accounting system, and become the person teammates come to when they're stuck.
* Be a support contact for integration partners like Sage, Procore, and BuildOps.
* Spot patterns in what customers run into and turn them into bug reports, feature requests, and process improvements with Product and Engineering.
* Hit Resolution, SLA, and CSAT goals while keeping quality high. Every customer loves working with you.

**What You'll Need:**
---------------------

* 2+ years of hands-on work with accounting or ERP systems, whether supporting customers, implementing, or using them day to day as an accountant or systems admin. That could be at a software company, consulting firm, VAR, or in-house finance team.
* Real depth in at least one of these: Sage Intacct, Sage 100 or 300 CRE, QuickBooks Online or Desktop, NetSuite, Acumatica, Viewpoint Vista or Spectrum, or Foundation.
* A working understanding of how payroll hits the books: chart of accounts, GL mapping, journal entries, accruals, departments and classes, job costing, and how to reconcile payroll against the ledger when the numbers don't match.
* Technical troubleshooting instincts. You're comfortable reading error messages and sync logs, working through CSV imports and exports, and learning how a system's data model fits together. You can work out what's going on without a script.
* You're organized and keep a clean queue. No cases slip through the cracks, you set expectations with customers, and you over-communicate, especially on cases that sit with Engineering or a partner.
* You're self-starting and don't need to be told what to do next. If you see something that needs to be done, you thrive on the ownership to just do it. Ambiguity doesn't deflate you. Not everything has a process yet, and you're excited to help build it.
* Clear, warm writing. You can explain a sync failure to a stressed-out controller at month-end so it makes sense, and make them feel heard.
* A teacher's mindset. You like writing things down, building guides, and helping teammates get as good at this as you are.
* Comfort using AI tools and workflows beyond the surface level. You're interested in building more, even if you haven't had the chance to flex that muscle in previous roles, you will here!
* An empathetic, service-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day-to-day operations.

**Nice to Have:**
-----------------

* Construction accounting experience, such as work-in-progress (WIP) schedules, job cost reports, certified payroll, union fringes, or prevailing wage.
* Experience implementing an ERP or payroll integration, including mapping setup, data migration, and go-live support.
* Familiarity with field and operations tools like Procore, BuildOps, ServiceTitan, or HCSS HeavyJob.
* Payroll experience, or familiarity with benefits and 401(k) data feeds like Employee Navigator.
* A CPA, or certification in an accounting system (for example, Sage Intacct or QuickBooks ProAdvisor).

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You're working integration cases on your own, starting with Sage Intacct and Sage 300 CRE, and you know our connectors well enough to tell configuration problems from bugs.
* **60 days:** You review integration cases that have made it to engineering, looking for opportunities to address the root cause at the front lines. You've published updates to troubleshooting guides for our top accounting systems.
* **90 days:** Fewer integration cases need Engineering, they resolve faster, and customers hear from us about sync failures before they have to write in.

**Our Interview Process**
-------------------------

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take-Home Exercise
* Domain Challenge
* Final Leadership Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.

* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning & Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company-wide and team-specific off-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------

We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.

Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company-wide and team specific off-sites!

**Join our Talent Community**
-----------------------------

Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? **Apply to our Talent Community****,** and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

**Equal Opportunity:**
----------------------

Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process:**
---------------------------------------------------------

Miter uses AI-assisted tools as part of our hiring process to help our recruiting team manage and review applications more efficiently. We want to be transparent about how this works.

*What the AI does:* When you apply to a role at Miter, an AI tool may review your application against the specific qualifications and requirements posted for that job. This tool identifies whether your experience appears to meet, partially meet, or not meet each stated requirement, and it provides supporting evidence from your application for every assessment it makes.

*What the AI does not do:* The AI does not make hiring decisions. It does not reject, advance, or rank candidates on its own, and it does not assign you a numerical score. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team, who makes the final call on whether you move forward. The AI is a tool that helps our team prioritize their time across a high volume of applications. It is not a substitute for human judgment.

*What information it uses:* The tool evaluates the application materials you submit (your resume and any other application content) against role-specific criteria our team has defined. It does not pull information from external sources such as social media or professional networking profiles, and personal identifying information is removed from your materials before any AI review takes place.

*Human oversight:* Our recruiting team periodically reviews how these tools are performing to check for unintended patterns in outcomes, and we retain the ability to override any AI-generated assessment at any time.

Compensation Range: $90K - $110K

**Hiring Opportunity – EdTech Customer Success Specialist to Support Implementation, Training, and Adoption of College and Career Readiness Platform**

*(Remote position with potential for some travel to deliver on-site training)*

MaiaLearning (“Maia”) is seeking an entry- or mid-level Customer Success Specialist to lead successful platform adoption across new and existing school, district, and state customers. Primarily serving customers in Pacific, Mountain, and Central US time zones, this role will guide college and career readiness implementations from onboarding through launch and sustained use. This is not a sales position. This role centers on supporting schools and districts in successfully leveraging the Maia platform to achieve their college and career readiness goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You may be a great fit if you are a former school counselor, college advisor, educator, or EdTech customer success professional, who is extremely tech-savvy and enjoys training adults, managing implementation projects, building relationships, and helping schools achieve meaningful student outcomes.

The successful candidate will quickly learn and become an expert in Maia's evolving platform and serve as a trusted partner to educators, counselors, administrators, and district leaders. This individual will support implementation projects from onboarding through launch, deliver engaging virtual and in-person training, and provide guidance on leveraging the platform to support college, career, and postsecondary readiness initiatives. Approximately 40% of the role focuses on customer onboarding and implementation, 30% on training delivery, and 30% on ongoing customer support and success management.

This is a remote position and may include occasional travel to provide on-site training to customers. Candidates located in Arizona are preferred; however, candidates in other states willing to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM Pacific Standard Time will be considered.

**In this role you will:**

* Support customers through on-time implementation, adoption, technical troubleshooting, and ongoing success
* Deliver virtual and in-person training to educators, counselors, and administrators
* Develop training resources, manage project timelines, and ensure key milestones are achieved
* Provide thorough first-line technical support and escalate requests as needed
* Collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and improve the customer experience
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and readiness scores through training and support interactions
* Perform additional duties and special projects as needed

**Work Location**

This position is remote. Preference will be given to candidates residing in Arizona due to the need for occasional on-site training and support for schools and districts in the region. Qualified candidates located elsewhere in the United States will be considered if they are able to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM Pacific Standard Time and can travel occasionally within the region. Travel is minimal and typically represents less than 5% of working time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software systems and technologies
* Demonstrated experience delivering engaging virtual and in-person training, preferably in K–12 education or educational technology
* Strong communication, presentation, customer service, and problem-solving skills
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
* Strong project coordination and time-management abilities
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a distributed team
* Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to deliver on-site training within the US
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Microsoft Excel, or similar office and spreadsheet software
* Reliable high-speed internet connection

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of college and career readiness, counseling, and postsecondary planning
* Experience in K–12 education, school counseling, college advising, educational technology, and/or school administration
* Experience supporting school initiatives, change management, student information systems, and educational technology platforms

**About Maia**

MaiaLearning (“Maia”) is a leading college and career readiness platform that helps K–12 students discover, plan, and prepare for successful futures. Serving schools, districts, and state education agencies across the United States and in more than 70 countries, Maia combines innovative technology with exceptional customer service to empower educators and support student success. Our platform continuously evolves to meet the changing needs of schools while delivering meaningful impact for students, counselors, teachers, and administrators.

At Maia, you’ll be part of a mission-driven, collaborative team dedicated to innovation, exceptional customer experiences, and meaningful educational impact. You’ll have a positive influence on students' futures by empowering educators, counselors, and school leaders to deliver high-quality college and career readiness programs at scale. You’ll play a critical role in helping educators leverage technology to improve student outcomes and postsecondary planning success.

**Instructions to Apply**

If you meet these qualifications and are passionate about helping schools leverage technology to improve student success, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter via Indeed.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

The Contact Center Specialist Level 1 (Remote) will provide excellent customer service while responding to inbound calls from borrowers and financial institutions as well as perform outbound calls to insurance companies and agencies to verify insurance information.

Fully Remote | Monday-Friday 12pm-9pm CST

Essential Job Functions

* Quickly analyze account history on a proprietary computer system and provide accurate information to assist in one-call resolution
* Perform insurance verifications via outbound calls and the internet
* Meet individual and team performance standards while maintaining good attendance and dependability
* Show courtesy and professionalism on all calls to ensure a positive customer experience

Qualifications

* Strong customer service orientation with active listening skills and a high attention to detail
* Professional verbal and written skills
* Ability to solve routine problems using established procedures
* Ability to type a minimum of 25WPM
* Intermediate computer skills

Education/Experience

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum one year of customer service experience
* Prior experience with auto insurance or collateral protection insurance a plus

**US Work Authorization**

US Work Authorization required. Markel does not provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

**Who we are:**

Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory and investment operations around the world.

**We’re** **all about people | We win together | We strive for better**

**We enjoy the everyday | We think further**

**What’s** **in it for you:**

In keeping with the values of the Markel Style, we strive to support our employees in living their lives to the fullest at home and at work.

* We offer competitive benefit programs that help meet our diverse and changing environment as well as support our employees’ needs at all stages of life.

* All full-time employees have the option to select from multiple health, dental and vision insurance plan options and optional life, disability, and AD&D insurance.

* We also offer a 401(k) with employer match contributions, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, PTO, corporate holidays and floating holidays, parental leave.

**Are you ready to play your part?**

Choose **‘Apply Now’** to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.

**Caution: Employment** **scams**

Markel is aware of employment-related scams where scammers will impersonate recruiters by sending fake job offers to those actively seeking employment in order to steal personal information. These "job offers" include convincing offer letters and frequently ask for confidential personal information. Therefore, for your safety, please note that:

1fbf9a9ba59d362bd865.title: Remote Healthcare Call Center Representative
1fbf9a9ba59d362bd865.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  
  

**Healthcare Contact Center Associate** **-Work from Home**

**About the Healthcare Call Center Associate role:**

  

As a member of the Customer Experience team, you will handle telehealth-based phone calls and email inquiries. Call drivers can include insurance verifications, benefits education, billing questions, prescription issues, technical challenges including up to real-time support during time sensitive situations. You manage a steady volume of incoming calls from customers while navigating multiple systems. Punctuality and dependability are key to our clients’ success and your role as an associate.

**There are plenty of career growth opportunities within the healthcare team!**

  

* You Must have Open Flexibility: Hours of Operation: 24/7/365

* Production Schedules are based on Business Need/Will be assigned during training.

* The pay rate is $16.50 an hour, which may be below your state’s minimum wage. Please take this into consideration when applying.

* Health benefits (medical, dental, vision) are available on the first day of employment.

* Paid time off is accrued after 180 days (about 6 months) of employment.

* Fully work from home.

* Successfully learn to navigate 3 systems with an average of 20 calls per day.

**What we look for:**

  

We are looking for people with a passion for helping others, who are naturally empathetic and determined to deliver a comprehensive solution to these healthcare-related calls. Customer service experience is a plus but not required. To be successful in this role, you will:

* Manage a steady volume of incoming calls from customers while navigating multiple systems.

* Successfully completed a 3-week virtual training class and 1 week of Nesting. (You cannot miss a day of training).

* Successfully complete customer service assessment & typing test on a computer (not compatible with mobile devices).

* Great problem-solving skills

* Ability to effectively multi-task

* Excellent communication skills

* Availability to work weekends.

* High school diploma, GED, or college degree

* Successful completion of a background check is required for this position.

* Production schedules are provided during training.

**About the Healthcare Call Center Role:**

* Answer questions about services, provider availability, insurance coverage, visit costs, etc.

* Assist patients in scheduling appointments for virtual consultations with healthcare providers

* Provide technical assistance in enrolling, scheduling, joining telehealth visits, reviewing account information, etc.

* Investigate patient reports of incorrect costs, refund requests, insurance coverage, etc. and escalate cases to billing department

* Guide patients through self-service options to locate visit history, sick slips, prescription information, medical records, etc.

* Gather patient feedback on provider quality, ease of use of self-service options, visit connectivity, etc.

  

**A few questions you can expect:**

* What is this authorization charge I see on my credit card after scheduling a visit?

* I am at the pharmacy to pick up my prescription and they do not have it in their system. Did it get sent?

* I cannot sign into my account in the app and am not receiving a password reset email. Can you send me one?

* I attempted to schedule a phone visit but was not reached by a provider. Can I switch to a video visit instead?

**Requirements for Remote Call Center Representative:**

* Successfully complete customer service assessment & typing test on a computer (not compatible with mobile devices).

* High school diploma, GED, or college degree.

* Complete a mandatory paid training program with 100% attendance.

* Successful completion of a background check is required for this position.

**Equipment and workspace requirements:**

* We provide all equipment. (Computer, Monitor, Mouse, Keyboard, Headset, Ethernet Cord, Power Cables)

* High speed internet. You must have a **home internet** connection with **25 Download and 10 Upload Speed** (you may do a quick check through https://www.speedtest.net/)

* Must be able to hardwire your work computer directly to your home modem via ethernet. (Ensure the available connection meets the minimum bandwidth requirements to perform your job function. **Satellite internet and wireless internet are not acceptable**.

* Must have a quiet, distraction free workspace. (Workspace must be clutter free, free of distraction, no one is allowed in workspace during working hours, no writing utensils, or unauthorized electronics in the work area

**The application process will take less than 20 minutes and includes everything required to be considered.**

* Apply to the role and provide your basic profile information (2 minutes)

* Answer prescreens questions to be sure you meet the minimum requirements for the role (3 minutes).

* Complete a typing test (2 minutes) **You** **will need a keyboard.**

* Take short assessment to determine your fit for the role and set everyone up for success (10 minutes)

**Important:**

Due to varying state and local minimum wage laws, we are currently only able to hire candidates residing in states where our compensation structure complies with applicable wage regulations. As a result, we may be unable to consider applicants from certain states or municipalities at this time.

*We are currently NOT hiring in the following geographies, including but not limited to:*

*States: AK, CA, CT, HI, IL, MA, MD, MT, NJ, NY, OR, WA.*  
*Metro Areas: Minneapolis - MN, Washington, DC, Denver - CO, Boulder - CO, Edgewater - CO, Flagstaff - AZ.*

Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $16.50/hour.

  

Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

63efc57c4b42daf4db1c.description:
**About The Role**
==================

Our Sales team is growing at The RealReal, and we’re seeking self-motivated individuals with excellent communication and interpersonal skills to join our team! The Business Development Representative (BDR) works to qualify leads and pass to the appropriate sales channel to close into new consignors. If you’re customer-obsessed and driven to excel in a fully-remote, competitive sales environment, this could be the perfect fit!  
  
WEST:Eligible work locations: AL, AZ, CA, CO, HI, ID, IL, LA, NM, MN, MO, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN (CST), TX, UT, WA

**What You Get To Do Everyday**
===============================

* Act as first point of contact for prospective clients (leads) interested in consigning at The RealReal
* Qualify marketing generated leads though daily outreach, while fielding inbound inquiries
* Pass qualified leads to appropriate sales channel to close into new consignment business
* Nurture leads through ongoing follow-up via phone/text/email
* Utilize internal tools and resources to educate leads on consignment process, brands accepted, pricing expectations and next steps

**What You Bring To The Role**
==============================

**Minimum Requirements**

* High degree of professionalism and excellent phone demeanor
* Exceptional attention to detail and organization skills; ability to tailor communication style to suit all audiences
* Strong customer service, problem-solving, and analytical skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortability using software such as G-Suite, Email, SalesForce, CRM
* Self-motivation and drive to excel in fast-paced environment
* A solutions-focused mentality with a growth mindset
* Adaptability and openness to change
* Ability to commit to full-time hours (40 hours per week)
* Must be able to work one weekend day - shifts offered are: Tuesday-Saturday or Sunday-Thursday

**Preferred Requirements**

* Familiarity with the luxury fashion marketplace
* Lead qualification experience

**Compensation, Benefits, + Perks**
===================================

* Hourly base pay + uncapped commission
* $800/month commission (at target)
* Monthly sales competitions (i.e. cash | prizes | site credit)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* 401K with Company Match
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Paid Parental Leave
* 9 Paid Company Holidays
* 18 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days (PTO starts accruing on first day of work)
* Find out more about our Benefits here.

The expected hourly rate for this role is $21-$21. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.

The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.

The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.  
  
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

**Job Profile**

**Position Overview**
=====================

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Customer Support Representative within PNC's Linga organization, you will be based remotely.
  
  
Shifts for this role will be:
  
Tuesday - Saturday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM EST or 5:00 PM EST - 2:00 AM EST.  
Sunday - Thursday, 4:00 AM - 1:00 PM EST (days off Friday, Saturday)
  
Wednesday - Sunday, 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM EST (days off Monday, Tuesday)
  
  

* Candidate will be required to work holidays.

  
This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

**Job Description**
===================

* Performs advanced customer service activities and initiatives for specialized products and services. Supports a complex dedicated suite of products/services, services a sophisticated client base, and/or leverages an advanced process or tool to support internal and external customers. Focus on problem resolution that occurs across multiple channels for our customers. Delivers CARES model to customers and service partners.
* Receives, investigates and responds to customer inquiries regarding complex products, services and issues via all channels through which customers are served.
* Resolves customer service inquiries and issues. Recommends appropriate solutions. Resolves the most complex or reoccurring issues, and identifies root cause and acts as an escalation point. May interact with higher levels within the customer organization.
* Maintains high levels of customer satisfaction consistent with PNC's core values. Demonstrates commitment to quality. Serves as a coach or mentor and may serve as a trainer to the customer service team.
* Documents customer interactions and completes service requests to minimize customer effort or additional action.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

* **Customer Focused** - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
* **Managing Risk** - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

**Qualifications**
==================

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

Accountability, Continual Improvement Process, Customer Interactions, Customer Service, Decision Making, Relationship Building, Results-Oriented, Technical Support

**Competencies**
----------------

Accuracy and Attention to Detail, Client Relationship Management, Customer Experience Management., Decision Making and Critical Thinking, Effective Communications, Fraud Detection and Prevention, Managing Multiple Priorities, Problem Solving, Products and Services, Tech Savvy

**Work Experience**
-------------------

Roles at this level typically require an Associates or equivalent degree as well as related experience or product knowledge to accomplish primary duties. Typically requires 3+ years experience. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

**Education**
-------------

Associates

**Certifications**
------------------

No Required Certification(s)

**Licenses**
------------

No Required License(s)

**Language Assessments**
------------------------

  
No Required or Preferred Language Assessments

**Pay Transparency**
====================

Base Salary: $37,500.00 – $75,000.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.

**Application Window**
======================

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 09/15/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

**Benefits**
============

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit pncthrive.com.

**Disability Accommodations Statement**
=======================================

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)**

The role evaluates customer needs, manages service and fulfillment requests, and resolves first level technical and operational concerns across print, device, and connectivity environments. The Representative applies technical knowledge, sound judgment, diagnostic resources, and established processes to make appropriate service decisions and deliver timely, accurate solutions that support a positive client experience.
