a51b7d41cd4dd10a5b9a.title: Contract Recruiter (3-Month Engagement)
a51b7d41cd4dd10a5b9a.description:
**Contract Recruiter (3-Month Engagement)**
===========================================

**About Scale**
---------------

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a **Contract Recruiter** for a 3-month engagement to own full-cycle hiring across Scale Media and our brands: Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements. You'll partner directly with hiring managers to fill open roles across growth and marketing, analytics, and other areas of the business, running each search from intake through accepted offer.

This is a hands-on, high-volume role with a defined timeline. You'll need to ramp quickly, build pipelines from day one, and close hires within the engagement window.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Full-Cycle Recruiting**

* Manage multiple open requisitions at once, from kickoff to offer acceptance.
* Run intake meetings with hiring managers to define the role, the must-haves, and a realistic profile for the market.
* Conduct first-round screens that assess both capability and fit with a fully remote, high-ownership team.

### **Sourcing & Pipeline Building**

* Proactively source passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, communities, and competitor mapping, rather than relying on inbound applicants.
* Build target lists from DTC, CPG, supplement, and wellness companies for hard-to-fill roles.
* Write job postings and outreach that are specific and compelling, not generic.

### **Process & Coordination**

* Keep candidates moving through structured interview panels, and make sure each interviewer knows what they are assessing.
* Own JazzHR hygiene so every req has accurate status, notes, and next steps.
* Coordinate scheduling, take-home assessments, and debriefs so the team reaches a decision quickly.

### **Offers & Closing**

* Manage compensation conversations, extend offers, and close candidates within approved bands.
* Spot and address candidate concerns early so offers don't fall apart at the finish line.

### **Hiring Manager Partnership & Reporting**

* Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers on market conditions, candidate calibration, and process.
* Track and report on pipeline health, time-to-fill, and source effectiveness, and suggest improvements based on what the data shows.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* At least 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including contract or interim roles where you were expected to deliver hires on a set timeline.
* A proven track record of sourcing and closing candidates across multiple functions at the same time.
* Comfort with recruiting tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and a modern ATS (JazzHR or similar).
* Strong written communication skills, from outreach to job descriptions to hiring manager updates.
* Sound judgment on candidate quality, and the confidence to push back on hiring managers when needed.
* Strong backgrounds include: in-house recruiters at DTC, eCommerce, or consumer brands; agency recruiters who have moved to (or want to move to) in-house roles; and talent coordinators or sourcers ready to own full-cycle searches.

**What Makes You a Fit**
------------------------

* **Hits the Ground Running:** You can take over open reqs in your first week and produce qualified pipeline without a long ramp-up.
* **High Ownership:** You treat every open req as your own problem to solve, not a ticket in a queue.
* **Fast-Paced and Remote-Ready:** You do well in a fully remote, fast-paced environment and keep things moving without being micromanaged.
* **Candidate-First:** You know a good candidate experience is part of how we win talent, and you run your process accordingly.
* **Cross-Functional Collaborator:** You're equally comfortable recruiting a performance marketer, a supply chain lead, and a data analyst.

**Preferred, But Not Required**
-------------------------------

* Experience recruiting for supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription brands.
* Experience hiring for growth and marketing roles in a DTC environment.
* Experience recruiting for a fully remote team.

**Reporting Structure**
-----------------------

You will report directly to our Associate Director, HR.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Salary: $80,000 - $100,000 annualized, depending on experience
* Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance
* Fully remote, full-time, 3-month W-2 contract position
* Monthly WFH stipend
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Discounted Products
* An amazing team to work alongside

Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants' homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

**Role Scope**:

The Sr. Authorizations Associate is a key member of Habitat Health's centralized, shared authorizations team within Value Based Care Operations. This non-clinical role owns the end-to-end authorization workflow, from validating new referrals through finalization, post-service authorizations, and follow-up, with local clinical teams. Working within strict regulatory timeframes, the Authorizations Coordinator keeps every referral accurate and moving so participants receive services on time, and so Habitat Health always knows what has been authorized, delivered, and billed.

The role's core accountability will include:

* Ensures all referrals and authorizations, across all systems of record, including post-service and retro-authorization requests, are processed within strict regulatory timeframes to support timely delivery of services to participants.

* Tracks authorization timelines, expirations, and extensions to help guarantee regulatory and internal turnaround times are met.

* Reviews and validates all referrals for completeness (participant, provider, and reason details; required clinical approvals, network status) before handing off to scheduling.

* Owns timely, compliant follow-up and close-out of referrals, including confirming follow-up from after visit summaries.

* Works closely with the local care delivery teams to route requests that require clinical review to the appropriate PCP or IDT members and tracks them to a decision. Partners with Patient Access, Medical Records, Network Management, Claims, and local care teams to resolve authorization-related discrepancies and keep handoffs on time.

* Facilitates single case agreements end-to-end with the Network team when needed.

* Keeps referral and authorization status accurate as enrollment changes (new enrollees, disenrollment, completed visits).

* Documents all actions, contacts, and outcomes accurately in the EHR and authorization systems, following standardized workflows and HIPAA requirements.

  **Qualifications:**

  + Associate's degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) and 2+ years of experience in prior authorization, referral coordination, or healthcare administration required.
  + Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration or a related field preferred;
  + Working knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance benefits, and authorization processes; Medicare/Medicaid managed care experience strongly preferred
  + Experience with single case agreements, out-of-network authorizations, or retro-authorizations preferred; familiarity with Kaiser Permanente referral processes is a plus
  + Experience with electronic health records (e.g., Epic), payer portals, and authorization management systems; proficiency in Microsoft Office
  + Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and own turnaround times
  + Ability to adapt to changes and learn new systems quickly
  + Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  + A strong passion for our mission, with a high degree of empathy for the populations we serve.

  **Compensation:**

  We consider an individual's qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance, life insurance, participation in the company's equity program, and paid time off, including vacation and sick leave. The expected salary range for this position is$70,000 to $88,000 and is bonus eligible. The actual offer will be at the company's sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate's qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

  **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**:

  Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Habitat Health applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), or other status protected by applicable law.

In keeping with our commitment, Habitat Health will take steps to provide people with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs with reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law. Accordingly, if you require a reasonable accommodation to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at careers@habitathealth.com.

**Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19**

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. For COVID-19 and influenza, team members who are working in a participant care setting are required to provide either proof of vaccination or a signed declination form and comply with applicable masking requirements while in a care setting to the extent permitted by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

Habitat Health will consider requests for reasonable accommodation based on an applicant's disability, medical condition, or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance in accordance with applicable law.

**Flexible Part-Time Position | Approximately 5-10 Hours Per Week**

About the Position

Light Within Counseling is looking for a warm, organized, and personable Client Care & Intake Coordinator to join our growing private practice!

This position would be an excellent fit for a graduate student pursuing their LMFT, LCSW, LPCC, or someone interested in building a future career in the mental health field. We understand that graduate school, internships, and personal commitments can make traditional work schedules challenging, so we are looking for someone who values flexibility and enjoys working with people.

This role offers an opportunity to gain exposure to the operations of a private mental health practice, learn about the client care process, and work alongside a team of therapists while helping individuals connect with the support they need.

The primary responsibility is to help create a positive, welcoming, and organized experience for prospective and current clients, from their very first phone call through getting established with a therapist.

Responsibilities

**Client Communication & Intake**

* Answer incoming phone calls and respond to voicemails.
* Respond to new client inquiries through email and website contact forms.
* Communicate with prospective clients about our services, therapists, fees, and scheduling process.
* Help match prospective clients with therapists based on their needs, preferences, and therapist availability.
* Send intake paperwork and communicate next steps.

**Consultation & Therapist Coordination**

* Coordinate consultation calls between prospective clients and therapists.
* Follow up with therapists regarding consultation calls and outcomes.
* Track whether prospective clients schedule after their consultation.
* Follow up with prospective clients who have not yet booked or completed the intake process.
* Communicate new inquiries and referral opportunities to the appropriate therapists.

**Scheduling & Client Care**

* Assist with scheduling, rescheduling, and general appointment coordination.
* Help current clients navigate scheduling needs and connect with the appropriate team member.
* Assist with continuity-of-care coordination when clients need to transition to another therapist.
* Help ensure prospective and current clients feel supported and don't fall through the cracks.

**Administrative Support**

* Maintain organized tracking of new inquiries, consultations, and client bookings.
* Monitor outstanding follow-ups and communicate updates to the practice owner.
* Assist with general administrative tasks related to client coordination and practice operations.

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

We would love to hear from someone who:

* Is currently enrolled in a graduate program pursuing their LMFT, LCSW, LPCC, or a related mental health profession.
* Is considering a future career in the mental health field.
* Enjoys connecting with people and helping others feel welcomed.
* Has excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Is organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.
* Is comfortable managing multiple tasks and following through independently.
* Is personable, professional, compassionate, and proactive.
* Enjoys working in a collaborative environment.

Previous administrative, customer service, or mental health office experience is a plus, but not required.

Position Details

* Part-time, approximately 10–15 hours per week to start.
* Flexible scheduling that can accommodate graduate school and internship commitments.
* Some designated phone and email coverage hours will be required.
* Opportunity for additional hours as the practice grows.
* Hourly compensation based on experience.
* Based in Roseville, CA, with potential for a combination of in-office and remote administrative work.

Why Light Within Counseling?

Light Within Counseling is a growing group therapy practice in Roseville, California, offering in-person and virtual therapy. We are passionate about providing meaningful, accessible, and thoughtful mental health care while creating a supportive environment for both our clients and our team.

This is an opportunity to be part of a collaborative practice, learn more about the behind-the-scenes operations of mental health care, and contribute to helping people find the right support.

**If you're organized, enjoy working with people, and are looking for a flexible part-time opportunity while pursuing your education or future career in mental health, we'd love to hear from you!**

bc31891fdb83217a57fe.description:
**Job Title:**  
LinkedIn Content & Social Media Coordinator
  
  
**Location:**  
Remote (U.S. based)
  
  
FLSA Classification
  
  
Exempt
  
  
**Job Description:**  
The LinkedIn Content & Social Media Coordinator will be responsible for developing, coordinating, publishing, and monitoring LinkedIn content that supports OEI’s brand awareness, business development, recruiting, and team member engagement objectives. This position will work with internal teams to identify compelling stories, gather project and team member content, maintain a consistent publishing schedule, and track social media performance.
  
  
This role reports to the Marketing Manager.
  
  
Essential Functions
  
  
LinkedIn Content Creation and Publishing
  
  

* Develop, write, edit, and publish engaging LinkedIn posts that reflect OEI’s brand, services, expertise, and company culture.
* Create content highlighting engineering projects, technical capabilities, team member achievements, company milestones, industry events, community involvement, and organizational announcements.
* Translate technical information provided by subject matter experts into clear, accessible content for professional audiences.
* Develop engaging captions, headlines, calls to action, and supporting copy tailored to LinkedIn.
* Coordinate the creation and use of supporting visuals, including photographs, graphics, short-form videos, and team member-generated content.
* Maintain a LinkedIn content calendar to ensure a consistent and timely publishing schedule.
* Coordinate content review and approval with the Marketing Manager and appropriate internal stakeholders before publication.

Team Member and Project Storytelling
  
  

* Collaborate with team members, project teams, business development, recruiting, and leadership to identify opportunities for content.
* Gather project highlights, employee stories, career milestones, professional accomplishments, and other content that demonstrates OEI’s expertise and workplace culture.
* Develop content that showcases OEI’s technical professionals, projects, services, and contributions to the industries and communities it serves.
* Support team member advocacy initiatives that encourage team members to engage with and share approved company content.
* Coordinate with recruiting to highlight career opportunities, team member experiences, internships, and other employment-branding initiatives.
* Obtain appropriate approvals and verify information before publishing team member photographs, project details, or other potentially sensitive content.

Social Media Engagement and Brand Management
  
  

* Monitor OEI’s LinkedIn presence and review comments, reactions, shares, mentions, and other engagement activity.
* Help maintain a professional, consistent, and recognizable brand voice across published content.
* Identify opportunities to participate in relevant industry conversations and increase visibility among clients, prospective team members, industry professionals, and other target audiences.
* Coordinate responses to routine social media interactions in accordance with established company guidelines, escalating sensitive questions or issues to the Marketing Manager.
* Monitor relevant industry developments, company news, and social media trends to identify potential content opportunities.
* Ensure published content follows company branding, communication standards, confidentiality requirements, and applicable platform guidelines.

Analytics and Performance Reporting
  
  

* Monitor LinkedIn analytics and track key performance indicators (KPIs), including impressions, engagement rate, reactions, comments, shares, follower growth, and link clicks, where available.
* Prepare regular reports summarizing content performance, audience engagement, and progress toward established social media objectives.
* Identify high-performing content and patterns in audience engagement to inform future content recommendations.
* Evaluate the performance of different content formats and topics, including team member spotlights, project highlights, company news, and recruiting-related posts.
* Recommend practical adjustments to content, timing, and publishing frequency based on performance data.
* Maintain organized records of published content, campaign results, and social media reporting.

Content Planning and Collaboration
  
  

* Work with the Marketing Manager to align LinkedIn content with approved marketing priorities, business development initiatives, recruiting needs, and company announcements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain accurate information, photographs, project updates, and approvals in a timely manner.
* Maintain an organized library of approved social media content, photographs, graphics, and related materials.
* Assist with special social media initiatives and campaigns as assigned by the Marketing Manager.
* Explore appropriate uses of artificial intelligence (AI) and social media tools to improve content development, scheduling, and reporting efficiency while maintaining accuracy and OEI’s brand voice.

Other Duties
  
  
Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Approximately 2–4 years of experience creating professional social media content, managing social media accounts, or supporting digital communications.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills is required.
* Demonstrated familiarity with LinkedIn and professional social media best practices.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, publishing schedules, and content approvals.
* Ability to adapt writing style for different audiences while maintaining a consistent brand voice.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
* Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues to gather information and develop accurate content.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with social media scheduling or analytics tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience managing a corporate LinkedIn page or supporting a business-to-business (B2B) organization’s social media presence.
* Experience in engineering, energy, utilities, infrastructure, technical services, or another professional services industry.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn analytics and social media performance reporting.
* Experience creating graphics or short-form videos using tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Experience supporting employer branding, employee advocacy, or recruiting-related social media initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled content creation tools and social media management platforms.

**Location Note:**  
This is a remote position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.
  
  
**Salary Range:**  
$75,000 to $95,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location)
  
  
**Benefits:**  
A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, company-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Orbital:**  
Powered by People, Driven by Solutions
  
  
Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands-on mentality, and world-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best-practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement:**  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

7487af18fb50455b8586.title: Remote Travel Coordinator
7487af18fb50455b8586.description:
We are seeking an organized and motivated Remote Travel Coordinator to support the planning and coordination of personalized travel experiences. This role involves researching destinations, organizing trip details, preparing itineraries, and communicating with clients throughout the planning process. It is well suited to someone who enjoys travel, planning, and organization and is comfortable working independently with digital tools. The position is fully remote and is part of a small, travel-focused company dedicated to creating well-planned client experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and organize client travel preferences, dates, budgets, and special requests
* Research destinations, accommodations, cruises, transportation, and vacation activities
* Compare travel options, amenities, locations, and scheduling requirements
* Prepare clear, well-structured travel itineraries
* Assist with coordinating reservations and reviewing booking details for accuracy
* Maintain accurate records of travel arrangements, confirmations, and itinerary updates
* Communicate relevant information and updates to clients throughout the planning process
* Use online resources and digital tools to manage planning tasks efficiently
* Stay informed about destination information and developments within the travel industry

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort using computers, online research tools, and digital platforms
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
* Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
* Interest in travel, hospitality, scheduling, or customer service
* Previous experience in administration, reservations, travel, or client support is helpful but not required

**Training and Development**

* Access to travel planning educational resources
* Guidance on itinerary preparation and coordination procedures
* Opportunities to expand destination knowledge and familiarity with the travel industry
* Ongoing learning resources to support skill development

**Work Environment**

This is a remote position involving online research, itinerary preparation, information management, and client communication. Candidates should have reliable internet access and a suitable environment for completing their responsibilities, and should be comfortable working independently in a home-based setting.

**What We Offer**

* A remote working arrangement
* Training and ongoing guidance to build travel planning skills and familiarity with industry systems
* The opportunity to contribute to personalized travel experiences within a small, travel-focused company

Details regarding eligibility, the working arrangement, and compensation will be provided in accordance with the role and applicable requirements.

e2a1214b19049ff60458.title: Continuing Care Coordinator RN
e2a1214b19049ff60458.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our Continuing Care Coordinator RN, you will collaborate with physicians, staff, and healthcare professionals within your clinical setting to maintain and improve quality and sustainability within the local market network, focusing on chronic disease management.
  
  
Every day you will develop individualized care plans based on nursing assessments, provide patient/caregiver education, coordinate interdisciplinary care, monitor patient progress, and implement evidence-based guidelines. You will also manage referrals based on local program criteria and participate in developing workflows and audits, facilitating seamless transitions of care.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will be a Registered Nurse with expertise in chronic disease management and care coordination, strong assessment and education skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate with healthcare professionals to implement evidence-based guidelines, driving quality and efficiency within the local market network.

  

* Works with "at risk" patients and families on selfmanagement support, including performing individual needs assessment, care plan design, education, documentation, implementation, and evaluation of outcomes according to state and national guidelines, policies, procedures, and protocols as required.
* Leads an interdisciplinary healthcare team in the management of highrisk patients referred to the Continuing Care program, facilitating collaboration, communication, and coordination among all responsible parties of the multidisciplinary healthcare team, striving to eliminate fragmentation, duplication, or gaps in care.
* Assists patients and/or caregivers with navigating the healthcare system to minimize fragmentation in services, obtain timely care and appropriate access to providers, services, and necessary procedures, anticipating barriers to care when possible.
* Assesses and works on the patient's readiness to change, the importance of change, and confidence in the ability to change, helping the patient to identify and overcome barriers, setting short and longterm goals for selfmanagement of chronic disease, and empowering the patient, family, and/or caregiver to achieve maximum levels of wellness and independence.
* Monitors member's compliance with scheduling and keeping PCP and specialist appointments, identifying patterns of nonadherence, and coordinating the scheduling of needed member appointments.
* Leads efforts to optimize care coordination across the care continuum, building and maintaining positive relationships with the healthcare team.

Hours are Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm. There are no weekends or Holidays. The position is remote (**must live in Colorado, Utah, AZ, NV or KS - Preference for Colorado**), with in-person attendance required at Corporate office in Centennial for the quarterly meeting.

**Job Requirements**

**Required**

* Associate's Degree in Nursing
* Two (2) years relevant experience OR advanced degree State issued license as a Registered Nurse as applicable to employment

**Preferred**

* BSN
* Three (3) to five (5) years of relevant experience
* EPIC experience HIGHLY desired.
* Case management, clinic or TCM/CCM experience HIGHLY desired.
* Remote or hybrid experience is a plus.

Where You'll Work

With more than 700 care sites across the U.S. from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable and innovating how and where healing can happen both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

 **Pay Range**  
$37.40 - $61.71 /hour

216772fe52f85fc419fa.title: Centralized Imaging Scheduler (PAS Resource Specialist)
216772fe52f85fc419fa.description:
Department Overview:

The function of the PAS Resource Specialist - Scheduling position within the Connected Care Center is to provide essential customer service support and guidance to clinics and patients in the areas of financial screening, patient eligibility for services, managed care, and complex patient referrals. The PAS Resource Specialist completes multifaceted, imaging-specific scheduling tasks, with the purpose of assisting, scheduling, and coordinating patient diagnostic imaging appointments within the Connected Care Center in EPIC and RIS. The employee in this position promotes OHSU’s mission statement by delivering high quality, cost effective, family-oriented service excellence. This position helps to create a collaborative environment by integrating education, research, and clinical leadership.

Function/Duties of Position:

* **Customer Service** - Provide high quality customer service to both external customers (patients, referring providers, clinics, insurance carriers) and internal customers (OHSU health care providers, staff) that exceed the service standards of the health care industry. This duty includes prompt and professional communication efforts, face-to-face and telephone customer contact skills, crisis management, familiarity with available information technology, standard complaint processing, flexible coverage of internal  
  service needs, and the continuous application of process improvement methods and skills.
* **Enrollment & Authorization** - Gather and/or verify patient information including demographics, insurance coverage, and financial status. Confirm patient eligibility for health care coverage and clarify any managed care arrangements. Verify appropriate accounts are active and associated with services to be received. Confirm authorizations for imaging procedures. Enter all information accurately into OHSU databases or into the medical record when necessary. Follow up on pending authorizations until they are obtained.
* **Arranged Care** – Obtains prior medical records and imaging studies if appropriate. Answer multi-line telephone, aids with clarifying orders, and notifying clinics of errors. Arranges stretchers, wheelchairs, and interpreters when necessary, and accommodate other special needs whenever possible. Mail information packets. Provide personal reminders to patients about upcoming appointments.
* **Radiology/Surgery Scheduling** - Schedules multifaceted patient appointments on line, and manually if necessary in all modalities of Diagnostic Imaging. Maintains current information regarding schedules for resources and providers. Serves as liaison and information resource for physicians, nursing support staff, coworkers, IP Admitting Department, Surgery Office, and Periop Services. Collects from physician and clinics all information necessary order information to schedule a scan (including ICD9 codes, diagnosis, equipment needs, etc.). Facilitates care arrangements by scheduling IRU time, preops, PAT clinic, ancillary and clinical services as needed. Applies problem solving and negotiating skills in resolving provider and patient concerns and  
  other imaging related problems.
* **Telecommunications** – Triages and accurately documents telephone calls from patients and referring clinics including requests for appointments, complaints, general information inquiries, and urgent health care concerns. Delivers such  
  information or requests promptly to the appropriate providers or their designees.
* **Clinical Services Resource** – Shares PAS expertise and disseminates PAS information to PAS Specialists within the service area. Instructs co-workers as needed in user skills for PAS system software including Order Entry, EPIC cadence scheduling and the Radiology Information System (RIS). Maintains a service-based working knowledge of diagnostic and procedural coding and  
  medical terminology. Fills in as needed for any subordinate PAS position within the service area.
* **Training and Competency** - Successfully completes the required PAS initial training and core competency assessment before or during the trial service period. Complete all required update modules. Maintain core competencies, and demonstrate continuous application of these skills throughout the period of employment.
* **Managed Care Coordination** – Maintains current information on managed care insurance plans and serves as a liaison and information resources for physicians, nursing support staff, PAS specialists, referring physician offices, patients, Hospital Operations Support and others on authorization requirements; serves as a service area resource ICD9 coding requirements;  
  obtains managed care authorizations for consultations, procedures, office visits, care arrangements, and contact other ancillary and clinical services as needed; problem solves and negotiates skills in resolving patient concerns and  
  managed care related problems.
* **Other: Employee completes other duties as assigned.**

  
Required Qualifications:

* One year of experience in a medical office setting, including high-volume direct patient contact, scheduling of appointments and may require experience obtaining managed care authorizations (dependent on position description). OR one and a half years of work experience in a high volume direct public contact position and 6 months experience in a medical office setting. The candidate must have a thorough knowledge of PAS policies and procedures. Candidates will have demonstrated advanced PAS user skills as well as extensive knowledge of integrated care at OHSU.

**Knowledge and Skills Required:**

* Basic computer skills including word processing. Windows applications, on-line scheduling, and a preference for data-base skills. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. Strong customer service orientation. Demonstrated effectiveness in confrontational customer interactions.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Associates degree.
* 2+ years in a medical office setting. Experience in a radiology or Connected Care Center setting strongly preferred.
* Database skills. RIS, EPIC systems. Radiology specific medical terminology

Additional Details:

* Must be able to work independently from home or in the office. Ability to concentrate in a busy, fast paced, noisy office. This is a fulltime position, and eligible for benefits.
* Ability to sit for continuous hours in a day.

Why apply to OHSU?:

**We are Oregon's only public academic health center.** In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington.

**All are welcome.** OHSU welcomes people of all ages, ethnicities, genders, national origins, religions and sexual orientations. We are striving to build an anti-racist, multicultural institution and encourage people with diverse backgrounds to apply.

To request reasonable accommodation, contact askhr@ohsu.edu

18d7b2dde416cc50429e.title: Central Scheduler
18d7b2dde416cc50429e.description:
**Job Summary**

The CaptionCall Central Scheduler will be responsible for creating, validating, qualifying and scheduling new leads interested in obtaining CaptionCall services as well as scheduling service appointments for existing customers. They will utilize sales skills to answer questions and walk potential customers through scheduling appointments for all current and future products offered by CaptionCall. Central Schedulers are responsible for working with and maintaining accurate and efficient travel schedules for the outreach teams. This is an inbound and outbound telephone calling position to people who self-certify their desire and need for captioning services.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Place calls and receive calls from applicants of CaptionCall services. Each new lead must be contacted the first business day the lead arrives into our system.
* Email, text and mail customers the request for an installation appointment if they cannot be reached on the phone.
* Screens and verifies new leads in order to confirm their need and desire to obtain captioning services from CaptionCall.
* Manage call queues to handle real time scheduling at customer facing events put on by Account Management teams.
* Enter new leads into database, attach required compliance forms and make account adjustments as outlined in processes.
* Ensure leads meet the basic environmental requirements in order to obtain their desired captioning device.
* Maintain a minimum of 80% conversion of all newly received leads.
* Maintain a revolving backlog of 100-120 customer accounts which include contacts made daily.
* Maintain an average of 100-150 calls handled daily.
* Enter newly received leads on the “drop” list when they cannot be reached or don’t meet the qualifications necessary to obtain service.
* Work leads dropped within the last 90 days to setup service for newly launched products.
* Schedule efficient appointments to minimize unnecessary mileage while ensuring an appointment wait time averaging less than two weeks for 200+ Trainers.
* Work directly with Trainers over the phone and email to coordinate appointments that fall outside of business hours.
* Learn the geographic territories to understand distances between locations and driving times for 200+ trainers.
* Use the scheduling platform to add new appointments to Trainer calendars and auto-assign tickets to the appropriate trainers.
* Review daily exception reports helping coordinate Trainer overnight travel and long-distance trips.
* Follow up with Trainers on unsuccessful appointments and reach out to customers as necessary.
* Assist with the reschedule of existing appointments at the request of the Customer or Management teams.
* Learn and understand other variables that impact installation times and the number of installations per day per Trainer.
* Have a basic understanding of the network configuration requirements and work with businesses to ensure their understanding of what’s necessary for the installation of CaptionCall services.
* Review accounts for proper compliance before scheduling service appointments.
* Coordinate self-install requests between leads and Customer Support.
* Maintain a basic understanding of Trainer and Customer Support duties and processes.
* Attend annual Sales trainings provided by Customer Care Management and National Account Management teams.
* Make recommendations for improvements to the centralized schedulers’ duties.
* Fill out summary reports to track daily and weekly efficiencies.
* Assist product management teams with the scheduling of newly released products according to outlined distribution goals and requirements set by the project teams.
* Perform miscellaneous duties, working on project teams, and ad hoc assignments as assigned.

  

**Supervisory Responsibility**

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

  

**Travel Requirements**

Travel Requirements: Less than 25%

  

**Education**

Minimum:

* High School Diploma or GED or equivalent, or call center experience.

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Must be familiar with Microsoft Office, specifically Outlook.
* Must be familiar with using a database or Customer Relationship Management software.
* Must be comfortable and experienced in using the telephone to make and receive calls at a rapid pace.
* Must be able to communicate effectively through telephone, email and other written communication.
* Must have professional and courteous telephone and electronic communications presence.
* Must be able to effectively communicate with remotely located employees and internal team.

  

**Working Conditions and Physical Requirements**

* Able to sit/ stand for a long period of time in an office environment
* Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, tools, and to handle other computer components
* Regular and predictable attendance required
* Positive attitude, team player, good interpersonal communication skills and able to work across company departments

  

**Disclaimer**

This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the employees, customers, and technologies of Sorenson Communications. It is essential that applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in strictest confidence.

  

Equal Employment Opportunity: Sorenson Communications is an EOE, Disability/Age Employer.

  

Benefits Disclosure: Consistent with applicable state and local pay transparency and job posting requirements, the Company provides eligible employees with access to a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits offerings may vary based on position status, location, and other eligibility requirements. Sick leave is provided to Part-Time employees when required by State or Local laws. At Sorenson, we believe everyone deserves to be understood. We combine expertise, technology, and care to help people connect across languages and communities.

b43f8b2adc3b1dd69563.title: C/S Administrative Specialist
b43f8b2adc3b1dd69563.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

**Make a Difference with DHSS**

Our mission at the Department of Health and Social Services (DHSS) is to improve the quality of life of Delaware citizens by promoting health and well-being, fostering self-sufficiency, and protecting vulnerable populations. We prioritize personal and family independence by assisting individuals and families in a variety of life areas.

We offer numerous career opportunities and are dedicated to attracting and retaining highly talented individuals who are ready to make a difference in their community today. DHSS is a great place to kick-start your profession.

For more information, please visit https://dhss.delaware.gov/dhss/ today!

**Summary Statement**
---------------------

Administrative Specialists provide administrative support work for the Chief Psychiatrist. Primary work includes assisting an administrative or technical supervisor in ensuring efficient and effective operations by carrying out various support activities such as composing official correspondence, drafting and distributing communications, coordinating workflow, resolving issues or complaints, or assisting with research, special projects or data/information management.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

Essential functions are fundamental, core functions common to all positions in the class series. These functions are not an exhaustive list of all job duties for any one position in the class. Since class specifications are descriptive and not restrictive, employees can complete job duties of a similar kind not specifically listed here.

  
  

* Serves as a liaison with internal and external contacts, customers, clients, and/or the public to coordinate various activities, respond to inquiries, and provide guidance and consultation on administrative matters.
  
  
* Creates formatted documents, generates and shares presentations, manages schedules, develops and manages spreadsheets, assists in maintaining policies, procedures, guidelines, or training manuals, and maintains information in databases.
  
  
* Delivers excellent customer service in-person, electronically, or by written communication.
  
  
* Applies and explains agency services, laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures.
  
  
* Creates and maintains a variety of record-keeping systems or logs to file, track, and retrieve documents or other information and ensures records are maintained in compliance with retention schedules.
  
  
* Assists higher-level staff with decision making and monitoring of key operational/program indicators by collecting/organizing data, preparing reports, supporting performance tracking and dashboard maintenance, or performing related support work.
  
  
* Reviews, processes, and evaluates information for completeness, accuracy, and conformity with applicable laws, rules, and regulations. Resolves discrepancies, deficiencies in information, or other issues.
  
  
* Drafts, manages, and distributes communications and other materials for public and/or internal use.
  
  
* Coordinates administrative elements of projects including tracking timelines, scheduling, documenting progress, and facilitating communication between team members.
  
  
* Uses automated information systems and computer software to enter, update, modify, delete, retrieve, and report on data.
  
  
* Orders and maintains office supplies and equipment.
  
  
* Plans and coordinates meetings, hearings, or conferences and makes travel arrangements.
  
  
* May approve or recommend approval/denial of requests/information within established standards and guidelines.
  
  
* Performs other related duties as required.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**JOB REQUIREMENTS for Administrative Specialist**

Applicants must have education, training and/or experience demonstrating competence in each of the following areas:

* One year of experience in performing office support work such as drafting routine correspondence, reports, or logs, operating office equipment, handling incoming and outgoing mail, postal and shipping services, answering phones, directing calls and taking messages, or maintaining files and supplies.

* One year of experience in document processing such as reviewing and evaluating records for completeness and conformity with laws, rules, regulations, standards, policies, and procedures, resolving deficiencies, and tracking and monitoring activities.

* One year of experience in using an automated information system to enter, update, modify, delete, retrieve/inquire and report on data.

* Six months’ experience in using standard computer software/applications to create documents, develop spreadsheets, or maintain/update databases.

**OR**

  
  

* Possession of an Associate’s degree or higher.

**Additional Posting Information**
----------------------------------

**This is a Casual/Seasonal position which is a non-pension eligible position without healthcare and/or other benefits.**

**Conditions of Hire**
----------------------

Criminal background check: A satisfactory criminal background check is required as a condition of hire. The recruiting agency may require the applicant to pay for the criminal background check as part of the conditional offer of hire.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The State of Delaware participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information refer to our Job Seeker Resources.

DHSS does not provide employment-based sponsorship.

All new hires are required to report to the Statewide New Employee Orientation (SNEO) on their first day of employment. Sessions are held at designated locations in Kent or New Castle County.

Pre-employment Drug Testing: Upon a conditional offer, you must undergo pre-employment drug testing as part of the hiring process.

**Selection Process**
---------------------

The application and supplemental questionnaire are evaluated based upon a rating of your education, training and experience as they relate to the job requirements of the position. It is essential that you provide complete and accurate information on your application and the supplemental questionnaire to include dates of employment, job title and job duties. For education and training, list name of educational provider, training course titles and summary of course content. Narrative information supplied in response to the questions must be supported by the information supplied on the application including your employment, education and training history as it relates to the job requirements.

Once you have submitted your application on-line, all future correspondence related to your application will be sent via email. Please keep your contact information current. You may also view all correspondence sent to you by the State of Delaware in the “My Applications” tab at StateJobs.Delaware.gov.

**Accommodations**
------------------

#### **An overview of this role**

As an Executive Assistant in the Office of the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you’ll support multiple senior leaders in GitLab’s Finance Group, helping them focus on their priorities through proactive calendar, travel, and expense management. Reporting to the Senior Executive Business Partner to the CFO, you’ll be part of an integrated model that gives Finance leadership balanced, consistent support. You’ll work across time zones, help coordinate team events and projects, and partner with colleagues to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

**What you’ll do**

* Proactively manage complex calendars across multiple time zones.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels, and visas where applicable.
* Manage expense reporting and reconciliation for each executive accurately and on time, following GitLab's travel and expense policies.
* Support the Senior Executive Business Partner in coordinating Finance leadership's recurring activities, including maintaining shared Office of the CFO resources, distribution lists, Slack channels, and shared calendars.
* Help plan team events, off-sites, and large meetings with cross-functional partners and the Senior Executive Business Partner.
* Handle highly confidential financial, personnel, and material non-public information with discretion, following GitLab's insider trading and quiet period policies.
* Provide coverage and backup for the CFO's Senior Executive Business Partner.

**What you’ll bring**

* Experience providing executive-level administrative support in a fast-paced environment and supporting multiple senior leaders at once, tailoring your approach to each leader while maintaining consistent support. Public company or Office of the CFO or Chief Executive Officer experience is a plus.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Navan, and related tools and processes, such as purchase orders, with the ability to learn new technical tools quickly.
* Experience working independently, moving quickly between tasks, and using sound judgment to prioritize, solve problems, and anticipate executive needs, including knowing when to escalate competing vice president priorities to the Office of the CFO.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams, including with other Executive Business Administrators and stakeholders at all levels.
* Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) to make day-to-day operations more efficient while protecting information and maintaining confidentiality.
* Ability to work in an all-remote, distributed environment, with a willingness to help others and contribute to a positive, one-team culture.
* Ability and willingness to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally, to support executives, team off-sites, and key events.

We value diverse backgrounds and transferable experience.

**About the team**

The Executive Business Administration function supports GitLab leaders by creating the operational foundation for effective work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The Office of the CFO brings the CFO's leadership team together under one operating model. Its Executive Business Administrators work as one team, using shared standards and templates, a common schedule of recurring activities, coordinated coverage, and a shared view of Finance leadership priorities. This approach helps the CFO and vice presidents receive consistent support as the organization grows.

8514a2df47e972420f77.title: Facilities Support Specialist
8514a2df47e972420f77.description:
At Tlingit Haida Tribal Business Corporation (THTBC), your work goes beyond the job description—it becomes part of a purpose-driven legacy. Our continuous commitment to growth directly contributes to the strength, resilience, and future of the communities we serve. Every milestone we achieve helps fund programs, expand services, and create lasting value for the Tribe, making each success a shared one.

For more than 35 years THTBC and its subsidiaries have delivered mission-critical services to federal clients globally. From logistics and information technology to cybersecurity and facilities operations, we are united by a single purpose: to generate meaningful economic opportunity and sustainable growth for the Tlingit & Haida Tribes of Alaska.

**Together We Grow – One Mission, One Team – With a Commitment to Serve**

**Job Title:** Facilities Support Services

**Work Location:** Remote

**Labor Category:** Exempt

**Clearance Level:** Secret

**Travel:** Up to 50%

**Pay Rate:** $75,000

**About the Role**

The Operations & Facilities Support Specialist provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Director of Operations and Senior Vice President of Operations. This position coordinates contract deliverables, reporting timelines, transition activities, leadership action items, and cross-functional operational requirements. The role supports multiple facilities management projects and works closely with Operations, Contracts, Finance, Human Resources, Quality Control, Security, and project teams to ensure assignments are completed accurately and on schedule.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Provide administrative and operational support to the Director and Senior Vice President of Operations.
* Maintain executive schedules and coordinate meetings, travel, agendas, minutes, and follow-up activities.
* Develop and maintain trackers for contract deliverables, deadlines, milestones, and leadership action items.
* Coordinate with project teams to collect, review, organize, and submit required reports and deliverables.
* Provide administrative support during contract phase-in, phase-out, mobilization, and transition activities.
* Track transition requirements, including staffing, onboarding, training, security access, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and executive-level reports, presentations, dashboards, and status updates.
* Support Program Management Reviews, customer meetings, operational reviews, and special projects.
* Maintain SharePoint sites, document libraries, continuity files, and operational records.
* Assist with procurement requests, vendor coordination, invoice documentation, and facilities-related administrative requirements.
* Coordinate across Operations, Contracts, Finance, HR, Quality Control, Security, and project management teams.
* Track risks, corrective actions, open issues, and other leadership-directed assignments through completion.
* Support audit preparation, records management, and contract compliance documentation.
* Handle confidential and sensitive business information with appropriate discretion.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We're Looking For**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Three to five years of experience in administrative support, operations coordination, project coordination, facilities support, or a related role.
* Experience supporting senior leadership and managing competing priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Experience managing deliverables, timelines, action-item trackers, reports, and document-control systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple departments, projects, and geographically dispersed work locations.
* Government contracting, facilities maintenance, base operations support, or contract transition experience preferred.
* Experience with Power BI, Smartsheet, Maximo, or similar reporting and tracking systems preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with project staff, Corporate departments, Government personnel, and subcontractors.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
* Must possess and maintain a valid state driver's license and a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy, to operate vehicles or equipment as required for the position.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

* Work is primarily performed in an office environment requiring prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, and frequent use of a computer, keyboard, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
* Must be able to occasionally lift and carry office materials and supplies weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Must possess sufficient visual acuity to review documents, operate a computer, and perform administrative duties.
* Must be able to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and electronically.
* Must be able to work on-call, alternate, and extended shift schedules when necessary to meet mission requirements, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

**Why Us?**

At Tlingit Haida Tribal Business Corporation (THTBC), our work goes beyond delivering exceptional services—we are driven by a mission to create meaningful impact. When you join our team, you become part of an organization that values purpose, performance, and people.

We offer the opportunity to work in dynamic, fast-paced environments where your contributions directly impact mission success. Our teams are built on collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to excellence, ensuring you are supported while being challenged to grow.

**Join us and be part of a team where your work matters.**

**Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* TRICARE Supplemental
* Critical Illness insurance
* Company-Paid Life and Short-Term Disability insurance
* Optional Long-Term Disability
* Paid Leave
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Identity Theft Protection
* Employee Discounts
* Wellness Seminars

For union represented positions, benefits and leave are provided in accordance with the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement.

**Pre-Employment Screening:** All candidates must successfully complete pre-employment screening, which may include a criminal background check, motor vehicle record review, and 5-panel drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to full compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, parental status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodation:** If you have a disability or medical condition and require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please notify the designated recruiter so we can provide appropriate assistance.

b383ed4a953f9f811848.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Full-Time, Remote Telephonic opportunity  
  
  
  
  
The UM Administration Coordinator 2 supports the administration of utilization management by performing a variety of moderately complex administrative, operational, and customer service tasks.
  
  
Responsibilities may include significant telephonic interaction with providers, members, and other stakeholders, including receiving inbound calls, providing customer service, and supporting the intake of utilization management and prior authorization requests. Some associates may be assigned primarily or fully to telephonic responsibilities based on business needs.
  
  
Additional responsibilities may include creating and processing authorization cases, generating correspondence, triaging faxes and shared mailboxes, processing documentation, conducting calculations and data processing, and performing other administrative functions supporting utilization management. Specific work assignments may vary and may change over time based on business needs, volume, and operational priorities.
  
  
Assignments are generally semi-routine in nature.

The UM Administration Coordinator 2 provides non-clinical support for policies and procedures ensuring the best and most appropriate treatment, care, or services for members.

This role may serve as a key point of contact for providers and members through inbound telephonic interactions, including responding to questions and supporting the intake and processing of utilization management requests. Associates must be comfortable working in a phone-based customer service environment, and some assignments may require the majority or entirety of the workday to be dedicated to inbound calls. Other assignments may include building and updating authorization cases, creating letters and other correspondence, processing and routing faxes, triaging shared mailboxes, reviewing and routing documentation, and completing other non-clinical administrative activities supporting the utilization management process. Associates are expected to demonstrate flexibility as work assignments may change based on business needs and operational priorities.

Decisions are typically focused on interpretation of area/department policy and process for completing assignments. Works within defined parameters to identify work expectations and quality standards but has some latitude over prioritization/timing and works under minimal direction. Follows standard policies/practices that allow for some opportunity for interpretation/deviation and/or independent discretion.

Success in this role requires the following:

* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.
* Strong customer service and verbal communication skills, including the ability to professionally manage a high volume of inbound telephone interactions.
* Comfort providing telephonic support while simultaneously navigating multiple systems, documenting interactions, and accurately processing information.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Technical savvy and ability to navigate multiple systems and screens while working cases.
* Collaboration skills to effectively interact with multiple parties, both internal and external.
* Flexibility and adaptability to work across telephonic and non-telephonic utilization management functions and transition between assignments based on business needs.
* An understanding of department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas.
* Ability to make decisions regarding your own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations and with minimal direction, receiving guidance where needed.
* Ability to follow established guidelines, processes, and procedures.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

* 1 or more years of administrative, technical support, customer service, or related experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability and willingness to provide customer service and intake support through high-volume inbound telephone interactions; telephonic duties may comprise the primary assignment
* Ability to simultaneously communicate by telephone, navigate multiple systems/screens, accurately document interactions, and process information
* Working knowledge of MS Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook in a Windows-based environment, and an ability to quickly learn new systems
* Must have accessibility to high-speed DSL or cable modem for a home office
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences
* Ability to adapt to changing work assignments based on business and operational needs
* Ability to work between the hours of 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. EST
* Hours may include rotational weekend work

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficient utilizing electronic medical record and documentation programs
* Proficient and/or experienced with medical terminology and/or ICD-10 codes
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
* Prior member, provider, call center, or customer service telephone experience
* Experience with Utilization Review and/or Prior Authorization, preferably within a managed care organization

**Work-At-Home Requirements**

* Must have the ability to provide a high-speed DSL or cable modem for a home office (Satellite and Wireless Internet service is NOT allowed for this role).
* A minimum standard speed for optimal performance is 25mbs download x 10mbs upload is required.
* Check your internet speed at www.speedtest.net
* A dedicated office space lacking ongoing interruptions so you can meet productivity requirements, and to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

  
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.  
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.  
$40,000 - $52,300 per year

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. 9d5dbdcc6c766500704b.description:
**Overview**

As a Human Resources Payroll Coordinator, you’ll keep payroll and employee records accurate, confidential, and moving smoothly. You’ll coordinate payroll processing, support benefits administration, and help employees and HR partners navigate policies and systems. Your impact: Accurate payroll and responsive HR support help employees receive timely answers and enable teams to focus on their work.

**Responsibilities**

* Process payroll data, review entries for accuracy, and resolve discrepancies in coordination with relevant teams.
* Maintain personnel records and handle confidential information with care; support benefits administration, employee relations, and workers’ compensation processes.
