c84f7f5a51940367463a.title: Medical Front Office Coordinator / Clinical Assistant – Part-Time
c84f7f5a51940367463a.description:
Advanced Foot & Ankle Wellness Center is a busy, established, physician-owned specialty medical practice in King of Prussia, PA.

We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly organized **Medical Front Office Coordinator / Clinical Assistant** to support both front office operations and patient flow.

This is a combination position. The primary responsibilities involve front desk operations, patient scheduling, insurance verification, payment collection, and administrative coordination. The employee will also assist with bringing patients to examination rooms, preparing rooms, and turning over rooms between appointments.

We are a small, patient-centered practice where teamwork, accuracy, initiative, and reliability are essential.

The ideal candidate enjoys interacting with patients, is comfortable working in both administrative and clinical areas, and takes ownership of responsibilities without requiring constant supervision.

**Prior medical office experience is required. This is not an entry-level position.**

Work Schedule

This is an on-site, part-time position with a consistent schedule:

* **Monday:** Approximately 11:00 AM–8:00 PM
* **Wednesday:** Approximately 7:15 AM–3:00 PM
* **Friday:** Approximately 7:15 AM–4:00 PM
* **Every other Thursday:** Approximately 7:15 AM–1:30 PM
* **No weekends**

Approximately 27–30 hours per week, depending on office needs.

Applicants must be available for Monday evenings and every other Thursday. Start and end times may vary slightly based on patient schedules.

Key ResponsibilitiesFront Office and Patient Services

* Warmly greet and acknowledge every patient upon arrival.
* Manage patient check-in, checkout, and appointment scheduling.
* Collect copays, deductibles, outstanding balances, and other patient payments.
* Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and patient financial responsibilities.
* Ensure patient registration forms, identification, insurance information, and required consents are complete.
* Review upcoming appointments to identify missing paperwork or insurance information.
* Maintain accurate patient records in the electronic medical record.
* Assist with patient calls, messages, scheduling requests, and follow-up appointments.
* Coordinate medical records, referrals, imaging appointments, and other administrative needs.
* Assist with daily payment reconciliation and end-of-day responsibilities.

Clinical Support and Patient Flow

* Escort patients from the waiting area to examination rooms.
* Prepare examination rooms for incoming patients.
* Assist with efficient room turnover between appointments.
* Clean and disinfect examination chairs, countertops, and patient-contact surfaces according to office infection-control protocols.
* Help maintain patient flow and communicate room availability to the physician and clinical team.
* Assist with basic noninvasive patient preparation and administrative clinical tasks as trained and permitted by office policy.
* Recognize when rooms need attention and proactively prepare them for the next patient.
* Follow established infection-control, patient safety, and HIPAA procedures.

Accuracy, Organization, and Follow-Through

* Follow established office procedures, workflows, and daily checklists.
* Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within expected timeframes.
* Identify and resolve incomplete documentation, scheduling issues, and administrative problems.
* Double-check work to prevent errors involving insurance, payments, and patient records.
* Coordinate with the physician, clinical staff, and remote administrative team.
* Recognize what needs to be done and take initiative without waiting for repeated instructions.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient work environment.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Previous experience in a medical front office, patient registration, or medical administrative position.
* Experience with patient scheduling, insurance verification, and payment collection.
* Familiarity with electronic medical records.
* Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software.
* Excellent patient communication and customer service skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities in a busy medical practice.
* Willingness and ability to assist with patient rooming, examination room preparation, and room turnover.
* Comfortable moving between front desk and clinical support responsibilities throughout the day.
* Dependable attendance, punctuality, and professionalism.
* Ability to work independently and follow established procedures.

**Preferred:**

* one or more years of medical office experience.
* Previous experience in a small private medical practice or specialty office.
* Experience with both medical reception and medical assistant responsibilities.
* Familiarity with DrChrono or similar electronic medical record systems.
* Experience with insurance benefits, referrals, authorizations, and patient collections.

Medical assistant certification is not required for the duties described, but previous clinical support experience is a plus.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Naturally greets patients and makes them feel welcome.
* Is comfortable working at the front desk and assisting in examination rooms.
* Notices when a patient needs to be brought back or a room needs to be prepared.
* Takes initiative without waiting to be told what to do.
* Understands that patient flow and front desk accuracy are equally important to the patient experience.
* Takes responsibility for completing tasks correctly and on time.
* Double-checks work and pays close attention to details.
* Is comfortable collecting payments and discussing patient financial responsibilities.
* Remains calm and professional in a busy environment.
* Works cooperatively with the physician and other team members.
* Accepts feedback and consistently follows instructions.
* Wants a stable, long-term position in a small medical practice.

Experienced Professionals Returning to Work Are Welcome

We welcome experienced medical office professionals returning to the workforce, seeking part-time employment, or transitioning from full-time work.

Candidates with a background in medical reception, patient registration, medical assisting, or combined administrative and clinical support are encouraged to apply.

We value experience, reliability, professionalism, and a strong work ethic.

Compensation

**$18.00–$24.00 per hour**, depending on relevant experience, qualifications, and ability to independently manage front office and patient support responsibilities.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your medical office experience, particularly in patient registration, insurance verification, payment collection, electronic medical records, and any experience assisting with patient rooming or examination room turnover.

We are looking for a dependable, long-term team member who takes pride in accuracy, patient care, teamwork, and helping a small medical practice operate efficiently.

Pay: $18.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 27.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable performing both front desk responsibilities and basic clinical support duties, including escorting patients to exam rooms, cleaning and disinfecting rooms, and preparing rooms for the next patient?
* Do you have experience working in a medical office, including insurance verification, collecting patient payments, and scheduling? Are you also comfortable bringing patients to exam rooms and assisting with room turnover?
* What hourly pay rate are you seeking for this part-time position? Our advertised range is $18–$24 per hour, depending on experience.
* Are you available to work Mondays 11:00 AM–8:00 PM, Wednesdays 7:15 AM–3:00 PM, Fridays 7:15 AM–4:00 PM, and every other Thursday 7:15 AM–1:30 PM?

Work Location: In person

b160f0eb7c26ea7f11ad.title: Intake Coordinator
b160f0eb7c26ea7f11ad.description:
**Intake Specialist – Home Infusion**

**Location:** Remote  
**Position:** Full-Time Intake Specialist  
**Industry:** Home Infusion Pharmacy

We are seeking an experienced **Intake Specialist** to join our home infusion team. The ideal candidate will have **previous home infusion intake experience** and understand the unique workflow involved in receiving, processing, and coordinating infusion referrals.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring patients receive timely access to their prescribed home infusion therapies while coordinating effectively with physicians, referral sources, insurance companies, patients, and internal clinical and pharmacy teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Receive and process home infusion referrals from hospitals, physicians, clinics, and other healthcare providers.
* Review referral information for completeness and accuracy, including patient demographics, insurance information, diagnosis, medication orders, and clinical documentation.
* Coordinate insurance verification and benefits investigation for home infusion services and medications.
* Obtain prior authorizations and assist with resolving insurance-related issues.
* Communicate with referral sources, physicians, nurses, patients, caregivers, and insurance representatives to obtain required information and documentation.
* Coordinate timely intake and admissions for new home infusion patients.
* Enter and maintain accurate patient and referral information in pharmacy and/or infusion software systems.
* Track referrals from initial receipt through approval, admission, and transition to ongoing service.
* Identify missing or incomplete documentation and follow up promptly to prevent delays in patient care.
* Collaborate closely with pharmacists, nurses, billing staff, and other members of the home infusion team.
* Maintain accurate documentation and follow applicable HIPAA, payer, pharmacy, and company requirements.
* Provide professional and compassionate customer service to patients and referral partners.
* Assist with ongoing communication and coordination for existing patients when needed.

**Qualifications**

* **Previous home infusion intake experience is strongly preferred and highly valued.**
* Experience with home infusion referrals, benefits verification, prior authorizations, and insurance requirements.
* Knowledge of infusion medications, therapies, and common home infusion processes is preferred.
* Strong understanding of insurance terminology and payer requirements.
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple referrals and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable communicating with healthcare providers, insurance companies, patients, and caregivers.
* Proficiency with computers and electronic healthcare/pharmacy systems.
* Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and patient-centered service.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are encouraged to apply:

* Home infusion intake
* Infusion pharmacy
* Specialty pharmacy
* Prior authorization
* Benefits investigation
* Referral coordination
* Medical insurance verification
* Hospital or healthcare intake
* Patient admissions
* Specialty medication coordination

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation
* Benefits package
* Full-time employment
* Opportunity to work with an experienced home infusion team
* Professional and collaborative work environment
* Opportunity to make a direct impact on timely patient access to home infusion therapy

**Join Our Team**

If you have **hands-on experience with home infusion intake** and understand the importance of accuracy, urgency, and excellent communication in coordinating patient referrals, we would love to hear from you.

**Apply today to join our home infusion team**

a7d52dba5ca9e0c1943d.title: Customer Care Team Lead
a7d52dba5ca9e0c1943d.description:
At our company, we move fast, adapt quickly, and turn challenges into opportunities—all while keeping quality at the heart of everything we do. We believe that work should be a positive and respectful place, and that with the right mindset, anything is achievable.

**Our Vision:**

Powering better health through pharmacy care driven by tech, trust and heart

**Our Mission:**

To deliver pharmacy care where access is effortless, care is affordable and patients come first.

**Summary**

This is a critical position requiring excellent customer service, leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills. The Customer Care Team Lead provides day-to-day operational support to advocates while serving as a knowledgeable resource for complex member issues, escalations, processes, and workflows.

The Team Lead is expected to support frontline operations by providing real-time assistance, coordinating escalated member issues, reinforcing processes and quality expectations, and helping ensure members receive accurate and timely resolutions.

This position requires strong knowledge of MCCP processes and the ability to perform and provide guidance on advanced operational responsibilities. The Team Lead works closely with leadership and cross-functional partners to identify process gaps, resolve issues, support associates, and maintain operational continuity. The Team Lead may also assist with calls, tickets, and other work when business needs or service levels require additional support.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide real-time floor and operational support to MCCP advocates, serving as a primary resource for process questions, complex cases, and issue resolution.
* Perform and provide guidance on responsibilities assigned to senior or advanced-level advocates.
* Own or coordinate escalated member issues and complaints, ensuring accurate documentation, appropriate follow-up, and timely resolution.
* Research and assist with complex member inquiries, tickets, account-related issues, and other operational work requiring advanced support.
* Coach associates and reinforce established quality, documentation, productivity, customer service, and process expectations.
* Support queue monitoring and workload distribution to help maintain service levels and operational continuity.
* Assist with inbound and outbound calls, tickets, and other operational work based on volume and business needs.
* Provide clear and accurate guidance using approved procedures, job aids, and available resources.
* Partner with Operations, IT, Quality, Training, Client Services, and other support teams to resolve issues requiring cross-functional assistance.
* Identify recurring member concerns, operational trends, and process gaps and communicate opportunities for improvement to leadership.
* Support new-hire development, cross-training, nesting, ongoing knowledge reinforcement, and implementation of process or workflow changes.
* Build effective working relationships and demonstrate sound judgment, professionalism, and appropriate escalation when handling difficult member or operational situations.

**Education and Experience**

* High School Diploma required.
* Post High School education or specialized training a plus.
* Demonstrated success in an advanced or senior customer care/member services role preferred.
* One plus years’ experience in a customer service contact center environment required.
* PBM, pharmacy, healthcare, or related industry experience desired.
* Demonstrated knowledge of MCCP processes, workflows, systems, and escalation procedures preferred.
* Previous experience supporting complex cases, escalations, peer development, training, or floor support preferred.

**Role Differentiator:**

The Team Lead combines advanced MCCP subject-matter expertise with escalation ownership, associate support, coaching, workload coordination, and day-to-day operational leadership. Unlike a frontline advocate position, the Team Lead is expected to provide real-time guidance to other advocates, assist with complex issues and escalations, reinforce processes and performance expectations, and help maintain operational continuity. The Team Lead remains operationally engaged and may assist with calls, tickets, and other work when needed.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Consistent quality, productivity, attendance, adherence, and professionalism.
* Demonstrated mastery of current-level MCCP responsibilities.
* Successful completion of required MCCP training and applicable cross-training.
* Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex member issues.
* Effective handling of escalations and difficult member situations.
* Ability to provide accurate guidance and support to peers.
* Strong documentation and follow-up.
* Demonstrated coaching, communication, and leadership capability.
* Ability to effectively balance member support with operational responsibilities.
* Readiness to support changing business needs and priorities.

**Equipment and Connection Requirements for Remote Candidates**

* Internet speed minimum: 100 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload, to be verified by HR through a speed test.
* Cell phones to allow VPN push notifications for network connectivity and access to support resources.
* Dedicated workspace to reduce background noise.
* Modem/router must be close enough to connect using a 10-foot network cable; connection must be hard-wired.

**Work Environment / Physical Demands**

This position is in a typical office environment which requires prolonged sitting in front of a computer. Requires hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office equipment including operation of standard computer and phone equipment. May have occasional high stress when dealing with customers/clients. Some travel may be required.

EOE M/F/D/V – WellDyne and HealthDyne are equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

0fc589f868fa3878ce6d.title: C3 Patient Access Resource Specialist
0fc589f868fa3878ce6d.description:
Department Overview:

The C3 Patient Access Resource Staff is responsible for providing the highest level of customer service while handling all aspects of the scheduling of clinic appointments, referral management, visit preparation, patient eligibility, and financial clearance for the Connected Care Center clinical services. This position is responsible for all aspects of scheduling and supporting patient care coordination across multiple clinical specialties. This position will respond to patient Connected Care Center scheduling requests which include but are not limited to, patient phone calls, MyChart or provider requests. The employee in this position promotes OHSU¿s mission statement by delivering high quality, cost effective, patient centered, service excellence.

Function/Duties of Position:

**Customer Service**

* Deliver exceptional customer service to external customers (patients, families, referring providers, insurance carriers, etc.) and internal customers (OHSU healthcare providers and staff).
* Meet or exceed service standards of the healthcare industry.
* Communicate promptly and professionally.
* Demonstrate patient-centered customer service skills.
* Handle crisis situations effectively.
* Utilize available information technology efficiently.
* Process complaints following standard procedures.
* Provide flexible coverage for internal service needs.

**Multi-Specialty Call Processing & Scheduling**

* Answer incoming calls and handle various inquiries related to scheduling, general information, referral status, and care-related matters.
* Transfer calls to Nurse Triage when necessary, following established guidelines.
* Schedule and manage patient access to clinical services in the Connected Care Center.
* Record accurate and detailed information in the electronic medical record (EMR) for telephone encounters, including medication refill requests, complaints, general inquiries, and urgent healthcare concerns.
* Assess and direct calls to the appropriate staff for patient care and needs.
* Process calls promptly, professionally, and courteously.
* Provide callers with relevant information, such as directions, addresses, and operating hours.
* Utilize schedules and departmental procedures to connect callers with the appropriate on-call personnel.
* Follow departmental policies for different types of encounters (e.g., refills, telephone consultations, documentation).
* Schedule patient appointments for Connected Care Center clinical services through various sources, including inbound calls, workqueues, clinical service requests, etc.
* Act as a liaison and information resource for physicians and nursing support staff.
* Return phone messages and send out new patient information packets via mail.
* Direct patients to the appropriate clinicians for healthcare issues.
* Process and route direct referrals to other clinical services.
* Accurately enter patient information into the Epic system.
* Utilize proper OHSU forms and documentation for all patients.
* Collaborate with providers to maintain up-to-date clinic templates and block schedules in Epic.
* Assist with scheduling surgical services as needed.

**Registration, Managed Care, Financial Clearance**

* Ensure administrative and financial preparation of patients prior to their visit by following registration workflows. Gather and verify patient information, including demographics, insurance coverage, and financial status.
* Pre-register patients with accurate demographic data, including race, ethnicity, language, and disability information.
* Conduct financial screening using the Experian tool to determine patient eligibility for financial assistance programs.
* Transfer patients to the appropriate department to address their financial concerns.
* Confirm patient eligibility for healthcare coverage and clarify managed care arrangements.
* Enter all information accurately into Epic EMR.
* Set up reservations and admissions for elective inpatient and day patient procedures.
* Obtain managed care authorizations for consultations, procedures, office visits, and care arrangements when needed. Follow up on pending authorizations until they are obtained.
* Stay updated on managed care insurance plans and serve as a resource for physicians, nursing support staff, and colleagues.
* Provide information on authorization requirements per diagnosis and service to referring physician offices, OHSU Health Plan Office, patients, and insurance companies.
* Maintain proficiency in ICD-10 requirements.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate with other ancillary and clinical services as necessary.
* Resolve patient concerns and managed care-related problems using problem-solving and negotiation skills.
* Create medical record if not already available.

**Visit Preparation & Integrated Care**

* Prepare for patient visits by reviewing established visit preparation items and documenting their completion while speaking with the patient.
* Contact referring providers to obtain any necessary items that have not been obtained.
* Record, track, and verify referrals and authorizations for outpatient clinic and lab visits when required.
* Schedule patient appointments and accommodate walk-ins as needed.
* Obtain prior medical records and studies when necessary.
* Arrange for stretchers, wheelchairs, interpreters, and other special accommodations as needed.
* Send out information packets to patients.
* Provide personal reminders to patients about upcoming appointments.
* Prepare patient for virtual visits as needed

**Referral Management:**

* Process incoming referrals for the Connected Care Center clinical services.
* Verify and update patient demographics, including address, contact numbers, and primary care physician (PCP) information.
* Ensure referrals contain the minimum required information.
* Contact the referring clinic (internal or external) if any of the minimum required information is missing.
* Utilize Media Manager software in Epic to upload documents into patient charts for current medical care or referral purposes.
* Perform document scanning at the point of care, paying meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate placement of records in the patient's chart.

**Training and Competency**

* Engage in relevant educational activities to enhance knowledge and skills for assigned work.
* Attend staff meetings, informational sessions, and other learning opportunities.
* Stay up to date by reading vendor documentation, trade and other relevant publications.
* Collaborate with peers and colleagues to exchange information.
* Successfully complete required initial training and core competency assessment for PAS (Patient Access Services).
* Stay up to date with all required OHSU and role specific modules.
* Maintain core competencies and consistently apply acquired skills throughout employment.
* Act as a resource for PAS expertise and share PAS information with other PAS Specialists in the service area.
* Provide instruction to co-workers on user skills for PAS system software, including Order Entry, EPIC cadence scheduling, and the Radiology Information System (RIS).
* Possess a working knowledge of diagnostic and procedural coding, medical terminology, and maintain familiarity with service-specific practices.
* Fill in as needed for any PAS/R position within the service area.

**Other Duties as Assigned**

* Including, but not limited to the following responsibilities:
* Teamwork and Collaboration: Participates with team members in daily huddle discussing daily work for the team to align with OHSU service standards. Must have strong communication, listening skills and awareness of self. Collaborate with various teams to ensure patient access to care.

Required Qualifications:

* One year of experience in a medical office setting, including high-volume direct patient contact, scheduling of appointments and may require experience obtaining managed care authorizations (dependent on position description). **OR** one and a half years of work experience in a high volume direct public contact position and 6 months experience in a medical office setting. The candidate must have a thorough knowledge of PAS policies and procedures. Candidates will have demonstrated advanced PAS user skills as well as extensive knowledge of integrated care at OHSU.

**Knowledge and Skills Required:**

* Basic computer skills including word processing. Windows applications, on-line scheduling, and a preference for data-base skills. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. Strong customer service orientation. Demonstrated effectiveness in confrontational customer interactions.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Advanced Degree
* Experience working with an electronic health record.
* 2+ years patient scheduling experience.
* 2+ years experience working in healthcare, preferably Urology, Neurology, Neurosurgery, GI, or Imaging
* Medical terminology. Ability to learn new computer sills and systems.
* Experience using Epic

Additional Details:

* Monday-Friday during normal hours of operation.
* This position works in a busy environment with many interruptions, multiple demands and interactions. This position will handle a high volume of patient phone calls, high level of multi tasking, and scheduling.
* This position requires sitting for at least 2 hours at a time. Heavy use of computers and multi-line phones. Ability to lift and carry 25 pounds. Ability to speak clearly, demonstrate patience and understanding of customer needs. Must be able to deal with competeing needs and priorities of internal customers. Must be able to work independently from a remote location.

0cbbc83af399477c8670.title: Acute Patient Access Services Representative Remote
0cbbc83af399477c8670.description:
**Department Name:**

Centralized Pre-Regist-Corp

**Work Shift:**

Day

**Job Category:**

Revenue Cycle

**Hours and Schedule:**

**\*\*All Acute Patient Access Services New Hires are required to attend New Hire Orientation & PAS New Hire Training.**

**Must have Patient Access or Medical/Health registration experience.**

**This role pre-registers scheduled patients at 19 acute facilities within AZ and CO. This position includes verifying insurances, obtaining critical patient information and providing financial counseling to patients prior to date of service.**

  

**Schedule: Monday - Thursday 9:30am to 6:00pm and Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm AZ Time**

**Apply Today!**

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is the first point of contact at healthcare facilities and assists patients with the administrative aspect of gaining access to medical treatment. This position is in a hospital-based setting which includes Emergency Dept, Inpatient, Obstetrics, Outpatient, etc. Responsible for in person patient intake and registration, providing superior customer service, accurately identifying, and obtaining authorizations patients’ insurance, verifying eligibility and benefits, generating patient estimates for services rendered, financial counseling, and collecting patient liability. Demonstrates the ability to resolve customer issues and provides excellent customer service.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Verifies patient’s demographics and accurately inputs this information into EHR, including documenting the account thoroughly to maximize reimbursement and minimize denials/penalties from the payor(s).

2. Proficiency with multiple services including, but not limited to inpatient, observation, emergency, obstetrics, surgery, imaging. This position may cover services 24/7.

3. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of insurance guidelines for all services. Proficiently verifies, reads, and understands insurance benefits.

4. Demonstrates proficient understanding that this position creates the first impression for our patient's experience with Banner Health. Demonstrates a positive patient experience through interactions and effective communication.

5. Proficient understanding of payer authorization guidelines. Accurately submits timely notification according to insurance guidelines using various systems to reduce/eliminate denials. Consistently meets all registration related key performance indicators as determined by management.

6. Obtains federal/state compliance information, consents and documentation required by the patient’s insurance plan(s). This includes a thorough understanding of accurately completing hospital-based compliance forms required by CMS. Uses multiple computer applications proficiently.

7. Consistently discusses financial liability with the patient(s) and/or families that includes: collection in full of patient liability, assisting patient in applying for Banner Line of Credit, setting up payment plans and/or assisting patient with Banner Financial Assistance policy/application.

8. Provides a variety of patient services and financial services tasks. May be assigned functions such as transporting patients, training new hire employees, recapping daily deposits, posting daily deposits, or conducting other work assignments of the Patient Access Services team.

9. Works independently under regular supervision and follows structured work routines. Works in a high-volume, fast paced, clinical environment which requires to ability to be adaptable, critical thinking, and independent decision making and to prioritize work and ensure appropriateness and timeliness of each patient’s care. Primary external customers include patients and their families, physician office staff and third-party payors.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED is required.

Must have customer service skills or knowledge of patient financial services, financial, collecting services or insurance industry experience processes normally acquired over one or more years of work experience.

Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences. Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, database software, and typing ability are required.

Employees working at Banner Behavioral Health Hospital, BTMC Behavioral, and BUMG, BUMCT, or BUMCS in a Behavioral Health clinical setting that serves children must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment. An Arizona Criminal History Affidavit must be signed upon hire.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Associate’s degree preferred.

CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative) certification, a credential offered by the Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA)

CHAA (Certified Healthcare Access Associate) certification, a credential offered by the National Association of Healthcare Access Management (NAHAM)

Knowledge of medical terminology or healthcare systems.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

**Estimated Pay Range:**

$19.45 - $29.17 / hour Banner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting. This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained.

Our organization supports a drug-free work environment.

**Privacy Policy:**

3d4b74c9b39c92ba2fd5.title: Patient Support Services
3d4b74c9b39c92ba2fd5.description:
**Position overview**

The Patient Support Specialist handles inbound and outbound calls supporting Commercial patients across AMC Health programs. The role includes patient registration and enrollments, remote device setup, technical support, troubleshooting, and coordination of equipment pickups. The specialist works with patients, caregivers, Care Coordinators, and internal teams to resolve needs and provide positive patient experience. The ideal candidate brings empathy, clear communication, and dependable follow-through to every interaction.

**Key responsibilities**

Respond to inbound calls and service requests from Commercial patients, caregivers, Care Coordinators, and internal teams, and conduct outbound outreach as assigned.

Explain program services, participation requirements, and next steps, answer questions and address concerns with empathy.

Contact referred patients, determine eligibility under applicable program requirements, and support registration and enrollment, including remote device setup and activation, where applicable.

Guide patients by phone through setup of assigned devices, including blood pressure monitors, scales, pulse oximeters, inhalers, tablets, modems, and Bluetooth enabled equipment, as applicable.

Troubleshoot monitoring devices, connectivity, mobile apps, software, and service issues; resolve routine concerns and escalate complex or unresolved issues.

Coordinate device preparation, replacement, and equipment pickups with internal teams as applicable.

Documentation of outcomes in assigned systems, including CareConsole and Jira.

Follow department procedures, work instructions, privacy standards, and company policies; help develop knowledge articles and training materials.

Meet assigned quality, productivity, service, ticket completion, and patient experience measures, along with registration and enrollment measures where applicable.

Participate in coaching, training, meetings, and projects. Responsibilities are not limited to those listed above and may vary with program needs.

**Required qualifications**

High school diploma or equivalent.

At least one year of experience in a contact center providing customer service, patient support, or technical support.

Ability to handle a high volume of inbound and outbound contacts while maintaining accuracy, empathy, and professionalism.

Ability to guide patients through remote device setup and troubleshooting by phone using clear, easy to understand instructions.

Strong computer skills, including the ability to learn new software quickly and work across multiple systems.

Strong verbal and written communication, organization, attention to detail, and follow through.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred qualifications**

Experience with remote patient monitoring, telehealth, healthcare services, or patient enrollment.

Experience supporting mobile apps, tablets, Bluetooth equipment, or healthcare devices.

Experience with Jira, CRM or ticketing systems, or quality systems.

Bilingual English and Spanish.

**Schedule and work location**

Full time, remote. Operating hours may include Monday through Friday coverage from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET and weekend coverage from 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET. The role may require overtime and weekend rotation based on business needs.

**Physical requirements**

The employee regularly communicates by phone and computer, sits for extended periods, and uses hands and fingers to operate equipment. The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

**Equal opportunity**

AMC Health is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants and employees without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law.

d33b67369d6330541231.description:
**Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Come join our Peak Health team at WVU Medicine as a Supervisor of Member and Provider Services, helping build the foundation of an innovative and rapidly growing health plan. Reporting to the Manager of Member and Provider Services, this position plays a critical role in delivering exceptional telephonic service experiences to our members, providers, employer groups, brokers, and community partners.
  
  
The Supervisor is responsible for oversight of the day-to-day operations of the Member and Provider Services team, ensuring high-quality telephonic customer service while demonstrating operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and achievement of performance goals. This role provides direct leadership, coaching, training, and development for telephonic service representatives while fostering a collaborative, member-focused culture. The Supervisor works closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, enhance service delivery, support organizational growth, and advance Peak Health's mission to improve healthcare through innovation, partnership, and exceptional service.
  
  
In this unique leadership opportunity, you will help shape the member and provider experience, drive employee engagement and development, and contribute to the continued success and expansion of Peak Health.
  
  
Position requires availability Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. during call center operations

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1. High school diploma or equivalent **AND** Three (3) years of experience working in a customer service call center environment **AND** Four (4) years of experience working in Commercial/ACA, CMS, Medicare, healthcare compliance, health plan operations, member services, or related environments.

**OR**

2. Associate’s degree **AND** Two (2) years of experience working in a customer service call center environment **AND** Three (3) years working in Commercial/ACA, CMS, Medicare healthcare compliance, health plan operations, member services, or related environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** **:**

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:**

1. Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, management, communications, or a related field.

2. Specialized courses, training, or seminars directly related to Commercial/ACA, CMS regulations, managed care, healthcare compliance, call center operations, leadership, or business management.

**EXPERIENCE:**

1. Two (2) years of experience in a healthcare, health insurance, or managed care.

2. Two (2) years of experience in a team lead or direct supervisory role overseeing customer service or call center associates.

3. Experience supervising employees in a regulated healthcare, health insurance, Commercial/ACA, CMS, or managed care environment.

**CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

  

1. Oversees daily department operations, ensuring team members consistently follow established policies, procedures, and service standards while maintaining operational efficiency and compliance.

2. Monitor live and recorded member and provider interactions, evaluate individual and team performance metrics, and partner with Team Leads to deliver timely coaching, actionable feedback, and development plans that drive service excellence, quality outcomes, compliance, and achievement of departmental goals.

3. Member and Provider Escalations: Handle complex or escalated inquiries from plan members regarding benefits, claims, or eligibility, and resolve difficult issues for healthcare providers regarding claims, referrals, and reimbursement structures.

4. Ensures departmental operations and member interactions comply with CMS requirements, Commercial ACA, Medicare regulations, Medicaid requirements, HIPAA, organizational policies, compliance standards, and applicable state and federal regulations.

5. Oversees the use of SharePoint and other approved systems to manage team resources and departmental documentation, including updating shared sites, maintaining current policies and procedures, managing access, and ensuring staff can locate required training and reference materials.

6. Demonstrates flexibility in meeting departmental and organizational needs related to changes in call volume, staffing, scheduling, business operations, regulatory requirements, system issues, emergencies, and special outreach initiatives.

7. Identifies on-going continuing education needs of existing employees as well as new employees.

8. Complete annual reviews as well as 90-day review.

9. Keeps staff informed of process, policy and other changes through presentation at regular staff meetings, face to face communication and email correspondence.

10. Participate in meetings with other Peak Health departments to stay current on actions affecting Customer Service and Insurance workflows.

11. Organizes and executes daily tasks in appropriate priority to achieve optimal productivity, accountability, and efficiency.

12. Demonstrates an understanding of healthcare and health plan operations, including eligibility, enrollment, claims, benefits, provider networks, pharmacy coverage, authorizations, billing, grievances, appeals, and reimbursement-related matters.

13. Works with manager to develop and attain quarterly objectives.

14. Demonstrated confidentiality and discretion when interacting with members or about members in compliance with HIPAA and policies and standard set forth by Peak.

15. Demonstrates flexibility to meet the needs of the department or hospital in regard to changes in work volume, planned change, scheduling changes, and emergency call – backs (i.e. weather or disaster).

16. Partners with Quality, Training, and Compliance teams to develop and deliver training, reinforce performance expectations, and address identified knowledge or process gaps. Supports employee onboarding, system access, training, mentoring, and transition to independent call handling

17. Promotes a professional, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable work environment focused on member experience, regulatory compliance, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

18. Participates in the recruitment, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and retention of qualified Member Services representatives.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

1. Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use standard office equipment for extended periods of time.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

1. Exposed to high stress and constant interruptions.

2. Standard office environment.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

  

1. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex healthcare, Medicare, and regulatory information clearly and professionally.

2. Knowledge of medical terminology.

3. Ability to monitor and interpret call center performance metrics, quality results, productivity measures, and service-level data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

4. Excellent Customer Service and telephone etiquette.

5. Strong decision-making, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and analytical skills, with the ability to assess complex situations and determine appropriate actions.

008632ee03b5777e674e.title: Home Care Scheduling Coordinator – Fully Remote (U.S. Only)
008632ee03b5777e674e.description:
**Company:** Home Care Admin Experts (HCAE)  
**Location:** 100% Remote – United States Only  
**Salary:** $30,000–$50,000 per year  
**Schedule:** 30–40 Hours Per Week  
**Job Types:** Full-Time / Part-Time; W-2 or 1099 Opportunities  
**Pay Schedule:** Biweekly Direct Deposit Through Gusto

IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU HAVE A MINIMUM OF SIX (6) MONTHS OF VERIFIABLE, PROFESSIONAL HOME CARE SCHEDULING OR CAREGIVER COORDINATION EXPERIENCE.**

This is **NOT an entry-level position**. We are specifically seeking individuals who have worked in home care scheduling and understand the responsibilities of coordinating caregivers, maintaining client coverage, and managing daily staffing operations.

**Applicants must have direct experience using WellSky, AxisCare, SwyftOps, HHAeXchange, or comparable home care management software.**

General administrative, customer service, medical office, or call center experience alone does not satisfy this requirement.

Applicants who do not meet these minimum qualifications will not be considered.

About Home Care Admin Experts

Home Care Admin Experts (HCAE) is a Florida-based company providing specialized administrative and operational support to home care agencies throughout the United States.

Since 2020, we have supported home care providers with scheduling, after-hours on-call coordination, caregiver recruiting, virtual assistance, and operational services.

We are expanding our nationwide remote team and seeking experienced **Home Care Scheduling Coordinators** who are dependable, organized, professional, and committed to supporting successful home care operations.

**This position is 100% remote. No commuting, office reporting, or relocation is required. Applicants must currently reside in the United States.**

Learn more about our company at www.iheart-hc.com.

Position Overview

As a Home Care Scheduling Coordinator, you will be responsible for maintaining caregiver schedules, managing staffing changes, coordinating shift coverage, and communicating with caregivers, clients, and agency representatives.

Our coordinators play an important role in ensuring that home care agencies operate efficiently and that clients receive consistent, reliable care.

The ideal candidate understands the fast-paced nature of home care scheduling and can independently handle call-outs, caregiver availability changes, uncovered shifts, and urgent staffing needs.

You will work remotely while following HCAE's internal procedures and the operational requirements of your assigned home care agency.

Key Responsibilities

* Create, maintain, and update daily and weekly caregiver schedules.
* Coordinate caregiver assignments based on availability, qualifications, geographic location, and client needs.
* Manage caregiver call-outs, cancellations, late arrivals, and last-minute staffing changes.
* Proactively identify and fill open shifts to maintain continuity of care.
* Communicate professionally with caregivers, clients, agency representatives, and internal management.
* Monitor upcoming shifts and resolve potential scheduling gaps.
* Track caregiver availability and coordinate schedule confirmations.
* Document scheduling changes, staffing updates, and communications accurately.
* Manage incoming scheduling-related calls, emails, and messages.
* Coordinate new client schedules and caregiver assignments as directed.
* Assist with caregiver recruitment coordination and onboarding-related scheduling when assigned.
* Escalate unresolved staffing concerns and urgent matters according to agency protocols.
* Maintain accurate records within the assigned home care management software.
* Complete daily reports, scheduling updates, and shift handoffs when required.
* Protect confidential agency, client, and caregiver information.
* Work collaboratively with HCAE leadership and other coordinators to ensure consistent service delivery.

Minimum Qualifications – REQUIRED

**Applicants must meet ALL of the following requirements:**

* **At least six (6) months of verifiable professional home care scheduling or caregiver coordination experience.**
* Previous experience working directly with a home care agency in a scheduling or staffing coordination role.
* Hands-on experience using **WellSky, AxisCare, SwyftOps, HHAeXchange, or comparable home care scheduling software**.
* Knowledge of caregiver scheduling, open shift management, call-out procedures, and staffing coverage.
* Current residency in the United States and authorization to work in the United States.
* A reliable computer capable of running home care scheduling software and remote communication platforms.
* Dependable high-speed internet and reliable cellphone service.
* A professional, quiet workspace suitable for confidential telephone conversations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational abilities and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize urgent scheduling needs, and work independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain professional under pressure.
* Reliable attendance and availability during assigned work hours.
* Ability to work approximately 30–40 hours per week.
* Ability to follow confidentiality policies, information security requirements, and applicable HIPAA standards.

**Employment history and relevant home care experience must be verifiable. Qualified applicants may be asked to provide professional references or employment information during the hiring process.**

Preferred Qualifications

* **Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus!**
* One or more years of direct home care scheduling experience.
* Experience coordinating schedules for multiple home care agencies or locations.
* Familiarity with private-duty home care operations.
* Prior remote home care coordination experience.
* Experience handling high-volume caregiver call-outs and urgent staffing needs.
* Familiarity with caregiver recruitment, onboarding coordination, or related administrative responsibilities.

Work Schedule

* **30–40 hours per week**
* Primarily daytime scheduling coverage
* Specific workdays and hours determined by assigned agency needs
* Consistent availability required during scheduled shifts
* Fully remote work from within the United States

This is a scheduling coordination position, not a direct patient care or caregiver position.

Compensation

**Annual Compensation: $30,000–$50,000**

Compensation is determined by relevant experience, qualifications, assigned schedule, responsibilities, and applicable employment or contract arrangement.

Actual compensation and weekly hours will be confirmed before an offer or contract is finalized.

**All payments are processed biweekly through Gusto via direct deposit.**

Employment Opportunities & Benefits

Home Care Admin Experts offers W-2 employment and 1099 independent contractor opportunities, depending on the available assignment and applicable worker-classification requirements.

W-2 Employee Benefits

Eligible W-2 employees may receive:

* 100% remote work
* Biweekly direct deposit through Gusto
* **401(k) retirement plan with a 3% company match**, subject to plan eligibility and terms
* Consistent scheduling opportunities
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement
* Support from experienced home care administrative leadership
* Collaborative remote team environment

1099 Independent Contractor Opportunities

For eligible independent contractor assignments, HCAE offers:

* Fully remote contract opportunities
* Biweekly payments through Gusto
* Defined contract responsibilities and service expectations
* Opportunities for ongoing assignments based on business needs

Independent contractors are not eligible for W-2 employee benefits. All arrangements are subject to applicable employment and independent contractor classification laws.

What Makes a Successful HCAE Coordinator?

We are looking for experienced home care professionals who take pride in their work and understand the importance of reliable scheduling.

Successful coordinators are:

* Dependable and accountable
* Organized and detail-oriented
* Comfortable working independently
* Confident communicating with caregivers and agency leadership
* Proactive rather than reactive
* Professional during stressful or urgent staffing situations
* Committed to confidentiality and client service
* Solution-oriented and resourceful
* Capable of managing daily scheduling responsibilities without constant supervision

At HCAE, we believe a strong scheduling coordinator is essential to maintaining quality home care services.

How to Apply

Qualified candidates should submit their resume through Indeed.

**Your resume should clearly demonstrate:**

* Your previous home care scheduling or caregiver coordination experience.
* The home care agencies or organizations where you gained that experience.
* The scheduling software platforms you have used.
* Your relevant scheduling responsibilities and experience.
* Your availability to work 30–40 hours per week.

**Please do not apply if you cannot demonstrate at least six months of verifiable home care scheduling or caregiver coordination experience.**

Visit our careers page to learn more:

**https://www.iheart-hc.com/careers**

Home Care Admin Experts is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, experience, and business needs without regard to legally protected characteristics.

Expected hours: 30.0 – 40.0 per week

Experience:

* Home Care Scheduling: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**

  

##### **The Operating Room Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for managing and coordinating the daily schedules of surgical procedures in the operating room. This role ensures optimal utilization of operating room resources, maintains accurate records, and collaborates with surgical teams to provide efficient and effective patient care. This role is the central link between physician office staff, operating room staff, surgeons, anesthesiologists, nursing teams, surgical vendor teams, and other administrative personnel.** **In this role you will:** * **Coordinate and schedule surgical procedures, ensuring optimal use of operating room time and resources.** * **Create a welcoming, professional environment while engaging with physician office staff, surgeons, anesthesiologists, nursing teams, and other healthcare professionals to verify schedules and efficiently resolve conflicts.** * **Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of surgical schedules, patient information, and operating room utilization.** * **Monitor and adjust schedules as needed to accommodate emergencies, cancellations, and changes in patient status.** * **Proactively identify scheduling conflicts or inefficiencies, communicate with the relevant parties to facilitate resolutions, and implement best practices to streamline workflow.** * **Attend and contribute to daily 5 Day Look-Ahead meetings to ensure any issues are addressed including preventing cancellations and delays.** * **Ensure compliance with hospital policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements related to operating room scheduling.** * **Provide administrative support to the surgical services department, including data entry, report generation, and record keeping.** * **Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.** **Qualifications:** * **High school diploma or equivalent required** * **Previous experience in healthcare scheduling, preferably in a surgical or operating room setting.** **Benefits**

* **Wellbeing support,** including free counseling and referral services
* **Time away from work** programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long- and short-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
* **Savings and retirement resources**, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
* **Additional benefits** for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts

Learn more about Employee Benefits

***Note: Eligibility for benefits may vary by location.***

Our services include scheduling, registration, insurance verification, hospital billing, revenue integrity, collections, payment compliance, credentialing, health information management, customer service, payroll, and physician billing. We also provide full-service revenue cycle management as well as targeted solutions, such as Medicaid Eligibility, for external clients across the country. Parallon has over 17,000 colleagues, and serves close to 1,000 hospitals and 3,000 physician practices, all making an impact on patients, providers, and their communities.

HCA Healthcare has been recognized as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies® by the Ethisphere Institute more than ten times. In recent years, HCA Healthcare spent an estimated $3.7 billion in cost for the delivery of charitable care, uninsured discounts, and other uncompensated expenses.

Description:

**Job Summary**

The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in managing and optimizing transportation and logistics operations for assigned regions and/or customers. This position is responsible for ensuring equipment reaches the correct destination on time while minimizing costs and maintaining operational efficiency. Key responsibilities include transportation coordination and direct carrier booking, vendor management, inventory oversight, and collaboration with purchasing, sales, finance, and project teams. The ideal candidate will possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound financial judgment, and the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Coordinate the end-to-end daily inbound/outbound logistics operations for AV equipment, including Transportation (Linehaul/first/last mile/White Glove, TL and LTL, Parcel, Ocean Imports, and Air Freight), scheduling, RMAs processes, and tracking of equipment between warehouses and to client sites.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including sales, operations, and technical support, to understand client requirements on a shipment per shipment basis.
* Prepare and manage delivery schedules, ensuring optimized routing/consolidations and timely delivery of equipment to multiple locations with approved carriers and agents.
* May require manual BOL entry and tender, or booking through approved vendor TMS/websites. Confirm pieces, weight, and dimensions of all shipments.
* Verify site contact details and keep local offices apprised of ETAs and Exceptions
* Make pre-calls to pick up or delivery location personnel to confirm schedule, notify of, or receive, changes and or updates pre pickup and/or pre delivery, to discuss site surveys, convey order updates and receive final instructions.

* Be an escalation point for transportation vendors and customers. Document operational issues/exceptions with carriers/agents in real time to ensure minimal disruption to client services.
* Ensure proper BOL notation of Overage, shortage or damage (OS&D) exceptions and gather all necessary data for the filing of freight claims.
* Verify transportation quotes are in line with vendor rate agreements/tariffs.
* Negotiate spot rates when needed with transportation vendors within a predefined limit and monitor compliance with service level agreements.
* Audit transportation vendor invoices with correct GL coding for AP including correct pro rating of multiple jobs in the case of consolidated truckloads or airway bills.
* Ensure all transportation vendor invoices are supported by hard copy POD (Proof of Delivery)
* Responsible for following documents control processes and procedures to retain BOLs, PODs, Pre shipment digital photos of freight, Loaded digital photos of freight, and digital photos of freight upon delivery to site.
* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend streamlined logistics procedures to enhance operational efficiency.
* Stay updated on industry trends, regulations, and best practices related to logistics and supply chain management in the AV equipment industry.
* Other duties assigned as assigned by Senior Logistics Coordinators and Management.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize supply chain and transport processes.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills to effectively liaise between various departments.
* Proficiency in logistics software and reporting tools.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining and managing logistics documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, solutions oriented.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and navigate through ambiguity.
* Advanced data entry and organizational skills
* Intermediate PC skills and working knowledge of Office Suite (Excel, Word)
* Fluent in English

**Education and/or Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field, or Equivalent work experience.
* Proven experience (3+ years) in transportation/logistics coordination of high tech/high value freight across multiple locations.
* Strong knowledge of logistics and supply chain management principles and best practices.
* Familiarity with DOT, FMCSA and TSA regulations and requirements
* Proficiency in using logistics management software and tools to track shipments and inventory (e.g., ERP systems, warehouse management systems, TMS).
* Familiarity with AV equipment, including audio systems, video projectors, lighting equipment, and other related technology is a plus.

This role uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. ------------------

The zMedia Center of Excellence team develops and implements marketing campaigns across various Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM) platforms to achieve both brand and performance goals. We are looking for someone energized by new challenges and who is looking to develop the depth and breadth of their skillset. If this sounds like you, join our Media team!

------------------------------------------------------

* Independently manage large, complex performance marketing campaigns across multiple lines of business with minimal guidance (Google Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen)
* Develop annual channel goals and channel strategy to achieve those goals
* Determine network mix and monthly flighting within annual channel budgets

* Collaborate synchronously and asynchronously within our global team across the US, Mexico and India

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 5+ years of work experience in performance marketing with a focus on Google Search, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns with annual budgets exceeding $10M USD.
* Proven ability to effectively oversee channels to drive strong business results
* Innovative mindset with a track record of successfully implementing experiments to improve performance
* Experience collaborating on creative strategy for performance marketing channels

* Detail-oriented with strong quantitative and analytical skills. Experience analyzing large amounts of data from multiple sources and compiling them into insights & recommendations to improve results.

* A strong verbal and written communicator who is comfortable presenting to various key stakeholders and providing routine feedback to junior team members

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.
