8f7aaf0a1c2872bba390.title: Senior Specialist Quality Assurance
8f7aaf0a1c2872bba390.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

***Senior Specialist Quality Assurance***

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

Abbott Point of Care is a global leader in providing critical medical diagnostic and data management products for rapid blood analysis that are intuitive, reliable, and cost-effective.

We have an opportunity for the role of **Senior Specialist Quality Assurance** within our Abbott Point of Care (APOC) team, based at our **Princeton, NJ** headquarters**.** Working under broad supervision, manages the day-to-day compliance with applicable domestic and international regulations and activities related to complaint handling and Medical Device Report (MDR) submissions. Ensures that complaints are reviewed within established timeframes. Responsible for filing Medical Device Reports to the FDA (US), Medical Problem Reports to Health Canada, and Medical Device Incident reports to worldwide regulatory agencies in compliance with regulations for the division's products. Elevates complaints requiring management and Medical Affairs guidance, drives discussions and decision-making process to determine reportability.

  

**What You’ll Work On**

  

* Responsible for scheduling day-to-day activities to ensure timely review of medical event files within established timeframes.
* Ensures potentially reportable complaints are assessed against criteria for reportability and reports are filed as necessary in compliance with worldwide regulations.
* Works closely with Medical Affairs, Technical Support, Complaint Handling, and Complaint Investigation teams to ensure that the appropriate information is obtained from complainants to make sure an accurate and timely assessment of reportability is made.
* Utilizes good judgment and makes timely decisions considering the facts and data at hand;; knows when to escalate to management.
* Coordinates changing priorities
* Uses tools effectively to monitor progress and results.
* Collaborates with international country offices providing data, answers to questions, information for other countries’ competent authorities, metrics, and process enhancements.
* Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments.
* Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, distributors, affiliates and authorized representatives.
* Performs verification of vigilance reports, as well as verification of data compiled for metrics.
* Manages the Reportable Confirmed Malfunction List (RCML) process by running monthly reports and reporting as necessary.
* Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Associate degree

* 2-4 years of experience in the relevant field - engineering and/or technical operational
* Advanced computer skills, including statistical/data analysis and report writing
* Strong communication, teamwork, and organizational skills
* Ability to work in a diverse environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, healthcare, Science field preferred
* Knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations (21 CFR Part 820), GMP, and ISO 13485:2016
* Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model

**Apply Now**

**Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

The base pay for this position is $78,000.00 – $156,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

66d752039db430da51a7.title: Quality & Reliability Engineer
66d752039db430da51a7.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

*Location: Remote - Candidates should be located in Southern California*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for "Most Innovative Housing Concept" and the Best of IBS Award for "Best Home Technology."

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We're building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

**About This Opportunity**

As the **Quality & Reliability Engineer**, you will stand up Frontline's hardware quality and reliability function and run it hands-on. Our connected, field-deployed systems have to work the one day they are needed, so quality is mission-critical.

You will own the loop that turns a field failure into a root cause and a permanent fix - across our designs, suppliers, and contract manufacturer - building the quality process and doing the work, in partnership with hardware engineering, operations, and field support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality & Reliability Process**

* Stand up our FA/RC/CA process - failure analysis, root cause, and corrective action - and the tracking and review cadence behind it
* Define and track quality and reliability metrics to target the biggest issues
* Help define and build and run reliability tests (HALT/HASS, life, environmental, etc.) to catch failures before they ship

**Field Failure Analysis & Corrective Action**

* Own field-failure investigations end to end, from field and telemetry signals to verified root cause
* Drive and verify fixes across mechanical, electromechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems, and feed them back into design
* Partner with field support and operations to quantify failure modes and prioritize reliability improvements

**Supplier & Manufacturing Quality**

* Run supplier issues to ground - containment, corrective action, incoming inspection, and verification
* Qualify new and second-source suppliers and work with contract manufacturers on build quality
* Build quality gates into new product introduction and review design and BOM changes for risk

**Qualifications**

Must-Have:

* 5+ years in quality and/or reliability engineering for physical, deployed hardware (electromechanical, fluidic, or connected-device a plus)
* Demonstrated ownership of failure analysis and corrective action, driven to verified closure
* Direct supplier and contract-manufacturer quality experience: corrective action, incoming inspection, and qualification
* Reliability-testing experience (HALT/HASS, life, environmental) and the ability to act on the results
* Comfortable building process and doing the work in a scaling company, and willing to travel to the field and suppliers

Nice-to-Have:

* Field or operations exposure: debugging deployed systems and working with installers
* Connected/IoT products: telemetry-driven diagnostics and firmware/OTA failure modes
* Familiarity with reliability statistics and PLM/ECO and BOM rigor

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Salary Range: $145,000 - $170,000 DOE
* Company-provided cell phone and laptop
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
* Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
* Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
* Company-provided equipment
* Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
* And much more!

**Join Our Mission!**

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

*Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

bb0014816169f650d763.title: Sales Representative - Cold Caller
bb0014816169f650d763.description:
**U.S.-Based Cold Caller & Website Sales Closer Recurring Commission**

We’re building a fun, ambitious U.S.-based sales team to sell affordable website subscriptions to local businesses.

This is a commission-driven opportunity with serious long-term upside: you earn recurring commission on every customer you personally close for as long as that customer remains active and paying.

You don’t lose your commission after three, six or twelve months. Build a strong book of customers and create monthly recurring income that continues growing with every new sale.

What You’ll Be Selling

We provide professionally designed, fully managed websites to local businesses through an affordable monthly subscription.

Our team handles:

* Website design and development
* Hosting
* Updates and ongoing support
* Customer onboarding
* Fulfillment and technical work

Your job is to speak with business owners, explain the offer, handle objections and close new customers.

Compensation

* recurring commission on every monthly payment
* Keep earning for the lifetime of every customer you personally close
* No cap on commissions
* Additional bonuses for hitting weekly and monthly sales targets
* Performance bonuses for top representatives
* Opportunities to become a team leader and earn overrides as we grow
* Commissions paid on successfully collected customer payments

This is a performance-based sales opportunity, not a traditional salaried position although base hourly pay is also provided.

What We Provide

* Large lead lists of qualified local businesses
* Sales script and objection-handling material
* CRM and organized sales pipeline
* Portfolio and website examples
* Product training
* Fulfillment and customer support
* Flexible working hours
* Supportive, energetic and genuinely cool team
* Regular coaching and sales feedback
* Bonuses, competitions and advancement opportunities

You will not need to find or purchase your own leads.

Responsibilities

* Call U.S. local business owners from the leads we provide
* Identify businesses that need a new or improved website
* Explain our affordable monthly website service
* Deliver demos and presentations when appropriate
* Follow up with interested prospects
* Handle common objections confidently
* Close customers and complete accurate sales notes
* Track calls, follow-ups and outcomes in our CRM
* Represent the company professionally

Who We Want

You may be a great fit if you:

* Are physically based in the United States
* Speak clear, fluent English
* Are confident speaking with business owners
* Have cold-calling, appointment-setting or closing experience
* Can work independently without needing constant supervision
* Are comfortable with performance-based compensation
* Want to build recurring income instead of starting from zero each month
* Are competitive, coachable, reliable and good with people

Experience selling any of the following is especially valuable:

* Websites or web-design services
* SEO or digital marketing
* SaaS subscriptions
* Merchant-processing services
* Advertising
* Home services
* Insurance
* Telecommunications
* Other services sold to local businesses

Schedule

Hours are flexible. You may create your own schedule, provided you call during appropriate U.S. business hours and consistently follow up with your prospects.

This can begin as a part-time opportunity and grow into a substantial full-time income stream for successful representatives.

Long-Term Opportunity

We are looking for people who want to grow with us not someone making calls for only a few days.

Strong performers can receive:

* Larger and higher-quality lead allocations
* Increased performance bonuses
* Exclusive industries or territories
* Team-leader opportunities
* Management overrides
* Input into scripts, offers and sales strategy

How to Apply

Please answer the following questions in your proposal:

* Where in the United States are you located?
* What have you previously sold over the phone?
* How many outbound calls can you realistically make each week?
* Are you comfortable with lifetime recurring commission as the primary compensation?
* Why do you believe you would be good at selling websites to local business owners?
* Please provide a short voice introduction or relevant cold-call sample through Upwork if available.

Start your proposal with the words “LIFETIME COMMISSION” so we know you read the complete posting.

We’re moving quickly and plan to onboard several U.S.-based representatives. If you’re confident on the phone and excited about building genuine recurring income, we’d like to hear from you.

Pay: $15.00 - $18.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid training

Work Location: Remote

c3119a2c53e20c5e3ee4.description:
* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.
* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).

**Operations**

* Provides customers with courteous, friendly, fast, and efficient service.
* Recommends items for sale to customer and recommends trade-up and/or companion items.
* Registers customer purchases on assigned cash register, collects cash and distributes change as requested; processes voids, returns, rain checks, refunds, and exchanges as needed.
* Keeps counters and shelves clean and well merchandised, takes inventory, and maintains records. Checks in and prices merchandise as required or as directed by store manager or communicated by the shift leader.
* Implements Company asset protection procedures to identify and minimize profit loss.
* Ensures compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
* Constructs and maintains displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions as directed.
* Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottom shelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.
* Has working knowledge of store systems and store equipment.
* Provides customer service in the photo area, including digital passport photo service, poster print and creative machine, suggestive sell of promotional photo products.
* Assumes web pick-up responsibilities (monitors orders in Picture Care Plus, fills orders (pick items), delivers orders to customers as they arrive at store).
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring clean, neat, orderly store condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager or assigned by corporate.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evenings and weekend hours
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer to be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evenings and weekend hours.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.
  
  
The actual compensation that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. **Salary Range:** $15 - $19 / Hourly

------------

* ### **Paid time off benefits**
* ### **Employee discount**
* ### **Retirement Savings Plan (401(k))**
* ### **Flexible hours**

13e51424ee0539f44165.title: Remote Patient Care Coordinator & Administrative Assistant
13e51424ee0539f44165.description:
**About the Position**

In Motion Physical Therapy is seeking an organized, personable, and proactive Patient Care Coordinator & Administrative Assistant to support the daily operations and continued growth of our practice.

In this role, you will work closely with the clinic owner to manage administrative responsibilities, coordinate patient care, and create a welcoming and professional experience for both new and existing patients.

An important part of this position involves supporting the growth of the clinic by connecting with prospective patients, following up with referrals, and re-engaging former patients. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can quickly build rapport, confidently explain the value of our services, address questions or concerns, and help prospective patients make informed decisions about their care.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, self-motivated, comfortable communicating with patients, and excited to contribute to the success of a growing physical therapy practice.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Patient Communication & Scheduling**

* Respond promptly and professionally to incoming phone calls, emails, and new patient inquiries, with a goal of responding within five business hours.
* Schedule and coordinate patient appointments while supporting continuity of care and adherence to prescribed treatment plans.
* Follow up with prospective patients, physician referrals, and existing patients to encourage appointment scheduling.
* Re-engage former patients and assist with patient retention and referral initiatives.
* Build strong relationships with prospective patients by explaining the benefits of physical therapy, answering questions, and addressing concerns related to treatment, insurance, and cost.
* Maintain a positive, welcoming, and professional patient experience.

**Administrative & Practice Management**

* Manage and maintain patient information within the clinic's Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
* Create and update patient records, including new patient registrations, discharge information, and WebPT documentation.
* Upload and organize patient documents, including signed progress notes, physician faxes, and other relevant medical records.
* Maintain accurate patient information within the clinic's website backend and email marketing platform.
* Coordinate with the clinic's third-party billing and insurance verification team to obtain insurance benefit summaries and communicate coverage details to patients before their appointments.
* Assist the clinic owner with general administrative tasks and organizational needs.

**Practice Growth & Marketing**

* Support patient acquisition efforts through timely follow-up with new inquiries, referrals, and former patients.
* Assist with developing and maintaining the clinic's social media presence.
* Support patient outreach, referral initiatives, and other marketing efforts to increase awareness of the practice.
* Track and compile monthly and annual reports related to new patient acquisition, scheduling, and key business performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows, patient communication, and overall clinic efficiency.

**Team Communication**

* Participate in regular phone or Zoom meetings with the clinic owner, approximately every one to two weeks, to discuss progress, priorities, and ongoing projects.
* Provide updates on patient inquiries, scheduling, administrative tasks, and practice growth initiatives.
* Communicate proactively about challenges, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Friendly, professional, and confident phone presence.
* Ability to build rapport with patients and communicate information clearly and compassionately.
* Strong time-management skills and ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities.
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative.
* Proficiency with computers, scheduling platforms, and digital communication tools. (Experience with Google Suite is a plus)
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.
* Experience with electronic medical records (EMR), particularly WebPT, is a plus.
* Previous experience in healthcare administration, patient coordination, customer service, or a similar role is preferred.
* Interest in social media, marketing, or small business growth is a plus.

**Role Details**

**Pay/Hours:** Hourly position requiring a minimum of 10 hours per week, averaging approximately 40–45 hours per month. While this role offers a flexible schedule, the ideal candidate must be responsive and available to address all new inquiries and requests within 5 hours of receipt.

**Compensation**: This is a W2 part-time hourly

**Location**: 95% Remote with some training and meetings required in clinic

**Start Date:** 1/4/27

Remote training is expected to begin in December 2026 to help ensure a smooth transition into the role. ***There is also flexibility for an earlier start date for the right candidate.***

We are seeking someone who can commit to the position for a minimum of one year, with the hope of building a long-term working relationship. As In Motion Physical Therapy continues to grow, we would love to find someone who is excited to grow alongside the practice.

**Apply**: Email your resume and cover letter to

Pay: $18.00 - $21.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8.0 – 12.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid training
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

50a1250065f6a528bca2.title: TAX PROFESSIONAL – OFFICE MANAGER
50a1250065f6a528bca2.description:
TAX PROFESSIONAL – MANAGER

**Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC**  
Website: www.dtaylortax.org

**Position:** Tax Professional – Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time / Seasonal  
**Location:** Remote  
**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Position Overview

Dominique Taylor Tax Services, LLC is seeking an experienced, motivated, and client-focused **Tax Professional – Manager** to oversee tax preparation operations, lead tax preparation personnel, and ensure the delivery of accurate, efficient, and high-quality tax services.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge of federal and state income tax preparation, strong leadership and organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

This position requires a hands-on manager who can prepare and review individual and business tax returns while providing guidance, training, and operational oversight to the tax preparation team. The Tax Professional – Manager will play an important role in maintaining the company's professional standards, strengthening client relationships, and supporting continued business growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

**Tax Preparation & Quality Control**

* Prepare and review individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Prepare and review business tax returns, including applicable small business filings.
* Ensure tax returns are accurate, complete, and compliant with current IRS and state tax regulations.
* Identify applicable deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities for clients.
* Review complex tax returns and assist with resolving preparation issues.
* Maintain current knowledge of federal and state tax laws, regulations, and filing requirements.

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Supervise, coordinate, and support tax preparers and administrative personnel.
* Assign client accounts and manage workflow to ensure timely completion of returns.
* Monitor employee productivity, accuracy, and performance.
* Provide training, guidance, and technical assistance to tax preparation staff.
* Establish and maintain quality-control procedures.
* Address operational challenges and escalate complex tax matters when necessary.

**Client Relations & Business Operations**

* Maintain professional relationships with new and existing clients.
* Assist clients with tax-related questions and document requests.
* Handle escalated client concerns and resolve service issues professionally.
* Oversee client intake, document collection, return processing, and filing procedures.
* Monitor filing deadlines and ensure timely submission of completed returns.
* Support client retention, referrals, and business development initiatives.
* Assist with implementing procedures that improve office efficiency and customer experience.

**Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of taxpayer information and financial records.
* Ensure compliance with IRS regulations, applicable state requirements, and company policies.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and secure handling of client records.
* Follow applicable taxpayer data security and information protection requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum of 3–5 years of professional tax preparation experience.
* Demonstrated experience preparing individual federal and state income tax returns.
* Experience with small business tax returns preferred.
* Prior supervisory, team leadership, or management experience strongly preferred.
* Active IRS Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN).
* Strong working knowledge of federal and state tax laws and regulations.
* Proficiency with professional tax preparation software.

5ef58ca280186c7b28f4.title: Plumbing Procurement Operations Specialist
5ef58ca280186c7b28f4.description:
**Position Overview**

Eco Flow Plumbing is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Plumbing Procurement Operations Specialist to coordinate the purchasing and availability of plumbing materials, parts, tools, and equipment. This role supports daily service and project operations by processing purchase requests, obtaining supplier quotes, tracking orders, monitoring material availability, and coordinating deliveries with vendors and field personnel.

The ideal candidate has strong administrative and organizational skills, communicates effectively with suppliers and internal teams, and can help ensure that technicians and project crews have the materials they need to complete their work on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing & Procurement Coordination**

* Process purchase requests for plumbing supplies, fixtures, fittings, piping, tools, and equipment.
* Request and compare supplier quotes based on pricing, availability, and delivery timelines.
* Prepare and submit purchase orders in accordance with company procedures.
* Verify order details, quantities, product specifications, and pricing before submission.
* Follow up on pending orders and purchasing requests.

**Supplier & Vendor Relations**

* Communicate with plumbing supply houses, manufacturers, and other vendors regarding orders and product availability.
* Request updated pricing, product information, and estimated delivery dates.
* Resolve routine purchasing issues, including incorrect items, shortages, damaged materials, and delayed shipments.
* Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and keep vendor contact information current.

**Inventory & Material Coordination**

* Monitor material availability and coordinate replenishment requests with warehouse or operations personnel.
* Track commonly used plumbing parts and supplies to help prevent shortages.
* Coordinate material transfers and deliveries to service locations or project sites.
* Maintain accurate records of inventory requests, received materials, and outstanding orders.

**Project & Field Operations Support**

* Coordinate procurement needs with dispatchers, service managers, technicians, and project coordinators.
* Help ensure materials are ordered in time for scheduled plumbing repairs, installations, and construction projects.
* Track special-order fixtures, equipment, and project-specific materials.
* Communicate order delays or substitutions to the appropriate internal teams.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain organized purchase orders, supplier quotes, invoices, and delivery records.
* Compare supplier invoices against purchase orders and receiving documentation.
* Report purchasing discrepancies and unresolved order issues to management.
* Prepare basic reports on purchasing activity, open orders, and material availability.
* Recommend improvements to procurement tracking and ordering procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, operations administration, inventory coordination, or a related role.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, email, and purchasing or inventory systems.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple orders and meet deadlines.
* Strong organization and follow-through.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a plumbing contractor, mechanical contractor, construction company, or plumbing supply distributor.
* Familiarity with plumbing materials, fixtures, fittings, piping, and common trade supplies.
* Experience preparing purchase orders and communicating with vendors.
* Knowledge of inventory tracking and invoice matching procedures.

**Core Competencies**

* Procurement and purchase order administration
* Supplier communication and coordination
* Plumbing material and product familiarity
* Inventory and delivery tracking
* Cost and invoice accuracy
* Organization and time management
* Problem-solving and cross-team coordination

**Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with a current résumé highlighting relevant experience in purchasing, vendor coordination, inventory management, construction administration, or plumbing operations.**

Pay: $63,700.00 - $76,800.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

d5f6a37bf28a07846a59.title: Operations Manager
d5f6a37bf28a07846a59.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**  

* Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.
* Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill
* Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

  
**Education**

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$19.00 - $29.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

**DATE OF POSTING: November 8, 2026**

**TITLE:** Program Coordinator, Code Enforcement
  
**DEPARTMENT:** Code Enforcement
  
**SALARY RANGE:** $56,631.65 – $88,881.00, commensurate with experience
  
**UNION:** CWA
  
**WORK HOURS:** M-F 8:30 am – 4:30 pm (35 hrs/wk); occasional evenings
  
**EFFECTIVE:** Immediately
  
**BENEFITS:** The Township provides a comprehensive benefits package including

health insurance, dental, vision, paid leave, group life insurance, deferred
  
compensation program, and retirement benefits through the State of NJ Division of
  
Pension and Benefits.

  

**DUTIES DESCRIPTION:**  
  
Serves as office coordinator for the Code Enforcement Department and principal administrative and technical
  
support to the Construction Official, managing permit intake, records, fees, and public information under the
  
NJ Uniform Construction Code (N.J.A.C. 5:23).
  
  
Duties include but are not limited to:

* Coordinates daily office operations, workflow, and coverage; supports the Construction Official,

subcode officials, and inspectors; and helps guide clerical staff.

* Receives and checks permit applications for completeness and UCC administrative compliance,

notifies applicants of missing items, and routes complete applications to subcode officials.

* Calculates permit fees and processes and issues permits and certificates after authorization.

* Serves as liaison with the public, Township departments, contractors, design professionals, and NJ

DCA; explains permit procedures and provides application and inspection status.

* Schedules inspections and coordinates information among inspectors, applicants, and contractors.

* Collects fees, records daily receipts, and reconciles with Finance; monitors the department budget

and prepares purchase requisitions.

* Maintains department records, coordinates retention under State schedules, and coordinates OPRA

responses with the Township Clerk.

* Prepares correspondence and periodic reports; maintains office procedures, desk references, and

department web content.

* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  
**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred. A high school diploma or equivalent with advanced office training and

two (2) years of building permit (or comparable municipal permit, licensing, or records) experience, or
  
an equivalent combination, will be considered.

* NJ DCA Technical Assistant certification strongly preferred; if not certified at hire, must obtain it within

twelve (12) months as a condition of continued employment.

* Valid New Jersey driver’s license required.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, permit software, and web-posting tools; strong organization,

communication, and customer service skills; ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  
Bilingual ability desired.  

Complete the Application for Employment and Submit Resume and Cover Letter Online

http://www.plainsboronj.com/500/Employment-Opportunities

**The Township of Plainsboro is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

8e677cebb5ab7662c5b5.title: Senior Director of Innovation
8e677cebb5ab7662c5b5.description:
IntraFi is a financial services technology company that provides deposit placement and funding solutions to financial institutions across the United States. Through its network-based services, the company helps banks and other participating institutions manage deposit relationships, access funding opportunities, and address evolving liquidity needs.

With a focus on the banking industry, IntraFi operates in an environment where financial expertise, regulatory awareness, technology, and operational reliability are essential to delivering effective financial solutions.

Job Summary

The Senior Director of Innovation will lead strategic initiatives focused on financial product innovation, business process modernization, and technology-enabled growth. This position will identify opportunities to improve existing services, evaluate emerging financial technologies, and develop practical solutions that support business objectives and the needs of financial institution clients.

Working closely with executive leadership, finance, product, technology, risk, and business development teams, the Senior Director will oversee innovation projects from initial research and financial evaluation through implementation and performance assessment.

The ideal candidate combines experience in banking or financial services with strong strategic thinking, financial analysis, and cross-functional leadership. The ability to balance innovation with regulatory requirements, operational stability, and commercial value is essential.

Key Responsibilities

* **Innovation Strategy:** Develop and execute innovation initiatives aligned with corporate objectives, financial services market developments, and long-term business priorities.
* **Financial Product Development:** Identify opportunities to improve banking solutions, deposit-related services, and financial technology capabilities based on institutional client needs.
* **Strategic Planning:** Evaluate emerging technologies, market opportunities, and new business models to support product development and organizational growth.
* **Financial Analysis:** Assess project budgets, financial forecasts, development costs, potential returns, and investment requirements for proposed innovation initiatives.
* **Digital Transformation:** Lead initiatives involving workflow automation, financial data analytics, digital platforms, and operational process improvements.
* **Market Research:** Monitor banking industry trends, competitive developments, financial regulations, and changing client requirements.
* **Project Management:** Oversee innovation programs, establish project milestones, coordinate resources, and monitor execution against business objectives.
* **Risk & Compliance:** Collaborate with legal, risk, and compliance teams to evaluate regulatory considerations and operational risks associated with new solutions.
* **Cross-functional Leadership:** Partner with finance, technology, product, operations, and business development teams to move innovation initiatives from concept to implementation.
* **Performance Measurement:** Establish KPIs, evaluate financial and operational outcomes, and recommend adjustments to improve business value.
* **Executive Reporting:** Present innovation proposals, financial assessments, implementation progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field required. MBA or relevant advanced qualifications preferred.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of progressive experience in financial services, banking innovation, product strategy, digital transformation, or corporate strategy, including senior management responsibilities.
* **Financial Expertise:** Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, investment evaluation, and financial performance analysis.
* **Banking Knowledge:** Familiarity with commercial banking, deposit products, liquidity management, banking operations, or financial institution services.
* **Innovation Management:** Demonstrated experience developing new business initiatives, evaluating emerging technologies, and implementing operational improvements.
* **Technology Skills:** Familiarity with financial technology platforms, data analytics, business intelligence tools, process automation, and enterprise software systems.
* **Risk Awareness:** Understanding of banking regulations, financial compliance considerations, and operational risk management.
* **Strategic Leadership:** Ability to manage complex initiatives, lead cross-functional teams, and translate business opportunities into measurable outcomes.
* **Communication:** Strong executive presentation, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and organizational leadership skills.
* **Work Environment:** Reliable high-speed internet, a professional remote workspace, and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams and financial services stakeholders.

**Job Posting**

**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
As a security first organization, UC Digital Risk & Security (UCDRS) is part of the Digital Innovation & Technology (DigIT) Department. The UCDRS teams include UCOP local and system-wide information security and risk teams focused on providing cyber security services to the UC system. We maintain an innovative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
50% Responsible for managing the daily activities of Security Operations security analysts who plan, design, develop, implement and maintain systems and programs to ensure the integrity, reliability and security of UCOP data and systems, and monitor and respond to threats to the UCOP computing environment. Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.  
  
25% Implements highly complex and broad-scale security controls to prevent unauthorized access or changes to institutional information, information systems, and / or network infrastructure. Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. Investigate security incidents and reports to management regarding the causes and effects. Applies advanced IT security concepts, compliance and regulatory requirements, and policies and procedures to respond to and appropriately escalate security incidents.  
  
5% Additional duties as required  
  
**Experience**  
Required Qualifications  
Min 8 years of related IT work experience.  

Min 2 years of experience managing an information security organization.  

  
  
**Skills and Abilities**  
Required Qualifications  
Ability to lead a highly technical team.  

Advanced interpersonal skills to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.  
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, to include writing and preparing technical and executive reports, briefings, and recommendations.  
Ability to follow department processes and procedures.  
Advanced experience using IT security systems and tools and using those tools to apply security controls in a complex environment.  
Advanced experience analyzing, researching, and implementing threat intelligence and novel security concepts to improve overall security in a complex environment.  
Experience in incident response and digital forensics including data collection, examination, and analysis.  
* Experience with risk assessment, penetration test, and vendor risk management processes.

  
**Education**  
Required Qualifications  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training  

  
  
**Licenses and Certifications**  
Preferred Qualifications  

* CISSP

6b5d88a8032d9b47c379.description:
Senior Director of Strategy

Company: Open Lending

Employment Type: Full-Time | Remote

Position Overview：

Open Lending operates in the digital asset and financial technology sector, an evolving market shaped by blockchain innovation, digital investment products, and emerging financial infrastructure. The company name and specific business operations should be verified before publishing this description.

Open Lending is seeking an experienced Senior Director of Strategy to lead strategic planning, evaluate market opportunities, and develop initiatives that support long-term business growth. This role will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to assess market developments, strengthen business positioning, evaluate strategic partnerships, and translate company objectives into actionable business plans.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute strategic plans aligned with the company's business objectives and long-term growth priorities.

Analyze digital asset markets, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging business opportunities.

Evaluate potential growth initiatives, new business models, and market expansion strategies.

Advise executive leadership on strategic priorities, business performance, and competitive positioning.

Identify and assess strategic partnerships, commercial opportunities, and potential business development initiatives.

Collaborate with finance, product, legal, compliance, and operations teams to support strategic decision-making.

Evaluate business cases, investment opportunities, and strategic initiatives using financial and market analysis.

Establish performance metrics and monitor progress against strategic objectives.

Assess regulatory developments and market risks relevant to digital assets in coordination with legal and compliance teams.

Prepare executive presentations, strategic assessments, and recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Lead cross-functional projects designed to improve operational efficiency and support sustainable growth.

Mentor strategy team members and promote analytical rigor, collaboration, and accountability.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Strategy, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

5+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, financial services, business development, or related leadership roles.

Demonstrated success developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex business environments.

Understanding of digital assets, blockchain technology, financial markets, or financial technology is preferred.

Strong financial modeling, market research, business analysis, and strategic planning capabilities.

Experience evaluating partnerships, new business opportunities, and market expansion initiatives.

Excellent executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to translate complex market information into clear business recommendations.

Strong leadership and cross-functional project management skills.

Ability to manage multiple strategic priorities while maintaining a focus on measurable outcomes.

Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and risk considerations in financial services or digital asset markets is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

50ef3066e4f1bb0d5b21.title: AI Operations & Delivery Manager
50ef3066e4f1bb0d5b21.description:
Most construction and trades businesses run on a dozen disconnected tools, a lot of spreadsheets and the owner's memory. We're changing that with AI. We need someone who loves AI, is technical enough to work with APIs and automations, and is so organized that nothing slips through. If this sounds like you, keep reading You get a little thrill from a clean task board where every item has an owner and a date. You use AI tools every day because they make you faster and better, not because it's trendy. You can sit with a developer, read a basic piece of code or an API response, and know whether it's right. And you'd rather be judged on results than on hours. About us Omadli Group is an AI and data company. We help construction and trades businesses run on one connected system, so their office, field, finance and sales data work together instead of living in separate tools. We're an AI-first team: bots support every seat, including the founder's. People do the work that needs judgment, relationships and care. AI does the drafting, sorting, summarizing and repetitive work around it. Our founder is a CPA with 20 years across accounting, data and AI: numbers have to tie out, processes have to be written down, and "I think it's done" isn't the same as "it's done." The mission of this role Make sure every commitment we make, to clients and to each other, ships on time and at high quality, with AI doing as much of the work as it reliably can. You'll turn sold work into delivered work, run day-to-day operations, coordinate our builders, and give our founder her time back. What you'll own (outcomes, not tasks) - Delivery that lands: every engagement has a clear scope, plan, owners and dates, and ships when we said it would. - A task board you could hand to anyone: one owner, a due date and a next step on every task. - Bot-plus-human workflows: decide what AI does, what a person checks, and which tool fits, then make it standard. - AI quality control: review AI output for accuracy, completeness, tone and numbers before it reaches a client. - Client rhythm: weekly updates, well-run meetings, same-day recaps. - Team rhythm: daily updates, 1:1s and follow-through; coach a small, mostly junior team. - Capacity honesty: know who has room for what and flag overload early. - Security and access hygiene: no credentials in chats or documents; access matches the team. - Working with builders: translate client needs into clear technical requests, then test before anyone calls it done. Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days - 30 days: you know every client, team member and tool; the board is clean; daily updates run without reminders. - 60 days: deliverables ship on agreed dates, every client gets a weekly update, and you've shipped two bot-plus-human workflows with written instructions. - 90 days: the founder spends no regular time on day-to-day delivery, and you have a simple delivery playbook plus estimated vs actual effort data. Must-have - 3+ years in operations, delivery or project management for client work. - Real AI fluency: daily use of LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok), good prompting, and workflows you've built where AI and people share the work. - You can judge AI output and design checks to catch made-up facts and wrong numbers. - A bit technical: APIs, automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make), dashboards, spreadsheets, and reading basic code. - Extremely detailed and organized; you've owned a project management tool end to end. - Clear, confident English for client-facing work with US business norms. - Based in the US, Canada or Europe, with 4-5 hours daily overlap with US Eastern time. - If outside the US: proven experience with US clients or companies. - Good security habits. Nice-to-have - Construction, trades or field-service experience and software. - QuickBooks, HubSpot, Microsoft 365/Teams, Notion, AI meeting-notes tools. - Built or ran AI agents, voice bots or chat assistants in a business. - Coached junior team members across time zones. Who this isn't for - Someone who wants a pure strategy or "AI advisor" role without day-to-day ownership. - Someone who waits to be told what to do next or finds detailed tracking tedious. - Someone who uses AI without checking the output. - Candidates outside the US with no US client or company experience. How we hire Application, 15-minute intro call, strengths assessment, values and experience interview, paid test project, final call with the founder, reference check, offer. How to apply We're hiring for attention to detail. Apply on Indeed with your resume, and answer the screening questions: a) Which US Eastern hours can you work each day? If you're outside the US, which US clients or companies have you worked with, and what did you deliver? b) Describe one workflow you designed where AI and people share the work. How did you check the AI's output? c) Give 3 bullet points on what you'd do in your first week with a messy task board where many items have no owner or due date. d) Which AI tool do you use most, and one thing you wish it did better? Omadli Group welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

Pay: $3,500.00 - $6,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Which US Eastern hours can you work each day? If you are outside the US, which US clients or companies have you worked with?
* Describe one workflow you designed where AI and people share the work. How did you check the AI's output?
* Give 3 bullets on your first week with a messy task board.
* Which AI tool do you use most, and one thing you wish it did better?

*South Key is conducting a confidential search for a Head of Operations for one of its clients.*

**Head of Operations, Wealth Management Service Delivery**  
Remote (U.S.; Eastern or Central time zone preferred) · Full-time · Reports to the COO  
Starting base salary $150,000 plus bonus

**About the company**

We are a growing operations partner to registered investment advisors. Our team works as an extension of our clients' staff, handling financial planning support, investment operations, new business processing and client service so advisors can focus on their clients and their growth.

**The role**

The Head of Operations is a leadership role, accountable for service delivery, quality, capacity and team performance across all of our client firms. You will lead a remote team of 20+ across client service, investment operations and financial planning, and build the team-lead layer beneath you.

You will stay close to daily operations, but you will lead through your team leads and managers rather than doing the work yourself. This is not a working-supervisor role. Over the next year, you will build an operation that can support significant client growth.

**What you'll do**

Service delivery and quality  
- Own timely, accurate delivery across all operations service lines.  
- Set service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures.  
- Track turnaround times, SLA commitments, errors, NIGOs, rework and client feedback, and fix the root causes of recurring problems.  
- Serve as the senior escalation point for significant delivery issues.

Team leadership  
- Lead, coach and develop team leads and staff with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.  
- Run consistent training, performance reviews and accountability.  
- Partner with recruiting to define staffing needs, interview candidates and onboard new hires.  
- Build career paths, cross-training and backup coverage that support retention.

Capacity and delivery economics  
- Keep a forward-looking 60–90 day view of workload, staffing, skills and available capacity.  
- Measure capacity and put the right staffing structure in place, including team-lead and manager roles, as the business grows.  
- Recommend hiring and resource allocation based on demand, service requirements and financial impact.  
- Balance productivity with quality and sustainable workloads.  
- Make sure new client start dates line up with operational readiness.

Process improvement and onboarding  
- Build, standardize and document core workflows while allowing for differences between client firms.  
- Improve workflows to reduce manual work, errors and unnecessary handoffs, partnering with the technology team on automation and system changes.  
- Own operational readiness for new client engagements: staffing, training, workflows and handoffs.

Reporting  
- Maintain a weekly operations scorecard covering quality, service levels, capacity, staffing and delivery risks.  
- Turn performance data into clear actions, owners and deadlines, and own the department's quarterly priorities.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management and staffing decisions. Project leadership alone is not enough.
* Experience overseeing multiple operations functions, such as client service, new business and account opening, money movement, investment operations and financial planning support.
* Experience developing team leads or managers who run their own teams.
* A track record of building and scaling an operation, not only maintaining one: building processes, improving workflows, measuring capacity and putting the right staffing structure in place as the organization grew, with measurable improvements in turnaround time, accuracy, productivity or service levels.
* Experience leading operations or advisor services in wealth management at an RIA. Custodian candidates are welcome if they have led advisor-facing service operations and understand how independent RIAs operate across client service, new business and investment operations.
* Hands-on knowledge of advisory firm workflows: account opening, transfers, custodian requirements, client service and operational accuracy.
* RIA candidates: experience at a firm with more than $500M AUM. $1B+ is preferred.
* Experience leading remote teams.
* Direct, collaborative communication and confidence handling difficult performance conversations.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Salesforce, Redtail and common custodian platforms.
* Workflow automation or process-improvement experience.
* Experience with a structured operating or accountability framework (for example EOS).

**Your first 90 days**

* Get to know the team and each client's delivery requirements.
* Assess immediate service, staffing and coverage risks.
* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths across operations.
* Set baseline metrics and weekly reporting.
* Build a 60–90 day capacity forecast and a prioritized improvement plan.

c085256acd778af3da27.description:
Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, Treasury Prime is a financial technology company that provides the infrastructure connecting banks, fintech companies, and businesses building modern financial products.

Its banking technology platform enables financial institutions to manage embedded banking programs, support payment processing, and establish direct relationships with fintech partners. Through its banking network and software infrastructure, Treasury Prime helps banks expand customer relationships, attract deposits, generate fee income, and manage their financial technology partnerships.

The company operates at the intersection of banking, software, and financial services, where commercial growth depends on strong relationships, reliable technology, and a clear understanding of financial performance.

Job Summary

The Director of Revenue Operations will be responsible for improving how Treasury Prime manages its commercial performance, revenue forecasting, and sales operations.

This position will work closely with sales, finance, marketing, and executive leadership to establish reliable revenue reporting, improve pipeline visibility, and strengthen the processes that support customer acquisition and business growth.

We are looking for an experienced revenue operations professional who understands the financial realities of selling technology to banks and financial institutions. The right candidate should be comfortable working with complex sales cycles, analyzing revenue performance, and helping commercial teams make better decisions based on accurate financial and operational data.

Key Responsibilities

**Revenue Operations Management**

Oversee revenue operations processes across sales, business development, and customer account management. Establish consistent practices for opportunity tracking, revenue reporting, and commercial performance measurement.

**Revenue Forecasting and Financial Analysis**

Partner with finance leadership to develop revenue forecasts, evaluate sales performance, and monitor recurring revenue, contract values, and customer profitability. Identify changes in financial performance and provide recommendations to senior management.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

Maintain accurate visibility into the sales pipeline, including opportunities involving banks, fintech companies, and enterprise clients. Evaluate conversion rates, deal progression, and sales cycle performance to support more reliable forecasting.

**CRM and Business Systems**

Manage the effectiveness of Salesforce and related revenue operations tools. Improve data accuracy, reporting standards, workflow automation, and coordination between commercial and financial systems.

**Commercial Performance**

Analyze customer acquisition costs, sales productivity, revenue growth, and account performance. Work with commercial leadership to identify operational improvements and opportunities to increase revenue efficiency.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

Coordinate with finance, sales, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure revenue processes remain consistent from initial business development through contract execution and ongoing account management.

**Strategic Planning**

Support annual revenue planning, sales capacity analysis, commercial budgeting, and performance reviews. Provide financial and operational insights that help leadership evaluate business priorities and allocate resources effectively.

**Executive Reporting**

Prepare revenue reports, financial performance summaries, and commercial forecasts for executive leadership. Present findings clearly and identify areas requiring management attention.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or relevant advanced qualification is preferred.

**Professional Experience**

A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, financial planning, business operations, or commercial strategy. Previous experience managing revenue operations within a financial technology, banking software, or enterprise SaaS company is strongly preferred.

**Financial Expertise**

Strong knowledge of revenue forecasting, financial modeling, budgeting, revenue recognition principles, profitability analysis, and financial performance reporting.

**Revenue Operations Experience**

Extensive experience with sales pipeline management, CRM administration, commercial reporting, sales performance analysis, and revenue planning. Candidates should understand how long enterprise sales cycles affect forecasting and business performance.

**Technical Skills**

Advanced proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, financial reporting tools, and business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI. Experience with SQL and revenue analytics systems is highly desirable.

**Industry Knowledge**

Understanding of financial technology, banking partnerships, embedded finance, payment processing, or enterprise financial software is preferred.

**Leadership and Communication**

Demonstrated ability to work with executive leadership, finance teams, and commercial departments. Strong analytical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to turn complex financial data into practical business recommendations are essential.
