075a210378cfbcec86de.title: Senior Manager, HR Technology and People Operations
075a210378cfbcec86de.description:
SEE how you can make a difference! Be part of an innovative company that cares about its associates and helps members enjoy the wonders of sight through healthy eyes and vision.
  
  
About Versant Health
  
  
Versant Health is a leading managed vision care company dedicated to making healthy vision a reality for everyone. Through our Davis Vision® and Superior Vision® networks, our purpose is to make healthy vision a reality for everyone by improving access to care and education in the communities we serve. Fueled by our mission to improve members' lives with easy-to-use vision benefits rooted in choice, value, and care, we believe that everyone has the power to become anything they set their sights on.
  
  
Position Summary
  
We are seeking a Senior Manager, HR Technology & People Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our HR technology ecosystem and key People Operations functions.
  
This role serves as the business owner and subject matter expert for Dayforce and related HR platforms, with responsibility for ensuring our HR systems, workforce data, payroll-related processes, controls, and workflows are accurate, secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.
  
The Senior Manager will partner across People & Culture, Finance, Information Technology, Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and external providers to strengthen governance, reduce risk, improve processes, and deliver an effective employee and manager experience.
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced HR technology and operations leader to shape how technology, data, payroll governance, and People Operations work together across the organization.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Lead HR Technology Strategy & Governance
  

* Lead the HR technology strategy and roadmap in alignment with organizational and People & Culture priorities.
* Serve as business owner and primary subject matter expert for Dayforce and related HR technology platforms.
* Establish governance for system configuration, integrations, releases, testing, security, data, workflows, documentation, and change management.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technology, automation, reporting, integration, and process solutions.
* Advise leadership on system capabilities, risks, dependencies, regulatory considerations, and investment priorities.

Own HR Systems, Security & Data Governance
  

* Direct the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Dayforce across HR, Payroll, Time and Attendance, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Onboarding, Workforce Management, and reporting.
* Oversee security roles, user access, workflows, integrations, organizational structures, business rules, and system controls.
* Lead system releases, enhancements, testing, production changes, complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and vendor escalation.
* Establish data governance and quality standards to protect the accuracy, completeness, consistency, security, and integrity of workforce data.
* Partner with Information Security and GRC on access reviews, least-privilege practices, segregation of duties, system risk, and remediation.

Strengthen Payroll & Payroll Tax Governance
  

* Provide governance and oversight for payroll operations to support accurate, timely, controlled, and compliant payroll processing.
* Oversee payroll readiness, calendars, controls, exception management, approvals, escalations, and payroll-impacting system configuration.
* Provide governance over payroll tax administration, including tax setup, registrations, agency notices and issues, filing-related activities, remediation, and vendor escalation.
* Identify recurring payroll and tax issues and drive sustainable resolution through root cause analysis, clearly defined ownership, and documented controls.
* Partner with Payroll, Finance, and external providers on reconciliations, reporting, funding, General Ledger requirements, and compliance obligations.

Lead People Operations & Continuous Improvement
  

* Provide leadership for assigned People Operations processes, ensuring accurate execution, compliance, strong controls, and effective employee service.
* Establish operating procedures, service standards, process ownership, escalation protocols, quality controls, and business continuity practices.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process maps, checklists, control documentation, and cross-training for business-critical processes.
* Build team capability through coaching, knowledge transfer, clear performance expectations, and functional leadership.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations, payroll, payroll tax, HR technology, and workforce data matters.
* Drive simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across HR technology and People Operations.

Deliver Workforce Reporting, Controls & Audit Readiness
  

* Lead workforce reporting and analytics across headcount, turnover, retention, hiring, payroll, labor costs, time and attendance, and other workforce measures.
* Establish standardized reporting definitions, validation, reconciliation, and quality-control processes.
* Support internal and external audits, financial controls, benefits audits, security reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify technology, data, process, and control risks and lead remediation efforts.
* Translate technical, payroll, compliance, and workforce information into clear, decision-ready recommendations for leadership.

Manage Vendors & Cross-Functional Delivery
  

* Manage HR technology, payroll, payroll tax, background screening, and other People Operations providers, including service performance, risks, escalations, and contractual obligations.
* Evaluate vendor solutions and operating changes for privacy, security, compliance, data access, integration, and business continuity considerations.
* Lead complex projects from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, change management, stabilization, and transition to operations.
* Coordinate dependencies and decisions across People & Culture, Finance, IT, Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and external providers.

What You’ll Bring
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in HR technology, HRIS, People Operations, payroll, or related functions.
* At least 3 years of leadership, people management, or significant enterprise program ownership experience.
* Demonstrated experience working with enterprise HCM platforms and complex HR technology environments.
* Strong analytical, project leadership, vendor management, communication, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to translate complex technology, data, payroll, and compliance matters into practical business recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Hands-on Dayforce experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with multi-state payroll and payroll tax administration.
* Experience with HR technology integrations, system security, workforce reporting, controls, data governance, and audit support.
* Advanced degree preferred.
* Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, CPP, PMP, Prosci, or a comparable credential preferred.

What Success Looks Like
  
In this role, you will help create an HR technology and People Operations environment that is:
  

* Reliable: Workforce and payroll data are accurate, timely, and trusted.
* Controlled: Security, access, payroll, tax, and operational processes have clear governance and accountability.
* Scalable: Systems and processes support organizational growth and evolving business needs.
* Efficient: Manual work and unnecessary complexity are reduced through standardization and automation.
* Insightful: Leaders have access to reliable workforce information that supports better decisions.
* Employee-focused: Technology and processes make it easier for employees, managers, and People & Culture teams to get work done.

**Key Areas of Accountability:** HR Technology | Dayforce | People Operations | Payroll & Tax Governance | Workforce Analytics | Controls & Compliance | Vendor Governance
  
  
Versant Health provides vision care to 38 million members nationwide! To ensure your continued success we provide opportunities for advancement and development. Our associates remain engaged through a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes health and dental insurance, tuition reimbursements, 401(k) with company match, pet insurance and FREE vision insurance for you and your family

eabbf9e603c1a299c613.title: Claims & Recovery Manager
eabbf9e603c1a299c613.description:
Zeeba operates a growing national fleet of commercial vehicles across multiple U.S. markets. We are hiring a Senior Subrogation and Claims Specialist to own recovery and the insurance interface end to end, treating recovery with discipline and urgency. This role owns the claims lifecycle from first notice through resolution: liability and coverage decisions, repair review, total loss versus repair decision input, and aggressive recovery across insurance, customer, and subrogation channels. It is currently a hands-on operator role, not a process-design or oversight-only seat. The successful candidate is direct, organized, and persistent, comfortable holding carriers, shops, and at-fault parties accountable, and able to build rapport that expedites recovery while escalating when needed.

### **About Zeeba Automotive Group Inc**

Zeeba is a leading fleet management company dedicated to providing our clients with the best solutions for their transportation needs. Our Services Include vehicle acquisition, maintenance and repair, fuel management, telematics, and compliance, all aimed to help fleet managers to optimize their fleet operations.

Our mission is to help reduce the carbon footprint we all leave on this planet when we use inefficient modes of transportation. Why use multiple vehicles for the same journey when one vehicle can transport the same group of people to their destination. Our vehicles help keep the environment clean by reducing the number of vehicles on the road, and our white-glove service along with our latest state-of-the-art technology sets us apart from others. We want to create solutions where the customer wins, the community wins, and the company wins.

Our Core Values:

Integrity: Doing the right thing is always the right thing to do.

Accountability: Leadership starts from being on the ground floor and in the trenches.

Respect: Empathy is at our core, and identifying others' needs is how we operate in servant leadership.

Flexibility: We aren't stuck in our ways, and we understand the changing times. We must adapt to meet the needs of our customers.

Community: Community is when there is common unity. We are here to connect others who want to connect with experiences.

### **Description**

**Primary Areas of Ownership**

* Claims lifecycle end to end: first notice, liability and coverage decisions, and resolution.
* Recovery across insurance, customer, and subrogation channels.
* Repair estimate and supplement review, including catching inflated or improper repairs.
* Total loss versus repair decisioning tied to asset value and residual.
* Carrier and adjuster relationships, and the escalation path when needed
* Customer Certificate of Insurance (COI) review.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own claims from first notice through resolution, making liability and coverage decisions with documentation and discipline.
* Prepare and pursue subrogation like litigation: evidence, documentation, and timelines, using rapport to expedite and escalate when needed.
* Review repair estimates, photos and supplements for accuracy and quality.
* Review final repair work checking for quality and verify repair process completion.
* Make repair versus total loss decisions based on asset value, residual, and reconditioning economics, negotiating repair costs directly.
* Maximize recovery yield across insurance, customer, and subrogation, reducing leakage.
* Maintain carrier and vendor relationships that speed cycle time, and hold them accountable on quality, cost, and responsiveness.
* Track and report recovery metrics, cycle time, and outstanding claims for executive visibility.

**Preventative Systems**

Beyond resolving claims, this role builds the systems that help mitigate them and protect recoverable value:

* Pre and post-rental inspection standards with documented proof of condition, to properly assign and support liability when damage occurs.
* Repair network scorecards and audits to identify vendor specific quality or integrity concerns.
* Monitor repairs to identify vehicle specific damage trends, collaborate with Fleet Operations and Customer Success teams to help reduce repeat claims.
* Monitor and escalate open and aging claims to determine actions needed to push for resolution.
* Monitor customer specific files to identify opportunities to communicate and inform them on claims reducing strategies for safer fleet management.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Recovery yields across all insurance claims.
* Subrogation cycle time and collection rate.
* Leakage reduction on total loss and repair evaluations.
* Repair estimate reductions.
* Reduction of aging claim closure days.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

**Experience.** Multiple years in claims, subrogation, and recovery, ideally in fleet, rental, leasing, or auto insurance. Track record owning claims end to end and driving recovery.

**Skills.** Claims and coverage knowledge, subrogation discipline, repair estimate review, total loss evaluation, carrier negotiation, and documentation rigor.

**Preferred background.** Strong claims and recovery experience in a vehicle-centric business.

**Travel:** Must be willing and able to travel 15% to 20% across the U.S. when required.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This role is structured as a revenue-generating position. Earnings scale with recovery performance and are not capped.

**Base Salary**: $70,000 to $75,000 based on experience

**Performance Incentive:** Paid quarterly, tied to role KPIs. Because recovery is long-tail, incentives pay quarterly as claims resolve rather than monthly.

**Incentive is earned on:** A percentage of insurance and subrogation dollars actually recovered, paid on collected amounts, not claimed amounts.

**Total Possible Yearly Compensation**: $105,000 to $120,000. Specific percentages and KPI thresholds will be finalized in a working session using actual claims data.

All incentive is paid quarterly on confirmed, collected dollars, reconciled against accounting.

**Also included:**

* Annual performance bonus
* Equity participation based on company programs and role level
* Employer-paid health coverage, paid time off, and company holidays
* Travel reimbursement

#### **Salary**

$70,000 - $75,000 per year

We’re looking for an experienced and approachable Director of Operations to manage the day-to-day operations of our financial services business. You’ll help teams stay organized, improve how work gets done, and make sure clients receive consistent, reliable service. This is a hands-on role for someone who can see the bigger picture while staying close enough to the details to understand where support is needed.

You’ll work with department leaders to set priorities, assign responsibilities, and keep important work moving. You’ll keep senior leadership informed about operational performance, costs, staffing needs, and emerging challenges. The right candidate will have several years of financial services operations experience, including responsibility for managing people and improving processes. You should understand the importance of accuracy, confidentiality, and timely communication in a regulated environment. Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work across departments are essential.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who takes ownership, listens carefully, and treats people with respect. You don’t need to arrive with every answer, but you should be willing to ask good questions, learn the business, and help the team move forward.

40afb71137572749d929.title: Program Delivery Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution
40afb71137572749d929.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana’s Consumer Product Management team is seeking an experienced Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, to join working remote anywhere in the US. In this role, you'll serve as a critical delivery connector across Insurance Product Management, Growth and Strategy, and the functional teams responsible for bringing Medicare Advantage products to market. You'll translate portfolio priorities into structured programs, clear milestones and coordinated workstreams that support accurate, timely and compliant execution. If you enjoy turning big-picture strategy into well-managed programs and helping teams deliver successfully, this role is for you.

As the Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, you'll lead complex bid initiatives and enterprise projects that span product strategy, benefit design, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, technology and process enablement. This includes coordinating initiatives such as benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, plan naming, service area expansion and the evaluation of new product and benefit opportunities.

You'll also help strengthen how Product Management operates. You'll establish practical delivery disciplines, maintain governance and program documentation, improve processes and tools, and provide timely training as requirements change. Through research, analysis and cross-functional leadership, you'll help teams understand complex issues, evaluate implications and move toward clear, executable decisions.

This is a highly collaborative individual-contributor role for someone who can create clarity from ambiguity, lead complex work without relying on formal authority and keep multiple teams aligned through demanding Medicare Advantage and CMS delivery cycles.

**Key Role Functions**

**Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Initiatives**

* Partner with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management and functional teams to define objectives, scope, deliverables, decision points and measures of success for bid-related initiatives
* Lead coordinated delivery of initiatives involving benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, product guiding principles and other enterprise or portfolio priorities
* Translate strategic direction into executable workplans, milestones, dependencies, ownership and decision requirements
* Establish delivery approaches that create consistency across portfolios while allowing for appropriate product, market and regulatory differences
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions needed to evaluate options, surface tradeoffs and move initiatives toward timely decisions
* Monitor initiative progress and ensure key decisions, dependencies and risks are identified before they affect bid submissions or downstream implementation
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future bid and product cycles

**Lead Feasibility Assessment and Decision Support**

* Lead structured evaluation of proposed products, benefits and portfolio opportunities across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology, system and financial considerations
* Define the questions, information and functional expertise needed to assess whether an opportunity can be executed accurately and within required timelines
* Bring together subject-matter experts to identify dependencies, constraints, assumptions, unresolved questions and downstream impacts
* Distinguish between identified facts, assumptions and areas requiring additional validation so leaders can make informed decisions
* Develop clear recommendations and decision-support materials that explain options, risks, tradeoffs and execution implications
* Facilitate alignment among partners with different priorities while recognizing that final product, financial or strategic decisions remain with the appropriate accountable leaders
* Maintain documentation of recommendations, decisions, rationale, owners and follow-up actions

**Lead Enterprise Research and Product Impact Analysis**

* Lead research and analysis related to Stars, Clinical, Regulatory Compliance, the Complaints Tracking Module and other enterprise priorities affecting Medicare Advantage products
* Identify relevant product, member, regulatory, operational and delivery implications
* Synthesize complex information into concise findings, recommendations and decision points for Product Management leaders and partner teams
* Evaluate how enterprise initiatives could affect benefit design, product processes, portfolio priorities, filings, systems or the member experience
* Serve as the Product Management program delivery lead on assigned enterprise initiatives
* Coordinate Product Management participation, consolidate feedback and ensure Product requirements and impacts are represented accurately
* Communicate conclusions, open questions and recommended actions in a format appropriate for working teams and senior leaders

**Own Program Governance and Delivery Discipline**

* Maintain program documentation for active portfolio opportunities, including objectives, scope, status, decisions, risks, dependencies, accountable owners and next steps
* Gather requirements and prepare backlog opportunities so they are sufficiently defined for prioritization and future planning
* Establish appropriate governance routines, status reporting, decision logs, risk tracking and escalation approaches for assigned initiatives
* Create clear visibility into program health, milestone performance, unresolved decisions and delivery risks
* Ensure commitments and decisions are documented and communicated to affected teams
* Provide concise and actionable updates to Product Management leaders and cross-functional stakeholders

**Improve Processes, Tools and Ways of Working**

* Partner with Process Improvement, Program Delivery and Product Management teams to create, maintain and improve process documentation, templates, workflows and delivery standards
* Evaluate existing processes to identify unclear handoffs, unnecessary complexity, recurring defects, manual activity and opportunities for standardization
* Lead implementation of practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency, transparency and user experience
* Identify opportunities to use tools such as Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot, SharePoint and other approved technologies to reduce administrative work and improve access to information
* Partner with technology and process owners to evaluate solutions and support responsible implementation
* Establish appropriate controls, documentation and ownership so process improvements are sustainable
* Measure the effectiveness of changes and adjust approaches based on user feedback and delivery results

**Build Product Management Capability**

* Provide timely training, guidance and support to Product Managers as processes, tools, systems and requirements change
* Translate complex process or regulatory changes into clear instructions, practical examples and job aids
* Determine the appropriate training approach based on the complexity, timing and impact of the change
* Facilitate working sessions that help teams understand new expectations and apply them consistently
* Provide technical and process guidance to associates working across related programs and workstreams
* Reinforce disciplined documentation, milestone management, issue escalation and adoption of standard processes
* Gather feedback after implementation and refine training or documentation where additional clarity is needed

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional healthcare experience
* 7+ years of relevant healthcare, health plan, product management, or related experience
* Demonstrated experience leading complex projects, programs or processes across multiple functional areas
* Experience establishing delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, governance and risk-management approaches
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive alignment without formal authority
* Experience researching complex business, regulatory or operational topics and translating findings into clear recommendations
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish facts, assumptions, risks and unresolved questions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for working teams, functional partners and senior leaders
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver through ambiguity, changing requirements and compressed timelines
* Advanced proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and related digital collaboration tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medicare Advantage product management, program delivery, implementation or operational experience
* Experience with the annual Medicare Advantage bid cycle, benefit design, service-area expansion or product implementation
* Knowledge of CMS Medicare Advantage requirements, bid processes, PBP or HPMS
* Experience evaluating product or benefit feasibility across regulatory, operational, system, clinical and financial considerations
* Knowledge of Stars, the Complaints Tracking Module, member experience or regulatory compliance programs
* Experience developing or managing enterprise milestone calendars, governance routines, decision logs or program dashboards
* Experience with process documentation, workflow design, training development or change enablement
* Experience using Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot or similar tools to improve processes, reporting or administrative efficiency
* Process improvement experience or training, including Lean, Six Sigma or another structured improvement methodology
* Experience presenting complex findings, recommendations and program risks to senior leaders

**Additional Information**

* **This role typically operates on Eastern Standard Time business hours.**
* **The work follows the annual Medicare Advantage and CMS regulatory cycle. Certain periods of the year require additional flexibility, including extended hours and occasional weekend work, to meet critical regulatory and business deadlines**

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Create clarity from complexity.** Translate broad portfolio priorities, regulatory requirements and enterprise initiatives into clear objectives, deliverables, milestones and accountability
* **Connect strategy to execution.** Help teams understand how bid initiatives, benefit decisions and process changes support portfolio goals, member value and operational readiness
* **Lead without relying on authority.** Build alignment, maintain momentum and create shared accountability across teams with different responsibilities and priorities
* **Use sound judgment.** Evaluate complex issues across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology and financial considerations and clearly explain the reasoning behind recommendations
* **Enable good decisions.** Bring together the right information and expertise, clarify tradeoffs and help accountable leaders reach timely, executable decisions
* **Anticipate rather than react.** Identify dependencies, risks and emerging requirements early enough for teams to respond effectively
* **Deliver reliably.** Maintain accurate plans, governance records and milestone calendars and follow through until commitments are completed or appropriately escalated
* **Communicate for the audience.** Provide the right level of information to working teams, functional partners and senior leaders at the right time
* **Keep work simple.** Reduce unnecessary complexity, clarify ownership and use technology to make processes easier, faster and more reliable
* **Strengthen the operating model.** Leave processes, tools, documentation and delivery standards stronger and more sustainable after each initiative
* **Learn and adapt.** Use feedback, performance information and lessons learned to improve future planning and execution
* **Maintain a member-centered perspective.** Consider how product and delivery decisions ultimately affect the clarity, quality and reliability of the member experience

**How You'll Lead**

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You'll model Humana's values by being Caring, Curious and Committed, and you'll put the Humana Way into practice by living the Golden Rule, keeping work simple, playing to win, keeping your eyes on the horizon and playing as one team.

You'll listen before assuming, seek diverse perspectives and remain open to learning. You'll turn complexity into clarity, focus teams on meaningful outcomes and identify opportunities to replace manual work with technology-enabled solutions. You'll establish clear endpoints, anticipate risks and adjust as conditions change. You'll explain recommendations and decisions transparently, build trust across organizational boundaries and create shared accountability for outcomes that help people achieve their best health.

**Role Expectations**

* Operate with substantial independence within established Product Management, Medicare Advantage, regulatory and enterprise strategies
* Serve as a subject-matter resource for complex program delivery, bid enablement, process activation and cross-functional execution
* Determine the appropriate methods, delivery approach, priorities and timelines for assigned programs with minimal instruction
* Exercise independent judgment on complex program and delivery issues while recognizing when decisions must be elevated to accountable leaders
* Lead through influence and technical guidance rather than through direct people-management authority
* Direct and coordinate the work of cross-functional contributors for assigned initiatives while remaining accountable for program integration and delivery
* Manage multiple complex programs and workstreams with competing timelines, stakeholders and dependencies
* Translate complex research, regulatory information and functional input into clear recommendations and execution plans
* Influence functional strategies and operating practices by identifying recurring issues and recommending sustainable improvements
* Maintain a forward-looking view of program needs while remaining accountable for near-term milestones and deliverables
* Use advanced digital tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and approved automation or reporting platforms, to manage work and communicate effectively
* Adapt quickly as priorities, requirements and business conditions change

**Key Partnerships & Reporting Relationship**

You'll report to the Director, Insurance Product Management and work closely with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management, Process Improvement and Program Delivery, Stars, Clinical, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other enterprise and functional partners.

This role does not have direct people-management responsibility; however, you'll lead through cross-functional influence and program ownership.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.  
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.  
$115,200 - $158,400 per year  
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-11-2026

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

f21f682e052c9fe8245b.description:
Environmental Technician – Asbestos, Lead & Mold

*California | Field-based, with remote administrative work as assigned*

About McKenna Environmental, Inc. (MEI)

MEI is an established environmental consulting company serving industrial, commercial, municipal, and institutional clients, with occasional residential assignments. We provide environmental assessment, sampling, and monitoring services and value responsive client service, technical accuracy, collaboration, and continued professional development. MEI does not perform asbestos, lead, or mold abatement or remediation.

Position Summary

The Environmental Technician performs field investigations, environmental sampling, documentation, and related project monitoring for suspected asbestos-containing materials, lead-containing materials, and mold or moisture-related concerns. Work is performed in accordance with project scope, applicable requirements, MEI procedures, and the technician’s current training, credentials, and authorized level of supervision. Opportunities for advancement and additional certifications are available.

Primary Responsibilities

· Perform asbestos, lead and mold samples by collecting material, dust, soil, air, and other environmental samples as authorized by the project scope, applicable law, and the technician’s certifications; document representative locations and conditions.

· Prepare accurate field logs; label samples consistently; maintain chain-of-custody records; package and coordinate delivery to qualified laboratories.

· Capture clear, correctly identified photographs and record material description, sample location, condition, and other report-relevant observations using MEI field forms and procedures.

· Operate, inspect, clean, calibrate, and maintain sampling equipment and personal protective equipment (PPE), as applicable.

· Observe applicable site safety rules, hazard assessments, exposure-control procedures, respiratory protection requirements, and project-specific safety protocols; promptly report incidents and unsafe conditions.

· Communicate professionally with clients, project managers, laboratories, contractors, and colleagues; escalate unexpected conditions or scope changes.

· Assist with report preparation, laboratory result tracking, field-data quality checks, records management, and other administrative project activities.

Required Qualifications

· High school diploma or equivalent; relevant college education or technical coursework is preferred.

· Valid California driver’s license and ability to travel reliably to assigned sites, subject to applicable law and MEI driving requirements.

· Current credentials appropriate to assigned work. For asbestos consulting/site surveillance work subject to California certification requirements, a current Cal/OSHA CSST (or CAC) certification is required; MEI may consider qualified candidates for a limited, supervised role while pursuing credentials, where lawful.

· For regulated lead hazard evaluations, a current CDPH Lead-Related Construction Sampling Technician or Inspector/Assessor certification appropriate to the assigned duties is required. A Sampling Technician works under the direction of a certified Inspector/Assessor and cannot independently perform full lead hazard evaluations or clearance inspections.

· Ability to follow technical procedures, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly, and use common digital tools for field forms, photographs, email, and reports. Comfortable using current technology and apps

Preferred Qualifications

Current AHERA training, additional asbestos or CDPH lead certifications, experience with building-material and air sampling, moisture meters and other assessment instruments, chain-of-custody procedures, laboratory coordination, technical report writing, and environmental field monitoring. Relevant safety and respiratory protection training is also valued.

Schedule, Travel & Work Setting

Field-based assignments are primarily in Ventura and Santa Barbara counties, with occasional work elsewhere in Central and Southern California. Technicians are generally dispatched to job sites rather than reporting daily to an office. Schedules vary with project needs; occasional early starts, extended days, and overnight travel may be necessary. Some reporting and administrative work may be completed remotely. All work time, applicable travel time, meal and rest periods, and approved business expenses will be handled in accordance with California law and MEI policies.

Physical and Safety Requirements

The essential functions may involve standing, walking on uneven surfaces, using stairs or ladders when properly trained and authorized, carrying sampling equipment, working in occupied and unoccupied buildings, and wearing required PPE. Assignments may involve dust, moisture-damaged spaces, or other environmental hazards; appropriate controls and training are required. MEI will consider reasonable accommodations to enable qualified applicants and employees to perform essential functions.

Compensation & Benefits

Anticipated compensation: $60,000–$90,000 annualized equivalent, depending on experience, applicable certifications, and role level. Position is anticipated to be nonexempt (hourly), with applicable overtime paid in accordance with California law. Benefits identified by MEI include health insurance, dental insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid training, and mentorship, subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Equal Employment Opportunity

MEI is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. Reasonable accommodation is available during the application process and employment as required by law.

Pay: $28.85 - $43.27 per hour

Expected hours: 32.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Safety equipment provided
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

Security Supervisor – Distribution CenterAbout interr

interr is a global security services provider with deep experience protecting complex environments across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, corporate, and retail sectors. We combine **high-touch service, disciplined operations, and smart technology** to deliver security solutions that go beyond traditional security services.

At interr, our people are our greatest asset. We invest in leadership, professionalism, and accountability—because **the right people, in the right place, at the right time** make all the difference.

Position Overview

interr is seeking a **Security Supervisor** to support daily security operations at a large distribution center. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for supervising security officers, ensuring consistent execution of post orders, and maintaining a safe, secure, and professional environment.

Working closely with the Security Manager, the Security Supervisor will provide direct oversight of assigned shifts, support officer development, respond to incidents, and ensure that security services consistently meet interr's standards and client expectations.

The ideal candidate is a **dependable, confident, and approachable leader** who leads by example, understands the importance of customer service, and can make sound decisions in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Supervise day-to-day security operations during assigned shifts, including patrols, truck gate operations, and incident response.
* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and guidance to security officers, ensuring professionalism, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Ensure officers follow interr standards, post orders, safety procedures, and client-specific requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for security-related matters during assigned shifts, escalating significant issues to the Security Manager.
* Conduct shift briefings, post inspections, and routine checks to ensure operational readiness.
* Monitor officer attendance, punctuality, uniform standards, and overall performance.
* Coordinate coverage, post assignments, and staffing adjustments to maintain required security coverage.
* Respond to incidents, emergencies, and security concerns, ensuring appropriate documentation, communication, and escalation.
* Oversee visitor processing, truck check-in and check-out, and perimeter security activities.
* Review daily activity reports, incident reports, and operational logs for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist with onboarding, training, and development of new and existing security officers.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements to the Security Manager.
* Maintain positive working relationships with client personnel, facility leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, teamwork, accountability, and exceptional customer service.

Qualifications

* **2–3 years of security experience**, with at least **1 year in a lead officer or supervisory role** preferred.
* Previous experience in a **distribution center, warehouse, logistics, or industrial environment** strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate security officers in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain calm, professional, and decisive during incidents and emergencies.
* Experience preparing incident reports, maintaining operational logs, and using basic reporting systems.
* **Experience with yard management software (YMS) preferred.**
* Ability to work independently while following established procedures and management direction.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Current New Jersey **SORA certification**, or ability to obtain and maintain certification as required.

Physical & Work Requirements

* Ability to stand, walk, and conduct security patrols for extended periods.
* Ability to respond promptly and appropriately to incidents and emergencies.
* Comfortable working indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to work in an active distribution center environment with vehicle and pedestrian traffic.
* Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

What interr Offers

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* Training, leadership development, and career advancement opportunities.
* A professional, supportive, and people-first work environment.
* Opportunities to grow within an expanding organization with a strong global foundation.

Why Join interr?

At interr, **Security Supervisors are more than shift leaders—they set the standard for professionalism, accountability, and service excellence.**

We believe great security operations start with great people. If you take pride in leading by example, supporting your team, and delivering exceptional service, we want to hear from you.

**Built around people, powered by technology.**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $23.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Supervising: 1 year (Required)

License/Certification:

* SORA (Required)

* Dayton, NJ 08810 (Required)

4c5801c1afbd13247fc5.title: Value-Based Programs Lead (VBP Design)
4c5801c1afbd13247fc5.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana Healthy Horizons is looking for a Value-Based Programs Lead who will support successful value-based provider relationships with a focus on improving the provider experience and achieving path-to-value goals. You will lead the beginning-to-end operational support of specialty Medicaid value-based payment (VBP) models in alignment with segment strategy and goals. The Value-Based Programs Lead will be a subject matter expert in VBP and have advanced technical knowledge and experience.

* Develop new innovative VBP models for range of provider types, such as behavioral health, maternity, specialists, and social determinants of health, creating glide paths to move providers from volume to value.
* Align scope of work with roadmap for new VBP model development to ensure compliance with Medicaid contractual requirements and RFP commitments.
* Analyze financial, utilization, and performance data to identify opportunities to drive improvements in quality and/or reductions in total cost of care.
* Creation of VBP payment strategies and model design, such as developing payment model logic, performance metrics and benchmarks, and financial terms, which align with segment goals.
* Design and contribute to development of provider reporting packages to help providers understand their overall and detailed performance.
* Partner with finance team to conduct impact analysis and modeling for new VBP models.
* Collaborate with team members and matrixed teams to operationalize and rollout of new VBP models. Contribute to developing solutions to operational gaps.
* Monitor VBP model performance KPIs to identify opportunities to enhance model design based on internal and external feedback and performance data.
* Ability to translate strategy into models that can be piloted and scaled across markets.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

* Bachelor's degree.

Altamira is looking for a field-oriented, full-time **hands-on manager with significant experience in retail residential projects and institutional/agency bathroom modification work**. A manager who understands the entire project cycle—from meeting with a customer and identifying their needs to estimating, selling, scheduling, managing installation, and ensuring the finished project meets Altamira's standards.Experience with stairlifts, ramps, platform lifts, and other accessibility equipment is helpful but not required.

The successful candidate should be comfortable visiting customers' homes and facilities, measuring, developing scopes of work, directing field employees, solving installation problems, and helping lead and grow our Philadelphia operation.

**Primary Responsibilities- Bathroom Remodeling Sales & Estimating**

* Meet with residential, institutional, and agency customers to evaluate bathroom remodeling and accessibility needs.
* Perform on-site assessments, measurements, and job-site evaluations.
* Develop accurate scopes of work, material requirements, labor estimates, and project pricing.
* Prepare and present proposals to customers.
* Explain remodeling options, accessibility solutions, products, costs, and project timelines.
* Follow up on outstanding proposals and actively work to convert qualified opportunities into sold projects.
* Identify change-order requirements and ensure additional work is properly documented and priced.
* Maintain appropriate project margins while delivering competitive proposals.

**Bathroom Remodeling & Project Management**

* Oversee bathroom renovation and modification projects from initial assessment through final completion.
* Coordinate employees, materials, permits, inspections, and project schedules.
* Monitor job quality, productivity, schedule, and profitability.
* Conduct job-site visits as necessary to ensure work is progressing according to scope.
* Resolve field problems and customer concerns quickly and professionally.
* Conduct or coordinate final project inspections and customer walkthroughs.

**Branch Leadership**

* Provide day-to-day leadership by monitoring the branch workload and staffing requirements.
* Must be willing to travel with occasional overnight stays
* Direct, develop, coach, and support the branch's home accessibility technicians.
* Establish clear expectations for scheduling, productivity, quality, customer service, and job documentation.
* Help recruit, train, and develop additional field personnel.
* Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, safety, and excellent customer service.

**Business Development & Growth**

* Develop the local retail bathroom remodeling business.
* Develop relationships with organizations serving seniors and individuals with disabilities.
* Identify opportunities for bathroom modifications through healthcare, rehabilitation, aging-in-place, and community-based organizations.
* Build relationships with contractors, vendors, suppliers, and other local partners.
* Help establish Altamira as a leading provider of accessible bathroom remodeling and home accessibility services in the Philadelphia market.
* Work with company leadership to establish annual sales, revenue, margin, and growth objectives for the branch.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Strong customer communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead a small team while remaining directly involved in day-to-day operations.

**Preferred**

* Previous management or supervisory experience.
* Experience managing remodeling, plumbing, construction, or home-services operation.
* Experience with accessible bathroom remodeling or aging-in-place modifications.
* Knowledge of ADA and accessibility concepts.

**Physical Requirements**

* Required to use hands to operate vehicles and forklift

f418d539c5dee12687a1.title: Operations Coordinator - Marketing Agency
f418d539c5dee12687a1.description:
**In order to be considered for this full-time, remote position, candidates must live in Colorado. Contractors and 3rd-party firms need not apply.**

### **Join a Rapidly Expanding Team as an Operations Coordinator of a Growing Digital Marketing Agency!**

Are you the person who keeps everything moving, follows up before anyone has to ask, and loves a clean system? Tree Ring Digital is looking for an Operations Coordinator to keep our internal operations organized, our pipeline current, and our follow-up consistent, so our CEO can stay focused on clients and growth.

You will work directly alongside our CEO and business development lead, taking the day-to-day operational work off their plates and owning it from start to finish. From managing inbox follow-up and confirming meetings to keeping HubSpot accurate and our own social media active, you will be the reason details get handled and opportunities get followed up. If you are organized, a strong communicator, and energized by seeing your work help a company grow, this role has real room to grow with you.

Tree Ring Digital is a Denver-based, top-rated digital marketing agency with a culture that's hard to beat. We're like-minded professionals who share common passions, appreciate unique ideas, enjoy each other's company, and love what we do. Our well-established, creative team thrives in a fast-paced environment while maintaining an excellent work/life balance.

**Essential Functions/Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):**

**Executive & Operational Support:**

* Manage the CEO's inbox follow-up, routing team and client emails to the right people so nothing waits on the CEO unnecessarily
* Confirm meetings, schedule introductions, and keep the CEO's calendar organized
* Set up and maintain internal accounts, shared folders, and vendor tools as the team grows
* Place and track print orders and other operational requests
* Keep internal documentation, templates, and process notes current

**HubSpot & Pipeline Support:**

* Enter new contacts, companies, and deals in HubSpot after calls with the CEO and business development lead
* Keep deal stages, tasks, and notes accurate and current so the pipeline always reflects reality
* Enter and organize contact lists from conferences and networking events
* Flag stalled deals and overdue follow-ups so they get handled
* Send a weekly summary of follow-ups completed, HubSpot updates, and open items

**Follow-Up & Brand Support:**

* Send thank-you notes and follow-ups after podcast appearances, and leave reviews for shows we appear on
* Handle strategic partner and post-event follow-up using established templates and voice
* Manage light social media for Tree Ring Digital's own accounts, including the content calendar, posting, and engagement
* Coordinate with our design and content team members on Tree Ring Digital materials
* Help onboard and support interns and new team members as the team grows

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills:**

* 2+ years of experience in administrative, operations, or coordinator roles
* Hands-on HubSpot experience (required): contacts, deals, pipelines, and tasks
* Strong written communication that is professional, clear, and on-brand
* Comfortable with Google Workspace, Slack, and social media scheduling tools
* Agency or small business experience is a plus

**Ability to:**

* Stay organized across multiple priorities without losing detail
* Own a task from start to finish without needing constant check-ins
* Follow up consistently and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
* Learn new tools and processes quickly
* Work independently in a remote environment while staying connected to the team

**Soft Skills That Matter:**

* Reliable and consistent, so the team can count on you to follow through
* Detail-oriented without getting stuck on perfection
* Positive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in seeing the whole team win
* Calm and adaptable when priorities shift
* Curious about how a digital agency runs and grows

**What This Role Is NOT:**

* Not project coordination (our website project coordinators manage client projects and deadlines)
* Not accounting, billing, or collections (our accounting team handles those)
* Not closing sales or writing proposals (the CEO and business development lead handle those)
* Not client marketing execution or client social media management (our marketing specialist and team handle client work)
* Not graphic design (our design team creates visual materials)

**What We Offer the Right Candidate:**

This is a full-time, remote position paying $24-28 per hour depending on experience, with a 40-hour work week. You can work from anywhere in Colorado, with no office requirement.

Full-time employees are eligible for medical insurance with a company contribution, dental and vision with the employee premium fully covered, six paid holidays, paid sick leave, and paid vacation after your first year. You'll work with tools including HubSpot, Slack, and Google Workspace.

We know the holiday season is a unique time to start something new. Our plan is to use the slower weeks to train you so you're fully up to speed when the new year kicks off. For the right person, this role can grow into a Senior Operations Coordinator position or toward client relationships or business development as the company grows. Join a team where people genuinely love working because of our flexible remote environment, laid-back yet professional culture, and colleagues who have each other's backs. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Ready to keep a growing agency organized and moving forward? Apply today.**

*We appreciate your excitement, but please no calls to our office. Only applications received through our online portal will be considered.*

3ea9a1aae46c60b92af6.title: Field HR Coordinator
3ea9a1aae46c60b92af6.description:
**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**

All Wonder team members deliver quality customer service while maintaining a clean, safe, and stocked with the products our customers need. As a HR Coordinator, this means:

* Being friendly, professional, and supportive of internal customers (store leadership, HR, and team members) and external customers.
* Engaging in safe work practices and leading others by example.

The HR Coordinator reports to the site HR Manager and supports leadership through a wide range of HR and administrative duties related to staffing, scheduling, talent acquisition, compliance, payroll, and team member engagement.

**The Impact You Will Make**

1. Employee Lifecycle, Recruiting & Onboarding

* Support recruitment activities- posting requisitions, screening candidates against established qualifications, coordinating interviews.
* Coordinate preemployment requirements.
* Conduct new-hire orientations, send welcome communications, and prepare onboarding materials, employment documents, tax forms, and schedules.
* Coordinate with managers, IT, and Facilities to arrange employee access, email accounts, software access, identification badges, and assigned lockers.
* Maintain the new-hire badge report, coordinate badge production with Facilities, and manage locker assignments and related records.
* Track onboarding progress and verify completion of required compliance, security, and initial training.
* Communicate with managers regarding temporary employees and track assignment status.

2. Timekeeping, Payroll & Workforce Administration

* Review and reconcile employee timecards, attendance records, missed punches, and payroll-related information for accuracy and completeness.
* Research discrepancies, coordinate corrections with managers, and submit required adjustments through established approval processes.
* Maintain attendance and scheduling-related records and provide administrative support for workforce tracking.
* Respond to routine employee payroll and timekeeping inquiries, escalating unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate channels.
* Monitor outstanding transactions and follow up to support accurate, timely payroll processing.

3. HR Reporting, Data Management & Recordkeeping

* Prepare, maintain, and distribute recurring and ad hoc HR administrative reports for the site, and Field HR.
* Compile staffing, headcount, scheduling, attendance, turnover, and other workforce metrics requested by leadership.
* Maintain accurate employee information, personnel files, HRIS records, and required compliance documentation.
* Collect, verify, complete as authorized, and upload Form I-9 documentation into Workday, following applicable requirements.

4. Employee Services, Communication & Engagement

* Serve as an accessible first point of contact for employees and managers regarding routine HR policies, payroll, benefits, onboarding, and administrative processes.
* Assist employees with Workday navigation, benefits enrollment procedures, and access to HR information and resources.
* Coordinate employee recognition activities, engagement initiatives, and workplace communications.
* Maintain HR communication boards, HR-related spaces, orientation and training areas employee notices, and accessible information resources.
* Provide professional, responsive, and confidential service to employees, leaders, and external partners, escalating matters when appropriate.
* Coordinate administrative aspects of workers’ compensation cases
* Support accurate, timely documentation and communication related to workplace incidents, while maintaining confidentiality.
* Escalate sensitive employee matters, compliance concerns, and cases requiring interpretation or managerial decisions.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, training schedules, documentation requests, and routine administrative activities across supported groups.

**What You Bring To The Table**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent
* At least two years of administrative, HR operations, payroll, workforce coordination, or related experience.
* Practical experience supporting workers’ compensation claims administration, documentation, or case coordination.
* Experience handling confidential employee information and maintaining accurate records.
* Experience with timekeeping, attendance tracking, payroll reconciliation, or related workforce administration.
* Proficiency with Workday, Looker, and other HRIS systems
* Ability to work effectively with hourly employees, frontline management, and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
* Previous HR administrative experience in manufacturing, production, distribution, logistics, or another high-volume hourly workforce environment.
* Experience with Workday or comparable HRIS platforms.
* Experience supporting recruiting, onboarding, and employee orientation programs.
* Experience preparing recurring HR or workforce reports for multiple business functions.

Key Competencies

* This is a full-time, on-site position based in Swedesboro, New Jersey,
* The facility operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Schedule flexibility is required to support workforce needs, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend coverage.
* Work is performed primarily in an administrative setting with periodic presence in active production and distribution areas, where noise, equipment activity, and applicable safety procedures are part of the environment.
* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or support of neighboring facilities (less than 10%)
* The position may require occasional movement of office or training materials, including items weighing up to 40 pounds, with appropriate assistance or accommodation as needed.

What Success Looks Like

* Success in this role means delivering accurate and timely HR administration, supporting a smooth employee onboarding experience, maintaining dependable payroll and workforce records, responding effectively to employee and leadership needs, and ensuring that administrative requests and compliance-related tasks are completed or appropriately escalated. The HR Coordinator contributes to operational continuity by providing dependable processes, clear communication, and consistent follow-through across the teams they support.

**Swedesboro:** $23.75/hr - $28.50/hr

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

**A Final Note**

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

**We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

09dc94085f3012cbcb71.description:
Circuit Clinical® is on a mission to transform the way people find, choose, and participate in clinical research.

We are searching for a part-time **Clinical Informatics Analyst** to join our team!

Circuit Clinical was ranked 20th nationally for **Best Workplaces for Innovators by Fast Company®** and was named an **Inc. Magazine® Best Workplaces 2021**. Topping a long list of innovation and startup awards over the last 5 years – including winning SCOPE’s Participant Engagement Award and winning at 43North - Circuit recently won Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas™ Award.

Our award-winning culture is grounded on a belief in the values of transparency, inclusion, accountability, performance, talent seeking, & continuous learning. We live these values every day and we’re looking for a leader who embodies them. Our focus is on building an incredible, hard charging Team and on providing them with the opportunity to do the best work of their careers. In short, we’re motivated to take on the hardest problems in the development of new medicines – this is **Work That Matters**.

To accomplish our Mission, we know we must recruit the most dynamic, mission-driven, empathetic, and passionate leaders in our industry. **That’s where you come in!**

**What We Offer:**

If you’ve been looking for a chance to work with an amazing, highly motivated team and to have direct impact in building a transformative clinical trials company every day – that is exactly what we’re offering. We provide competitive benefits and an environment focused on helping you grow personally and professionally.

**What You Will Bring to Circuit Clinical:**

As our Clinical Informatics Analyst you will support data retrieval and healthcare network clinical information analysis. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning and validating Electronic Health Records (EHRs), and clinical research systems. Ideal candidates have experience working in healthcare systems with strong understanding of clinical billing, documentation practices, terminology, EHR reporting tools and stong Microsoft Excel skills.

This position is well-suited for an early-career professional seeking to build expertise in clinical research and healthcare technology.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Extract, compile, and organize data from EHR systems and clinical research platforms.
* Perform data quality audits to identify missing, inaccurate, or duplicate records.
* Validate datasets against source documentation and established business rules.
* Maintain data integrity and consistency across multiple systems.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Analyze healthcare and clinical research data to identify trends, patterns, and operational insights.
* Support patient population identification and feasibility assessments for clinical research studies.

**Data Management**

* Clean and transform data from multiple sources into usable formats.
* Support data reconciliation projects.
* Document data workflows and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and organizational privacy requirements.

**Collaboration**

* Work with clinical operations, research coordinators, informatics teams, and healthcare partners to fulfill data requests.

**Your Qualifications:**

**A day in the life**
---------------------

You start your morning by checking the day's run sheet, loading parts and materials, and inspecting a company vehicle before heading out for time-sensitive deliveries to customers and our other facilities. After drop-offs, you return to assist with shipping and receiving, organize inventory across storage locations, and lend a hand building skids and loading crates. In the afternoon, you might assemble valves and regulators or complete safety checks on regulators after training—work that directly supports our sales organization. When the Facilities Manager needs a hand, you're there—whether it's supporting daily building operations or helping set up and clean up for corporate events. Throughout the day, you keep the workspace safe, orderly, and compliant with company, customer, and DOT requirements.

### **What you'll do**

* Operate company vehicles, including DOT trucks, to deliver parts and materials to customer sites and shuttle goods between facilities.
* Load and unload trucks with a focus on safety and efficiency.
* Execute shipping and receiving transactions; move, organize, and maintain inventory across storage areas.
* Assist with packaging, skid building, and crate loading.
* Perform safety checks on regulators (post-training) and assemble valves, regulators, and related products to support sales.
* Support the Facilities Manager with daily operations and provide setup/teardown assistance for corporate events.
* Work occasional overtime or adjusted schedules as needed for deliveries, inventory tasks, and events.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe environment; follow all company and customer safety policies; meet DOT and customer safety requirements.

* High School Diploma.
* 2+ years of driving experience with a valid Driver's License and an insurable driving record.
* 1+ years of shipping and receiving experience.
* 2+ years in roles requiring high attention to detail.
* 2+ years supporting internal or external customers.
* 2+ years working with general shipping and receiving concepts.

#### **Preferred**

* Trade school education and/or technical training.
* Forklift operating experience.
* Background in warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or industrial settings.
* Experience with inventory control and material handling processes.
* Mechanical or technical experience, including the use of hand tools.

* Lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds safely.

* Service Truck
* Flatbed Truck / Pickup Truck

* Driver's License

* Shipping/Receiving

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

Enjoy a standout culture, a fantastic work environment, and competitive benefits including premium medical coverage, a 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement, and other unique incentives.

**About the role**

For decades, World Book has supplied reference content to school and public libraries and media centers. Now we are moving into K-12 classroom instruction with ClassMate, a supplemental, cross-curricular nonfiction literacy platform for grades 6–8. It helps content-area teachers build literacy into the science, social studies and math units they already teach.

The Customer Success Lead spans both sides of that business. You lead the team that renews World Book Online for schools and libraries, and you personally manage a small book of strategic library and media services accounts. You also lead ClassMate implementation: how new districts get launched, adopted and renewed. That makes this a key role in World Book's move into instruction.

**What you'll do**

**Lead the World Book Online renewal team**
